english:
Rachakonda is a ruined hill fort east of Hyderabad, built among granite ridges that provide natural defences. It became the seat of a branch of the Recherla Nayakas after the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom. Stone gateways and walls follow the rocky ground, enclosing the remains of a fortified capital.

In the fourteenth century Anapota Nayaka established his court at Rachakonda, while another branch of the family ruled from Devarakonda. The chiefs contended with neighbouring kingdoms and the Bahmani sultans for control of Telangana. Rachakonda eventually fell to the Bahmanis in the fifteenth century, ending its time as the capital of the Recherla rulers. The remains of the fort recall a period when local dynasties competed to fill the space left by the Kakatiyas.
simp_chinese:
拉恰孔达是海得拉巴以东一座废弃山堡，建在可提供天然防御的花岗岩山脊之间。卡卡提亚王国覆灭后，它成为雷切尔拉纳亚克家族一支的驻地。石造门楼和城墙沿着崎岖地势延伸，围住设防都城的遗迹。

十四世纪，阿纳波塔·纳亚克在拉恰孔达设立宫廷，家族另一支则从德瓦拉孔达统治。诸首领与邻近王国及巴赫曼尼苏丹争夺特伦甘纳。十五世纪，拉恰孔达最终落入巴赫曼尼之手，结束了它作为雷切尔拉统治者都城的时期。堡垒遗迹令人想起地方王朝争夺卡卡提亚留下的权力空间的时代。

english:
Racibórz stands where a road from the Moravian Gate towards Kraków crossed the Oder. An old fortified settlement and one of the historic capitals of Upper Silesia, it became the seat of a Piast duchy in 1172. Its brewers enjoyed early privileges, and their beer found buyers in Silesia and neighbouring Bohemia. The castle chapel of St Thomas recalls a bishop of Wrocław who took refuge here in a dispute with a Silesian duke.

Duke Leszek acknowledged Bohemian overlordship in 1327. When he died without an heir in 1336, King John of Bohemia granted the duchy to Nicholas II of Opava, whose Přemyslid descendants ruled it thereafter. The townspeople retained their municipal rights, and clothmaking, tanning and brewing supported a growing commercial centre. In 1521 Racibórz passed to the Piast Duke Jan II of Opole, reuniting two important Upper Silesian duchies before his death in 1532 brought them to the Bohemian Crown.
simp_chinese:
拉齐布日位于从摩拉维亚门通往克拉科夫的道路横渡奥得河之处。这座古老的设防聚落是上西里西亚的历史首府之一，1172年成为皮雅斯特公国的驻地。当地酿酒匠很早便获得特权，他们的啤酒在西里西亚和邻近的波希米亚都有人购买。城堡内的圣托马斯礼拜堂令人想起一位弗罗茨瓦夫主教：他与西里西亚公爵发生争执时，曾到此避难。

莱谢克公爵于1327年承认波希米亚的宗主权。他在1336年无嗣去世后，波希米亚国王约翰将公国授予奥帕瓦的尼古拉二世，此后由他的普热米斯尔家族后代统治。居民保有自治权，制呢、制革与酿酒支撑了日益繁荣的商镇。1521年，拉齐布日转归奥波莱皮雅斯特公爵扬二世，两大上西里西亚公国重新合并；1532年他去世后，领地回归波希米亚王冠。

english:
Rada is a town of the Yemeni highlands whose most celebrated monument is the Amiriya, a mosque and school distinguished by domes, carved stucco and painted decoration. The complex combines a place of worship with rooms for teaching and residence, giving architectural expression to the prosperity of the Tahirid rulers who made the town an important centre.

Sultan Amir ibn Abd al-Wahhab founded the Amiriya in 1504, during the last years of the Tahirid dynasty. He spent extended periods in Rada, where members of his family also endowed other schools. The Amiriya's upper level contains a courtyard and living quarters, while a large water basin stands alongside the lower part. Its decorated prayer hall and spaces for study served scholars and worshippers together. The sultan himself is thought to have used the complex as a residence during his stays in the town.
simp_chinese:
拉达是也门高地的一座城镇，最著名的建筑是阿米里亚清真寺与学校，以穹顶、雕刻灰泥和彩绘装饰著称。建筑群将礼拜场所与教学、居住空间结合起来，体现了使此镇成为重要中心的塔希尔王朝统治者的繁荣。

1504年，苏丹阿米尔·本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜在塔希尔王朝末年兴建阿米里亚。他常在拉达长期居留，家族成员也在此捐建其他学校。阿米里亚上层设有庭院与居室，下层旁边有一座大型蓄水池。装饰华丽的礼拜厅与学习空间同时服务学者和礼拜者。据信苏丹在镇上居留时，也曾将建筑群用作住处。

english:
Radhanpur lies in the dry country of northern Gujarat, near routes linking cultivated districts with the desert margins. Farming, livestock and trade connected the town with surrounding villages and markets, while rainfall and access to water shaped local production.

In the eighteenth century Radhanpur became a centre of the Babi ruling family. After the Marathas took Ahmedabad in 1753, Kamal-ud-din Khan, known as Jawan Mard Khan, retained Radhanpur and other northern Gujarat territories as a jagir. The town's rulers thereafter negotiated their position among the larger powers that contested Gujarat.
simp_chinese:
拉丹布尔位于古吉拉特北部的干旱地区，靠近连接农业区与沙漠边缘的道路。耕作、畜牧和贸易将城镇与周围村落及市场联系起来，降雨和水源则影响当地生产。

十八世纪，拉丹布尔成为巴比家族的统治中心。1753年马拉塔人夺取艾哈迈达巴德后，人称贾万·马尔德汗的卡迈勒丁汗仍保有拉丹布尔及古吉拉特北部其他领地，作为采邑。此后，当地统治者在争夺古吉拉特的较大势力之间维持自己的地位。

sources.title: The Imperial Gazetteer of India Vol-21 (Pushkar to Salween).pdf

english: Radkan lies in the Khorasan country northwest of Mashhad. Its best-known monument is a tall brick tower with a conical roof, raised in the thirteenth century during the Ilkhanid period. Thirty-six rounded ribs articulate the outside of the tower, while its interior has eight sides. The building served as a tomb, though its occupant is unknown. Its distinctive form makes it one of Khorasan's notable medieval monuments.
simp_chinese: 拉德坎位于马什哈德西北的呼罗珊地区。当地最著名的建筑是一座覆有圆锥形屋顶的高砖塔，建于十三世纪的伊儿汗国时期。塔身外侧有三十六道圆形壁柱，内部则呈八角形。人们通常认为它是一座墓塔，但墓主身份尚无定论。独特的造型使它成为呼罗珊一处引人注目的中世纪建筑。

english: New Radnor lies beneath a castle mound on the eastern edge of the Welsh hills. The earthwork occupies a natural bluff overlooking the settlement and a route into Elfael, a district contested by Welsh rulers and the lords of the Marches. In 1188 Archbishop Baldwin visited Radnor on his journey through Wales to preach the Crusade. The surviving mound recalls a fortified place on the changing frontier between Wales and England.
simp_chinese: 新拉德诺位于威尔士丘陵东缘，坐落在城堡土丘下方。土垒占据天然高地，俯瞰聚落和通往埃尔韦尔的道路；威尔士统治者与边区领主曾争夺这一地区。1188年，鲍德温大主教穿越威尔士宣讲十字军时曾到访拉德诺。留存的土丘让人想起英威边境不断变化的一处设防地点。

english: Radogoshch stood on the Sudost, a tributary of the Desna, in the old Starodub country. The Hypatian Chronicle mentions it in 1155, and historians generally identify it with the site of later Pogar. Lithuanian forces captured and burned the town in 1534 during the struggle with Moscow. Under the Cossack Hetmanate Pogar became a company centre of the Starodub regiment, and its townspeople sought confirmation of their municipal rights in 1666.
simp_chinese: 拉多戈希位于杰斯纳河支流苏多斯季河畔，属于古老的斯塔罗杜布地区。《伊帕季编年史》在1155年提到它，历史学家通常认为其旧址就是后来的波加尔。1534年立陶宛军在与莫斯科的争斗中攻占并焚毁城镇。哥萨克酋长国时期，波加尔成为斯塔罗杜布团的百人队驻地，市民于1666年请求确认其城市权利。

english: Radomsko lies on the Radomka in the historic Sieradz lands, at a meeting of routes through central Poland. Duke Leszek the Black granted it town privileges in 1266 and later brought Franciscan friars here. Their Gothic church was supported by King Władysław the Short in 1328. The town entered the affairs of the kingdom when Polish nobles gathered here in 1382 and 1384 during the succession that brought Jadwiga to the throne. Under the Jagiellonian dynasty, royal privileges encouraged trade: Władysław Jagiełło granted such rights in 1427, and Sigismund II Augustus added further privileges in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 拉多姆斯科坐落在谢拉兹历史地区的拉多姆卡河畔，位于中波兰道路交会处。黑公爵莱谢克于1266年授予城镇特权，后来又引入方济各会修士。国王「矮子」瓦迪斯瓦夫于1328年资助修建他们的哥特式教堂。1382年和1384年，波兰贵族在此集会，商议最终使雅德维加登上王位的继承问题，城镇因此进入王国大事的舞台。雅盖隆王朝时期，王室特权促进贸易：瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃于1427年颁发相关权利，齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特又在十六世纪增加特权。

english: Radovan stands on the Desnățui River in the plain of southern Oltenia. The village is recorded in a document of 1558. Nearby at Târnava, the hermitage of Târnăvița was founded in 1672 by the abbot Partenie. Its church was painted in 1694 by a group of craftsmen led by Andrei, a painter associated with the school of Hurezi, bringing the art of that monastery to this rural corner of Wallachia.
simp_chinese: 拉多瓦努位于奥尔泰尼亚南部平原的德斯讷楚伊河畔，1558年的文书已记载了这个村庄。附近特尔纳瓦的特尔讷维察隐修院由院长帕尔泰尼于1672年创建。1694年，以画师安德烈为首的一组匠人为教堂绘制壁画；他与胡雷济画派有关，将那座修道院的艺术带到了瓦拉几亚乡间。

english:
Radziejów lies in Kuyavia, a farming region of central Poland. Its market and craftsmen served the surrounding countryside, while town institutions gave it a place in the administration of the region. In 1298 Władysław Łokietek granted the town full Magdeburg rights; an earlier attempt to establish a town in 1252 may not have been carried through.

From 1510 the town hosted joint assemblies, or sejmiks, of the two Kuyavian voivodeships. Courts and the seat of a royal starosta also made Radziejów an administrative centre. War brought destruction: the town and its castle suffered during Swedish campaigns in the seventeenth century. These institutions and upheavals tied a small market town to the politics of the Polish crown and Commonwealth.
simp_chinese:
拉杰尤夫位于波兰中部的库亚维亚农业区。市场和工匠服务周围乡村，市镇机构也使它成为地区行政的一部分。1298年，瓦迪斯瓦夫·洛凯特克授予该镇完整的马格德堡法；1252年曾有较早的建镇许可，但可能未能落实。

从1510年起，库亚维亚两个省的联合地方议会在这里举行。法院和王室地方长官的驻地，也使拉杰尤夫成为行政中心。战争带来破坏：十七世纪瑞典军队的行动波及城镇和城堡。地方机构与战乱将这座小镇同波兰王国及波兰立陶宛联邦的政治联系起来。

english: The Rae Lakes lie between Great Slave and Great Bear lakes, in a country of forest and waterways used by the Tłı̨chǫ and Sahtu Dene. Families moved through this region to fish and hunt, following trails between seasonal camps. Routes through the lakes connected with Great Slave Lake, Great Bear Lake and the Mackenzie River; after the arrival of the fur trade, travellers also followed them to trading posts on those waters.
simp_chinese: 雷湖群位于大奴湖和大熊湖之间，周围森林与水道为特里乔人和萨图德内人所利用。各家庭沿道路往返季节性营地，在这一地区捕鱼狩猎。湖区路线与大奴湖、大熊湖及马更些河相连；毛皮贸易到来之后，旅人也沿这些道路前往水边的贸易站。

sources.title: Dehk’è Frank Channel Bridge - LUP Application - Project Screening Document - May 5 25.pdf

english:
Raebareli belongs to the fertile country of Awadh, where river plains and roads connect farming communities with important towns of northern India. Grain cultivation and other crops supplied households, while markets and crafts supported exchange beyond the immediate village. Seasonal rain, water, and landholding shaped agricultural work. Local institutions organized relationships through religion, family, and obligations linking rural society with centers of authority.

The town was taken by Ibrahim Shah of the Jaunpur Sultanate, who built a fort and mosques there in the fifteenth century. Its congregational mosque was later restored under Aurangzeb. Different neighbourhoods developed around families and communities associated with the town, while the surrounding district remained part of the agricultural world of Awadh.
simp_chinese:
赖伯雷利属于阿瓦德肥沃地区，河川平原和道路将农业社区同北印度重要城镇连接。谷物等作物供应家庭，市场工艺支持村落之外交换。季节雨水、水源及土地安排影响农事，地方制度通过宗教、家庭和义务，使乡村社会同权威中心保持关系。居民生活扎根土地及长期社会联系。

焦恩普尔苏丹国的易卜拉欣沙占领此城，并在十五世纪修建堡垒和清真寺。城中的聚礼清真寺后来在奥朗则布统治下得到修复。不同街区围绕与城镇有关的家族和社群形成，而周边地区仍属于阿瓦德的农业世界。

english:
Rafsanjan lies in a broad basin northwest of Kerman, amid the desert-edge oases of the Iranian plateau. Underground water channels made cultivation possible in this dry country. The town was formerly known as Bahramabad; scholars have suggested that it either occupied or succeeded the medieval settlement of Unas. Its old walls had several watchtowers and four gates, enclosing a community on the route between Kerman and Yazd.

The name Bahramabad appears in records from the late fourteenth century. Under the Safavids, Ganj Ali Khan, governor of Kerman under Shah Abbas I, sponsored the Kabutar Khan caravanserai in the district. Its corner towers protected a courtyard where travellers and their animals could rest. The fortified inn recalls the traffic through the basin as well as the governor's investment in buildings along the roads of his province.
simp_chinese:
拉夫桑詹位于克尔曼西北的宽阔盆地中，属于伊朗高原沙漠边缘的绿洲地带。地下水渠使干旱地区得以耕作。城镇旧称巴赫拉马巴德；学者认为它可能就是中世纪的乌纳斯，或是其后继聚落。旧城墙设有数座瞭望塔和四座城门，围护着这座位于克尔曼与亚兹德之间的城镇。

巴赫拉马巴德之名见于十四世纪末的记载。萨法维时期，阿拔斯一世麾下的克尔曼总督甘吉·阿里汗在当地兴建了卡布塔尔汗商队旅舍。四角塔楼守护着庭院，供旅人与牲畜休息。这座设防旅舍既见证了穿越盆地的交通，也体现出总督对本省道路沿线建筑的投入。

english: On the exposed northwestern shore of Vancouver Island, Raft Cove lies south of San Josef Bay. A long spit and a crescent of sand mark the mouth of a river, while the rugged coast gives way inland to rounded hills and forests of western hemlock and red cedar. Bears forage along the streams and beach, where the forest meets the waters of the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 筏湾位于温哥华岛西北部面向大洋的海岸，坐落在圣约瑟夫湾以南。一条长长沙嘴与新月形沙滩围绕着河口，崎岖的海岸向内陆延伸，渐渐变为浑圆的山丘，以及西部铁杉和西部红雪松组成的森林。在森林与太平洋相接的地方，熊沿着溪流和海滩觅食。

english: Ragay Gulf lies between the Bicol and Bondoc peninsulas of southeastern Luzon. Its long inlet opens southwards towards the Sibuyan Sea, with hilly coasts on either side. Narrow fringing reefs and fishing grounds line the gulf, which forms one of the many sheltered waters around the deeply indented Bicol region.
simp_chinese: 拉盖湾位于吕宋东南部的比科尔半岛与邦多克半岛之间。狭长海湾向南通往锡布延海，两侧海岸丘陵起伏。狭窄的岸礁和渔场沿湾分布，它是海岸曲折的比科尔地区众多较隐蔽水域之一。

english: Ragh lies in the mountain country between Darvaz and Badakhshan, west of the upper Panj. Its valleys contain deposits of gold-bearing quartz, among the mineral resources of northeastern Afghanistan. In the seventeenth century the shahs of Darvaz and the rulers of Badakhshan emerged as rival powers. The country of Ragh, lying between their centres on the Panj and at Fayzabad, was repeatedly contested in the fighting between them.
simp_chinese: 拉格位于达尔瓦兹与巴达赫尚之间的山地，处在喷赤河上游以西。当地谷地蕴藏含金石英矿脉，是阿富汗东北部矿产的一部分。十七世纪，达尔瓦兹沙阿与巴达赫尚统治者成为对手；拉格地处双方在喷赤河畔和法伊扎巴德的中心之间，在历次冲突中屡遭争夺。

english: Raghdan is a mountain village in the Sarawat country near al-Bahah. Wadi Qub runs between its hills, and inhabitants built terraces to cultivate the slopes. The village was also known for its Sunday market, where people from surrounding communities came to exchange the produce of the highlands. Close-set houses and cultivated ground gave the settlement a distinct place in this mountainous landscape.
simp_chinese: 拉格丹是巴哈附近萨拉瓦特山地中的一座村庄。古卜谷流经群山之间，居民修筑梯田耕种山坡。村庄还以周日集市闻名，周边社群的人们在此交换高地产物。紧密排列的房屋和耕地，使这座聚落在山地景观中独具特色。

english:
Ragnit stands on the steep southern bank of the Nemunas, in the old land of the Skalvians. The Teutonic Order conquered the settlement in 1289 and built a castle here between 1397 and 1409. The fortress guarded northern Prussia and served as a base for campaigns into neighbouring Samogitia. Although the fortress was significant, the settlement remained in the shadow of nearby Tilsit.

Plague and famine during the Great Northern War killed many inhabitants of Ragnit and its district in 1709–1711. Prussian authorities subsequently settled immigrants from Salzburg, and Frederick William I granted the settlement town privileges in 1722. Russian forces destroyed it again during the Seven Years' War in 1757. The old castle, no longer needed for defence, later served as a court and prison.
simp_chinese:
拉格尼特位于涅曼河南岸陡峭的高地上，地处斯卡尔维亚人的古老土地。条顿骑士团于1289年征服聚落，并在1397至1409年间修建城堡。要塞守卫普鲁士北部，也是骑士团进攻邻近萨莫吉希亚的基地。尽管要塞地位重要，聚落仍处在附近蒂尔西特的影响之下。

大北方战争期间，1709至1711年的瘟疫与饥荒夺去拉格尼特及周围地区许多居民的生命。普鲁士当局随后安置来自萨尔茨堡的移民，腓特烈·威廉一世于1722年授予聚落城市特权。七年战争期间，俄军于1757年再次摧毁城镇。古老城堡不再用于防御，后来被用作法院和监狱。

english: Raguli lies in the steppe south of the Manych depression, near the meeting of small streams. Before the village was founded, the surrounding country formed part of the open grazing lands between the northern Caucasus and the Don basin. Shallow, often saline lakes and marshes occupied the Manych lowland to the north, contrasting with the dry grasslands around it. Herds and their keepers moved through this broad landscape according to the availability of water and pasture.
simp_chinese: 拉古利位于马内奇洼地以南的草原，靠近小河汇合之处。村庄建立以前，周围是北高加索与顿河流域之间开阔牧地的一部分。北方的马内奇低地分布着浅湖与沼泽，湖水常带盐分，与周围干燥草原形成对照。牧群和牧人依照水源、牧草的情况穿行于这片广阔地带。

english:
Ragunda lies in the valley of the Indalsälven in eastern Jämtland. Here the river once flowed through Lake Ragunda and over the great Storforsen waterfall. The falls were a formidable obstacle to the movement of timber downstream, and their disappearance would transform the valley in a single night.

In 1796, workmen attempted to open a channel around Storforsen so that logs could pass without being broken on the rocks. On the night of 6–7 June the loose ground gave way, and Lake Ragunda emptied in a few hours. A flood surged down the Indalsälven, while the old waterfall was left dry. The exposed bed and silent rocks became known as Döda fallet, the Dead Falls, a lasting trace of the attempt to tame the river for the timber trade.
simp_chinese:
拉贡达位于耶姆特兰东部的因达尔河谷。河水曾流经拉贡达湖，再从斯图尔福森大瀑布倾泻而下。瀑布阻碍木材顺流运输，而它的消失在一夜之间改变了整条河谷。

1796年，工人试图在瀑布旁开挖水道，让原木避开容易撞碎木材的岩石。6月6日至7日夜间，松软的地层突然决口，拉贡达湖在几小时内泄空。洪水沿因达尔河奔涌而下，旧瀑布则彻底干涸。裸露的河床和寂静的岩石后来被称作“死亡瀑布”，成为人们试图改造河流以便利木材运输的持久见证。

english: Rahachow stands between the Drut and Dnieper rivers. First mentioned in a Rus' chronicle in 1142, it later formed part of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Muscovite forces captured and destroyed the town in 1492. From the sixteenth century it was a royal town in Rechytsa County, within Minsk Voivodeship. Cossack and Russian raids hindered its development in the seventeenth century, but it remained a regional centre of trade and manufacture. The county's local assembly met here temporarily during the reign of Stanisław August Poniatowski. In the first partition of the Commonwealth in 1772, Rahachow passed to the Russian Empire; five years later it became the seat of an administrative district in Mogilev Governorate.
simp_chinese: 拉哈乔夫位于德鲁季河与第聂伯河之间，1142年首次见于罗斯编年史，后来属于立陶宛大公国及波兰—立陶宛联邦。1492年，莫斯科军队攻占并摧毁了城镇。十六世纪起，它是明斯克省列奇察县的一座王室城镇。十七世纪哥萨克及俄罗斯军队的袭击阻碍其发展，但这里仍是地区贸易与制造业中心。斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基统治时期，县的地方议会曾暂时迁来此地。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，拉哈乔夫归入俄罗斯帝国；五年后，它成为莫吉廖夫省的一个县级行政中心。

english: Rahatgarh stands on the steep bank of the Bina River west of Sagar. Its fort crowns a hill above the town, with a circuit of walls and massive towers surrounding the remains of palaces, temples and mosques. The stronghold is attributed to Sultan Muhammad Khan in the seventeenth century. Its position overlooks the river and the approaches through the hilly country between Sagar and Bhopal, while a waterfall lies a short distance away.
simp_chinese: 拉哈特格尔位于萨加尔以西、比纳河的陡峭河岸上。堡垒耸立在城镇上方的山丘，城墙和巨大塔楼环绕着宫殿、寺庙与清真寺的遗迹。要塞相传由苏丹穆罕默德汗于十七世纪修建。它俯瞰河流和穿越萨加尔与博帕尔之间丘陵地区的道路，不远处还有一座瀑布。

english: Rahayta is an Afar coastal settlement near the southern end of the Red Sea, its name associated with water springing from the ground. The salt plains of Warraysa Dagad lie to its south. In the early sixteenth century Gibdi Hamad divided the territory of the Tagira sultanate, creating a separate sultanate at Rahayta. Early in the eighteenth century its ruling branches, Dinitte and Burhanto, established an alternating succession to end disputes within the family.
simp_chinese: 拉海塔是红海南端附近的一处阿法尔海岸聚落，其名称与从地下涌出的水有关。城南是瓦赖萨达加德盐原。十六世纪初，吉布迪·哈马德分割塔吉拉苏丹国的土地，在拉海塔建立了另一个苏丹国。十八世纪初，统治家族的迪尼特与布尔汉托两支确立轮流继位的制度，以平息家族内部的争端。

english:
Al-Rahba guards the Euphrates valley near Mayadin, where the cultivated riverbank meets the Syrian desert. The first town, founded by the Abbasid commander Malik ibn Tawk, stood beside the river. After an earthquake devastated it in 1157, a new fortress rose on a mound towards the desert, protected by walls and overlooking the approaches to the valley. Its position made it a coveted stronghold on the road between Syria and Iraq.

Under the Mamluks, al-Rahba was an important frontier fortress and administrative centre on the Euphrates, as well as an eastern terminus of the sultanate's postal network. Its garrison stood on a contested frontier with the Mongol powers of Iraq. The fortress and its settlement remained significant through the later Middle Ages, though their importance diminished under Ottoman rule. The high citadel preserved the memory of the town that had once guarded this passage between the river and the desert.
simp_chinese:
赖赫巴扼守迈亚丁附近的幼发拉底河谷，河岸耕地与叙利亚荒漠在此相接。阿拔斯将领马利克·伊本·陶克所建的最初城镇位于河边；1157年地震摧毁城镇后，人们在靠近荒漠的土丘上修建新堡垒，以城墙防御并俯瞰进入河谷的道路。这里控制着叙利亚与伊拉克之间的通道，因而成为各方争夺的据点。

马穆鲁克统治时期，赖赫巴是幼发拉底河上的重要边境堡垒和行政中心，也是苏丹国驿路的东端之一。驻军面对着与伊拉克蒙古诸政权争夺的边疆。堡垒及其聚落在中世纪后期仍然重要，到了奥斯曼时期地位逐渐下降。高耸的城堡保存了这座昔日扼守河流与荒漠之间通道的城镇的记忆。

english: Rahimabad lies near Parandak on the dry plain northeast of Saveh. The Shur River passes south of the settlement, crossing a landscape of open ground and cultivated villages between the western highlands and the central Iranian basin. The country forms part of the route from Saveh towards Ray, a corridor travelled by merchants and officials between the cities of the plateau. The river's name, meaning salty, reflects the character of waters that drain towards the interior salt basins.
simp_chinese: 拉希马巴德位于萨韦东北的干旱平原，靠近帕兰达克。舒尔河从聚落南方经过，穿越西部高地与伊朗中部盆地之间的开阔土地和耕作村庄。这里处在萨韦通往雷伊的道路上，商人和官员由此往来高原城市。河名意为“咸”，反映了流向内陆盐盆地的水流特征。

english:
Rahon lies in the Doaba, between the Beas and Sutlej rivers. A trading town on routes towards Tibet and Central Asia, it was known for its market and for cotton cloth, including the closely woven fabric called bafta. Tradition traces its foundation to Raja Raghab, who is said to have named it Raghupur.

Under Akbar, Rahon was the centre of Dardhak Mahal, a subdivision of the Mughal administration, and a brick fort was built there in Aurangzeb's reign. Sikhs and Mughal forces fought at Rahon in 1710. In 1759 Tara Singh Ghaiba of the Dallewalia Misl seized the town and made it his headquarters. After his death in 1807, Maharaja Ranjit Singh annexed the misl's territories, including Rahon.
simp_chinese:
拉亨位于比亚斯河与萨特莱杰河之间的多阿巴地区，是通往西藏和中亚道路上的商镇。这里以市集和棉布闻名，出产包括密织的巴夫塔布在内的多种织物。相传拉格布王创建此城，最初将其称作拉古普尔。

阿克巴统治时期，拉亨是莫卧儿行政区达尔达克马哈尔的中心；奥朗则布在位时，城中修建了一座砖堡。1710年，锡克人与莫卧儿军队在此交战。1759年，达勒瓦利亚米斯尔的塔拉·辛格·盖巴夺取拉亨，将其作为总部。他于1807年去世后，兰吉特·辛格大君吞并了该米斯尔的领地，拉亨也随之易手。

english: Rahor is a monastery in the mountain country of Dranggo in eastern Tibet. It began as a Bon institution and later passed to the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism, before becoming a Nyingma monastery. Its changing affiliations reflect the long coexistence of Bon and Buddhist traditions in Kham, where religious foundations occupy the valleys and uplands among the eastern Tibetan ranges.
simp_chinese: 然哈寺位于藏地东部炉霍山地。它原为苯教寺院，后来归属藏传佛教萨迦派，再转为宁玛派寺院。寺院宗派的变迁反映出康区苯教与佛教传统的长期共存；在藏地东部群山之间，宗教建筑分布于河谷与高地。

english: Rashaan Khad is a rocky site in the Khentii country, near Binder Mountain. Its surfaces bear animal figures, human images and hundreds of clan marks, accompanied by inscriptions in scripts from several periods. Among them are Turkic, Khitan, Mongolian, Persian, Chinese and Tibetan writing. Stone tools and nearby burial sites reveal a much longer history of human presence, making the rock a meeting place of traces left by successive peoples of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 拉桑哈德是肯特山地中靠近宾德尔山的一处岩石遗址。岩面刻有动物、人物和数百个氏族印记，旁边还有不同时代的文字，包括突厥、契丹、蒙古、波斯、汉文和藏文。石器及附近墓葬显示这里的人类活动历史更为久远，使这块岩石汇集了草原上历代人群留下的痕迹。

english:
Raichur lies between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra, in the doab that took its name from the town. Its great stone fort, ringed by a double wall, dominates the surrounding black-soil country of cotton and millet. A long inscription records that the fort was built in 1294 under the Kakatiyas, and later rulers strengthened its walls and gates until it became one of the principal strongholds between the two rivers.

The Bahmani sultans and the kings of Vijayanagara fought repeatedly for Raichur and its neighbouring fort at Mudgal. In 1398 a Vijayanagara army advanced against both and was beaten by the Bahmani ruler Firuz Shah. The greatest battle came in 1520, when Krishnadevaraya besieged the fort, then held by Ismail Adil Shah of Bijapur. The sultan marched to relieve it but was defeated, and the fortress fell. Cannon and matchlocks were used by both sides, and Portuguese soldiers fought in the Vijayanagara ranks. Raichur then returned to Bijapur and later passed to the Mughals and the Nizam, but its walls remained a measure of power over the doab.
simp_chinese:
赖丘尔位于克里希纳河与东格珀德拉河之间，那片河间地正是以这座城镇命名的。它的大石堡有双重城墙，俯瞰周围种植棉花和小米的黑土地带。一方长铭文记载，此堡是1294年在卡卡提亚王朝治下建成的，后来的统治者不断加固城墙与城门，使它成为两河之间的主要要塞之一。

巴赫曼尼素丹与毗奢耶那伽罗国王反复争夺赖丘尔及其邻近的穆德加尔堡。1398年，毗奢耶那伽罗军队向两堡进军，被巴赫曼尼统治者菲鲁兹·沙阿击败。最大的一战发生在1520年，克里希纳德瓦拉亚围攻当时由比贾布尔的伊斯玛仪·阿迪勒沙占据的堡垒。素丹前来解围却战败，要塞陷落。双方都使用了火炮与火绳枪，葡萄牙士兵也在毗奢耶那伽罗军中作战。赖丘尔随后回到比贾布尔手中，后来又先后归于莫卧儿和尼扎姆，但它的城墙始终是衡量河间地权力的尺度。

english:
Raigarh lies in the eastern Chhattisgarh country, on the approaches between the Mahanadi basin and the forested hills to the north. It became the seat of a local state under a ruling family associated with the Gond chiefs of Chanda. The family’s traditions trace its founder Madan Singh to Bairagarh, from which he came to establish his authority in this country.

According to the district history, Madan Singh had been a subordinate of the ruler of Sambalpur before creating a separate Raigarh state. His successors maintained the local ruling house as neighbouring powers competed over the surrounding lands. The state belonged to a group of small principalities between Chhattisgarh and western Odisha, where political authority was organized around estates and fortified seats rather than a single large city.
simp_chinese:
赖加尔位于恰蒂斯加尔东部，地处默哈讷迪河流域与北方森林丘陵之间的通道。它成为地方邦国的驻地，统治家族与钱达地区的贡德首领有关。家族传统称，创建者马丹·辛格来自拜拉加尔，后来到此建立权力。

据地区历史记载，马丹·辛格原是森伯尔布尔统治者的属臣，后来建立独立的赖加尔邦。此后，邻近势力争夺周围土地，他的继承者则继续维持地方王室。赖加尔属于恰蒂斯加尔与奥里萨西部之间的一群小邦，当地政治权力围绕地产和设防驻地组织，而非集中于一座大城市。

english:
Raigarh, or Raigad, is a great hill fort above the Konkan, protected by steep cliffs and commanding approaches between the coast and the Western Ghats. Formerly called Rairi, it was taken by Shivaji in 1656 after his conquest of the Jawali country. The summit became the seat of his government, with palaces and other buildings laid out within the defences.

On 6 June 1674 Shivaji was crowned at Raigad, publicly proclaiming his independent sovereignty. The English representative Henry Oxinden attended the ceremonies and presented him with a diamond ring. Shivaji died at the fort in 1680, and it remained central to the Maratha kingdom during the struggles that followed. In 1689 Mughal forces captured Raigad during the reign of his son Rajaram. The Marathas recovered it in 1733. Its exposed heights and the remains of its royal buildings recall both the foundation of the kingdom and the wars that followed.
simp_chinese:
赖加尔即赖加德，是贡坎上方的大型山堡，陡峭崖壁为其提供保护，并俯瞰海岸与西高止山脉之间的通路。堡垒原名赖里，希瓦吉于1656年征服贾瓦利地区后夺取此地。山顶成为他的政务驻地，宫殿及其他建筑布置在防御工事之内。

1674年6月6日，希瓦吉在赖加德举行加冕礼，公开宣布独立君权。英国代表亨利·奥克森登参加庆典，向他献上一枚钻戒。1680年希瓦吉在堡内去世，此后在接连不断的争斗中，赖加德仍是马拉塔王国的中心。1689年，其子拉贾拉姆在位时莫卧儿军队攻占堡垒；1733年马拉塔人将其夺回。险峻高地与王室建筑遗迹共同见证了王国的建立及随后的战争。

english:
Raighar belongs to the inland uplands of southwestern Odisha, in a broad region where forests, cultivated valleys and local chiefly territories meet. Communities combined farming with the use of woodland resources, and their work followed the seasonal arrival of rain. Rice could be grown where water and soils permitted, while other crops and gathered products supported households in different environments. Paths and market gatherings connected villages whose languages and social traditions were often distinct.

Much of this upland lay within the domain of the Suryavanshi rulers of Jeypore.
simp_chinese:
赖加尔属于奥里萨西南内陆高地，森林、可耕河谷和地方首领领地在这里相接。居民把农耕与林地资源利用结合起来，劳动按照季节降雨安排。在水源和土壤适合的地方可以种稻，其他作物与采集产品则支持不同环境中的家庭。小径和定期集市连接语言、社会传统往往各有特点的村庄。

这一带大部分高地曾属于杰伊布尔的苏里亚万希统治者。

english: Raikot lies in the Malwa country of Punjab. It was founded in 1648 by the Manj Rajput Rai family, who also established nearby Jagraon. According to tradition, Rai Kalha gave shelter to Guru Gobind Singh in 1705 while Mughal forces pursued him after the battle of Chamkaur. In gratitude, the Guru gave the family a metal vessel called the Ganga Sagar and an inscribed sword.
simp_chinese: 赖果德位于旁遮普的马尔瓦地区，由曼杰拉杰普特人的赖家族于1648年建立；附近的贾格拉翁也是这个家族所建。相传1705年查姆考尔战役后，莫卧儿军队追捕古鲁戈宾德·辛格，赖·卡尔哈在此庇护了他。古鲁为表谢意，赠予该家族一只称作恒河萨加尔的金属容器和一柄刻有铭文的剑。

english:
Rainy Lake lies among the forests and rocky waters of the Canadian Shield. Its outlet becomes the Rainy River, which runs west to Lake of the Woods. The lake and its connecting waterways formed part of a much older Indigenous travel network, later used by traders travelling between Lake Superior and the northwest.

In 1688 the French trader Jacques de Noyon reached Rainy Lake and spent the winter there. French trading activity grew in the 1730s around Fort Saint Pierre near the lake’s outlet. The North West Company established a depot on the Rainy River in 1787, and later competed with the Hudson’s Bay Company until their merger in 1821. The posts relied on Indigenous suppliers, who provided food as well as furs to the traders.
simp_chinese:
雷尼湖坐落在加拿大地盾的森林与岩石水域之间，湖水从出口流入雷尼河，再向西注入林中之湖。湖泊及相连水道原是历史更早的原住民旅行网络的一部分，后来商人沿此往返于苏必利尔湖和西北内陆。

1688年，法国商人雅克·德·努瓦永抵达雷尼湖并在此过冬。十八世纪三十年代，湖口附近的圣皮埃尔堡成为法国贸易活动中心。西北公司于1787年在雷尼河设立货栈，后来与哈得孙湾公司竞争，直到两家公司于1821年合并。贸易站依靠原住民供应者提供毛皮与食物。

english:
Raipur was the capital of a branch of the Kalachuri kings in the Chhattisgarh plain. Its name is traditionally linked to Brahmadeva or his father Ramachandra, and the remains of an old fort recall its role as a royal seat. The kingdom formed part of the historical country of Dakshina Kosala, whose rulers held a network of fortified districts. Temples and inscriptions at Raipur, Rajim and Khallari preserve evidence of the dynasty’s patronage and authority.

In the fourteenth century the Kalachuri house divided, and a junior branch established a separate kingdom based at Raipur. Inscriptions at Raipur and Khallari record Brahmadeva’s rule in 1402 and 1414. The Hatkeshwar Mahadev temple on the Kharun River was built in his time by Hajiraj Naik, providing the growing town with a sacred place dedicated to Shiva. Maratha armies entered the region in 1741; Amar Singh Deo, the last Raipur ruler, was later displaced by the Bhonsles of Nagpur. After his death in 1753, the Marathas took the districts left to him.

British officials assumed administration after the Maratha defeat in 1818 and made Raipur their headquarters in Chhattisgarh. Authority returned to the Bhonsles in 1830. Across these changes the town remained a centre for the surrounding plain, linking the legacy of its Kalachuri kings to the successive governments that followed them.
simp_chinese:
赖普尔是恰蒂斯加尔平原上卡拉丘里王朝一支的都城。传统将城名与梵天德瓦或其父罗摩旃陀罗联系起来，旧堡遗迹也使人想起它作为王室驻地的地位。王国属于历史上的南拘萨罗地区，统治者掌管着一系列以堡垒为中心的辖区。赖普尔、罗什伐和哈尔拉里等地的寺庙与铭文，保存了王朝庇护活动及权威的证据。

十四世纪卡拉丘里王室分裂，较年轻的一支以赖普尔为中心建立独立王国。赖普尔和哈尔拉里的铭文记载梵天德瓦分别于1402年和1414年统治此地。卡伦河畔的哈特凯什瓦尔·摩诃提婆神庙由哈吉拉杰·奈克在他统治期间建造，为不断发展的城镇提供了一处供奉湿婆的圣地。1741年马拉塔军队进入该地区；赖普尔末代统治者阿马尔·辛格·德奥后来被那格浦尔的本斯勒家族推翻。他于1753年去世后，马拉塔人夺取了留给他的辖区。

马拉塔人于1818年战败后，英国官员接管行政，并将赖普尔设为恰蒂斯加尔的驻地。1830年权力又交还本斯勒家族。历经这些变化，城镇始终是周围平原的中心，将卡拉丘里国王的遗产与此后的历代政权联系起来。

english:
Raipur lies in the wooded country of western Bengal once known as Tungbhum, on the margins of the Malla kingdom of Bishnupur. Its estate became a focus of resistance to the East India Company at the end of the eighteenth century. Forests, cultivated land and mud forts formed the setting for a struggle in which local landholders and their followers contested the sale of estates.

In 1798 Durjan Singh, the dispossessed zamindar of Raipur, led a rising against the purchaser of his estate. His followers attacked the bazaar and revenue office, and a detachment of sepoys sent against them was driven back. Local landholders and other influential men withheld supplies and information from the troops and sometimes sheltered the rebels. The rising was part of the wider unrest in the Jungle Mahals during the early years of Company revenue rule.
simp_chinese:
赖普尔位于孟加拉西部林地，属于曾称通布姆的地区，在毗湿奴普尔马拉王国的边缘。十八世纪末，这里的领地成为抵抗东印度公司的中心。森林、耕地和土堡构成了斗争的背景，当地领主及其追随者反对领地被出售。

1798年，被剥夺赖普尔领地的扎明达尔杜尔詹·辛格领导起事，反对购买其地产的人。他的追随者袭击集市和税务官署，击退了前来镇压的一支印度兵部队。当地领主和其他有影响的人不向军队提供补给与情报，有时还为起事者提供藏身之处。这场抗争是公司征税统治初期丛林马哈尔广泛动乱的一部分。

english: Rairangpur lies in the Bamanghati country between the Gorumahisani and Budha Rana hills of northern Mayurbhanj. Under the Bhanja rulers the district was known as Bamanghati, a name recorded among the forts of the state in accounts from the Mughal period. Its valleys and wooded ridges belonged to the larger domain governed by the Bhanja house, whose centres lay farther south at Khiching and later Haripur.
simp_chinese: 赖朗布尔位于马尤尔班杰北部戈鲁马希萨尼山与布达拉纳山之间的巴芒加蒂地区。班贾统治时期，这片地方称为巴芒加蒂；莫卧儿时代的记载将其列为该邦的设防地点之一。这里的山谷与林木山脊属于班贾家族统治的广大领地，其中心更南面的基钦，后来迁至哈里普尔。

english: Raisa follows the Reisa River through a wooded valley to Reisafjord in northern Troms. The valley and its uplands formed part of a landscape used by Sámi herders moving reindeer between inland winter pastures and the coast. During the eighteenth century migrants from northern Finland and the Torne valley settled in Reisadalen, making it an important centre of Kven settlement. They brought woodland practices including the burning of tar, which became a commodity for trade.
simp_chinese: 赖萨沿赖萨河穿过森林山谷，通向特罗姆斯北部的赖萨峡湾。山谷及其高地是萨米牧民的活动地区，驯鹿在内陆冬季牧场与海岸之间迁徙。十八世纪，来自芬兰北部和托尔讷河谷的移民在赖萨河谷定居，使其成为克文人重要的聚居地。移民带来了森林经营技艺，包括烧制可供贸易的焦油。

english:
Raisin takes its name from a strong fort in eastern Malwa, a place of consequence in the history of the region. In the fifteenth century the fortress was held by the sultans of Mandu before passing to Rajput rulers. Babur mentioned it in his memoirs, and in 1543 Sher Shah Suri captured it from Puran Mal. Under Akbar, Raisin became the seat of a sarkar in the Mughal province of Malwa.

The fort remained under a Mughal commander into the eighteenth century. In 1756 Faiz Muhammad Khan of Bhopal occupied it and later obtained recognition from the emperor Alamgir II as its faujdar. The fortified hill thus passed into the hands of the rulers of Bhopal as Mughal authority in Malwa weakened.
simp_chinese:
赖辛得名于东摩腊婆的一座坚固堡垒，在当地历史上占有重要地位。十五世纪，堡垒由曼杜的苏丹掌握，后来转入拉杰普特统治者之手。巴布尔在回忆录中提到了这里；1543年，舍尔沙·苏里从普兰·马尔手中攻下堡垒。阿克巴统治时期，赖辛成为莫卧儿摩腊婆行省一个萨尔卡尔的驻地。

直到十八世纪，堡垒仍由莫卧儿军官掌管。1756年，博帕尔的费兹·穆罕默德汗占据这里，随后获得皇帝阿拉姆吉尔二世承认为赖辛的军政长官。随着莫卧儿在摩腊婆的权威衰落，这座山堡转入博帕尔统治者之手。

english: Raivavae is a volcanic island in the Austral group, where steep Mount Hiro rises above a lagoon and coral reef dotted with small islets. Stone ceremonial sites and carved figures recall the island’s Polynesian past. In 1775 a Spanish expedition under Tomás Gayangos encountered its inhabitants and charted the island as Santa Rosa.
simp_chinese: 赖瓦瓦埃是土布艾群岛中的火山岛，陡峭的希罗山高出潟湖及散布小岛的珊瑚礁。石造礼仪场所和雕像见证了岛屿的波利尼西亚历史。1775年，托马斯·加扬戈斯率领的西班牙探险队遇见当地居民，并在海图上将此岛标为圣罗莎。

english: A coral barrier surrounds the volcanic island of Raivavae in the Austral group. Its lagoon contains many low islets, or motu, set between the high land and the open sea. In 1775 the Spanish expedition of Tomás Gayangos encountered the islanders and charted their island as Santa Rosa.
simp_chinese: 珊瑚堡礁环绕着土布艾群岛中的赖瓦瓦埃火山岛。潟湖中散布着许多低矮的礁岛，位于高地与外海之间。1775年，托马斯·加扬戈斯率领的西班牙探险队遇见当地居民，将岛屿在海图上标作圣罗莎。

english: Raʻivavae is a volcanic island in the Austral group, its mountain slopes enclosed by a coral reef and lagoon. Polynesian communities had long inhabited it when Spanish navigators Gaiangos and Andía y Varela visited in 1775. Islanders told the visitors the name of their island.
simp_chinese: 赖瓦瓦埃是南方群岛的一座火山岛，山坡由珊瑚礁与潟湖环绕。1775年，西班牙航海家盖安戈斯和安迪亚·伊·瓦雷拉到访时，波利尼西亚社群已在这里生活很久。岛民告诉访客他们岛屿的名字。

english: Raivke lies west of Lake Topozero, a broad freshwater lake with more than a hundred islands. Its outlet, the Kovda, is known in its first stretch as the Sofyanga and runs toward Lake Pyaozero. The Kovda water system continues east to the White Sea, linking the lake country with the coast through a chain of northern waters.
simp_chinese: 赖夫克位于托波泽罗湖以西。这座宽阔的淡水湖中有一百多座岛屿。湖水经科夫达河流出，河流上段称索菲扬加，流向皮亚奥泽罗湖。科夫达水系继续向东通往白海，通过一连串北方水域将湖区与海岸连接起来。

english: Rajabar lies near the fort mound of Momal Ji Mari in northern Sindh, east of Ghotki. The surviving walls and bastions mark a fortified site thought to date from the Soomra period, between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries. Local tradition connects the mound with the story of Raja Dahir’s son and the Arab commander Muhammad bin Qasim.
simp_chinese: 拉贾巴尔位于信德北部，靠近戈特基以东的莫玛尔吉马里堡丘。残存城墙与棱堡属于一处设防遗址，据信可追溯至十一至十四世纪的苏姆拉时期。当地传说把堡丘与拉贾达希尔之子及阿拉伯将领穆罕默德·本·卡西姆的故事联系起来。

english:
Rajamahendry, also known as Rajamahendravaram, stands on the Godavari in coastal Andhra, overlooking a fertile delta. The city was a centre of political and literary life under the Eastern Chalukyas, and is associated with the Telugu poet Nannaya and his rendering of the Mahabharata.

In the late fourteenth century the Reddy rulers made Rajamahendravaram the capital of an eastern province. A branch of their dynasty later ruled there independently, until the Gajapatis took the kingdom in the mid-fifteenth century. Vijayanagara's Krishnadevaraya subsequently brought Rajahmundry under his authority. In 1769 Rajahmundry and Eluru came under the East India Company's chief and council at Machilipatnam.
simp_chinese:
拉贾马亨德里又称拉贾马亨德拉瓦拉姆，位于安得拉海岸的哥达瓦里河畔，邻近肥沃的三角洲。东遮娄其时期这里是政治和文学中心，也同泰卢固诗人南纳亚翻译《摩诃婆罗多》的传统有关。

14世纪末，雷迪统治者以此为东部省份的首府，王朝的一个分支后来在此独立统治，直至15世纪中叶被伽阇钵底王朝夺取。毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚随后将此地纳入其统治。1769年，拉贾马亨德里与埃卢鲁转由东印度公司驻马苏利帕坦的首席官及议事会管理。

english: Rajanari lies in the eastern Nepal Himalaya near the Barun valley. The Barun rises from the glacier beneath Makalu and flows east to join the Arun, part of the Kosi river system. Its valley descends from ice and high peaks through steep slopes towards warmer lower forests. The great height difference gives the Barun a striking range of landscapes over a short distance.
simp_chinese: 拉贾纳里位于尼泊尔东部喜马拉雅山区，靠近巴伦河谷。巴伦河发源于马卡鲁峰下的冰川，向东汇入阿伦河，属于戈西水系。河谷从冰雪高峰间下降，穿过陡坡，通向较温暖的低海拔森林；巨大的高度差使短短一段河谷呈现出多样景观。

english:
Rajapur is a Konkan port set inland on a creek leading to the Arabian Sea. Pepper and cardamom from the country under Bijapur drew foreign merchants to its market. The English East India Company maintained a trading house here, buying spices alongside cotton goods and saltpetre. French merchants also established a factory at Rajapur in 1670.

The port’s trade was disrupted by the wars of Shivaji. The English at Rajapur became entangled in the conflict after men from their factory assisted the Bijapur forces besieging him at Panhala in 1660. Shivaji subsequently plundered the factory and detained its personnel. Although the English later resumed trade, repeated disputes and demands made the establishment difficult to maintain. Its troubled history shows how closely coastal commerce depended on the changing relations between European merchants and Maratha power.
simp_chinese:
拉贾普尔是贡坎地区的港口，位于通向阿拉伯海的一条内陆水道上。比贾布尔领地出产的胡椒和小豆蔻吸引外国商人来到当地市场。英国东印度公司在此设立商馆，采购香料、棉布和硝石；法国商人也于1670年在拉贾普尔建立商馆。

希瓦吉的战争打断了港口贸易。1660年，拉贾普尔商馆的英国人协助比贾布尔军队在潘哈拉围困希瓦吉，因而卷入冲突。希瓦吉随后劫掠商馆并拘留其人员。英国人后来虽恢复贸易，反复发生的争端与索求仍使商馆难以维持。这段动荡的经历显示，海岸商业与欧洲商人同马拉塔势力之间不断变化的关系密切相关。

english: Rajgir lies among the hills of old Magadha, the site of ancient Rajagriha, a royal capital associated with both the Buddha and Mahavira. Walls once protected the city among the surrounding heights, and Buddhist tradition recalls the Bamboo Grove given to the Buddha by King Bimbisara. On Vulture’s Peak the Buddha is said to have taught his followers. At the foot of Vaibhara hill, hot springs known as the Saptadhara have long added to the sanctity of the place.
simp_chinese: 拉杰吉尔坐落在古摩揭陀的群山之间，古代王都王舍城便位于此地。佛陀与大雄都曾与这座城市相关。城墙曾沿周围高地保卫王城；佛教传统还记载，频婆娑罗王将竹林赠予佛陀。相传佛陀在灵鹫山向弟子说法，而毗婆罗山麓名为七泉的温泉也使此地更具圣洁之名。

english:
Rajim stands at the meeting of the Mahanadi, Pairi and Sondur rivers, a confluence revered as the Prayag of Chhattisgarh. Its most celebrated shrine is the Rajiv Lochan temple, dedicated to Vishnu, whose image stands within a richly carved sanctuary. At the confluence itself is the temple of Kuleshwar Mahadev, raised on a high platform above the waters. The temples and inscriptions make Rajim an enduring religious centre of Dakshina Kosala.

A stone inscription in the Rajiv Lochan temple records the building of a Rama shrine and the gift of a village for its worship by Jagapala, a subordinate of the Kalachuri kings. The inscription also preserves details of his service under successive rulers of Ratanpur. In the eighteenth century Rajim was among the districts retained for the maintenance of Amar Singh Deo, the last Kalachuri ruler of Raipur. After his death in 1753, the Marathas took possession of them.
simp_chinese:
罗什伐位于摩诃那迪河、拜里河和松杜尔河的汇流处，这片河口被尊为恰蒂斯加尔的普拉耶格。最著名的神祠是供奉毗湿奴的罗吉夫·洛昌神庙，神像坐落在雕饰精美的殿内。汇流处还有库莱什瓦尔·摩诃提婆神庙，建在高出水面的台基上。寺庙和铭文使罗什伐成为南拘萨罗持久的宗教中心。

罗吉夫·洛昌神庙中的石刻记载，卡拉丘里国王的属臣贾加帕拉建造了一座罗摩神庙，并捐赠村庄供奉神灵。铭文还保存了他侍奉拉特纳普尔历代统治者的事迹。十八世纪，罗什伐是留给赖布尔末代卡拉丘里统治者阿马尔·辛格·德奥维持生计的辖区之一。他于1753年去世后，马拉塔人占领了这些地区。

english:
Rajmahal stands where the Ganges runs beside the Rajmahal Hills, at a narrow approach between Bihar and Bengal. The river and the nearby Teliagarhi pass gave the town strategic command of traffic entering the delta. As Akbarnagar it became a Mughal provincial capital, with a palace, mosque and mint marking its importance.

In 1576 Mughal forces defeated the Afghan ruler Daud Khan Karrani near Rajmahal. Two decades later the governor Man Singh chose the site for a new Bengal capital and named it Akbarnagar in honour of Akbar. Its position on the Ganges allowed the administration to watch both river traffic and the road through the hills. The capital later moved to Dhaka, but Shah Shuja restored it to Rajmahal in 1639. Shuja built a palace and strengthened the city’s defences. The Ganges, however, was a shifting neighbour: a change in its course damaged the newly built palace. During the Mughal succession war, Shuja retreated through the region before fleeing east. The provincial capital moved back to Dhaka in 1660, leaving Rajmahal’s buildings as reminders of its years at the centre of Bengal’s government.
simp_chinese:
拉吉马哈尔位于恒河沿拉吉马哈尔丘陵流过的地方，扼守比哈尔与孟加拉之间狭窄的进路。大河和附近的泰利亚加尔希隘口使它得以控制进入三角洲的交通。这里以阿克巴纳加尔之名成为莫卧儿行省首府，宫殿、清真寺和铸币厂体现了城市的重要地位。

1576年，莫卧儿军队在拉吉马哈尔附近击败阿富汗统治者达乌德汗·卡拉尼。约二十年后，总督曼·辛格选择此地作为孟加拉新首府，为纪念阿克巴将其命名为阿克巴纳加尔。恒河上的位置使当局既能监视水上交通，也能控制穿越丘陵的道路。首府后来迁至达卡，1639年沙阿·舒贾又将其迁回拉吉马哈尔。舒贾修建宫殿并加强城市防御。然而恒河的河道不断变化，改道损坏了新建的宫殿。莫卧儿继承战争期间，舒贾经这一地区撤退，随后逃往东方。1660年行省首府迁回达卡，拉吉马哈尔的建筑留下它曾处于孟加拉政务中心的记忆。

english: Rajnagar lies in the lowlands of the Sylhet region, among rivers and seasonal wetlands. At nearby Paschimbhag a copperplate records a grant by the Chandra ruler Srichandra in the tenth century. Known as the Chandrapur charter, it describes land given to religious and scholarly institutions and provides evidence for a centre of learning in the region. The inscription links this landscape to the political and religious networks of early Bengal.
simp_chinese: 拉杰纳加尔位于锡尔赫特地区低地，河流与季节性湿地遍布其间。附近帕希姆巴格发现的一块铜板，记载了十世纪钱德拉王朝统治者什里钱德拉的一项捐赠。这份称为钱德拉布尔敕书的铭文描述了赐予宗教和学术机构的土地，为当地曾有学术中心提供了证据，也将这片土地与早期孟加拉的政治和宗教网络联系起来。

english:
Rajouri lies among the mountains southwest of Kashmir, on an approach to the valley. Known as Rajapuri in Kalhana's twelfth-century chronicle, the Rajatarangini, it was ruled by a line of Jarral Rajput rajas. In the fifteenth century the campaigns of Malik Tazi Bhat brought Rajouri under the suzerainty of the Kashmir Sultanate. Its rulers retained limited autonomy in return for tribute and military support.

After Akbar annexed Kashmir in 1586, the Jarral rulers came to an agreement with the Mughal Empire and received the title of Mirza. Rajouri resisted Ranjit Singh's attempts to conquer it in 1810 and 1812, but the following year Gulab Singh captured the town for the Sikh ruler, defeating Raja Aghar Khan. Parts of the territory were granted as jagirs, including one to the defeated raja's brother Rahimullah Khan.
simp_chinese:
拉久里坐落在克什米尔西南的群山中，扼守通向谷地的道路。在迦尔汉十二世纪的编年史《王统河》中，这里被称为罗阇布里；统治此地的是贾拉尔拉杰普特王公。十五世纪，马利克·塔齐·巴特的征战使拉久里承认克什米尔苏丹国的宗主权。当地统治者保留有限的自治，但须提供贡赋和军事支持。

1586年阿克巴吞并克什米尔后，贾拉尔统治者与莫卧儿帝国达成协议，获授米尔扎称号。拉久里在1810年和1812年抵御了兰吉特·辛格的进攻，但翌年古拉布·辛格为这位锡克君主攻占城镇，击败阿加尔汗王。部分领土被划为采邑，其中一份赐给了败王之弟拉希穆拉汗。

english: Rakahanga is a small atoll of about four square kilometres in the northern Cook Islands, lying 44 kilometres from its neighbour Manihiki. According to oral tradition, the first settlers, the Rarotongan exile Toa and his wife Tapairu, came to the atoll around 1350 and settled on the motu of Te Kainga near the south-western lagoon entrance. The Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernández de Quirós came upon the island on 2 March 1606.
simp_chinese: 拉卡汉加是库克群岛北部一座面积约四平方公里的小环礁，距邻岛马尼希基四十四公里。据口述传统，最早的定居者是来自拉罗汤加的流亡者图阿与妻子塔派鲁，他们约在1350年前后来到此地，定居于特卡因加小岛，靠近潟湖西南入口。1606年3月2日，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯率领的西班牙远征队遇见了这座岛。

english: Rakahanga lies close to Manihiki in the northern Cook Islands. Te Kainga, beside a passage into Rakahanga's lagoon, is remembered as an early settlement; the community also voyaged between the two atolls as resources were used up. In 1606 Pedro Fernández de Quirós's expedition encountered a populous, coconut-covered island generally identified as Rakahanga.
simp_chinese: 拉卡汉加位于库克群岛北部，靠近马尼希基。潟湖入口旁的特凯恩加被记为早期聚居地；资源逐渐耗尽时，居民也会在两座环礁之间航行迁居。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的探险队遇到一座人口众多、遍布椰树的小岛，通常认为就是拉卡汉加。

english: The Rakaia River runs east from the Southern Alps across the Canterbury Plains to the Pacific Ocean. Its braided channels spread across a wide gravel bed. The river and its upper valleys form part of a network of South Island routes used by Māori travelling between the plains, mountains and western sources of pounamu.
simp_chinese: 拉凯亚河从南阿尔卑斯山向东流过坎特伯雷平原，注入太平洋。辫状河道在宽阔砾石河床上展开。河流及上游山谷属于南岛道路网络的一部分，毛利人经由这些道路往来于平原、山地和西部绿玉产地。

english:
Rakaŭ stands on the Islach River west of Minsk, in the lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The settlement appears in fifteenth-century chronicles, and a castle was built on an older fortified site. In 1465 Casimir Jagiellon gave Rakaŭ to the Lithuanian chancellor Mykolas Kęsgaila; it later passed through the Zawisza and Sanguszko families.

The Sanguszkos endowed two religious houses here: Konstancja Teodora founded a Dominican monastery in 1686, and Kazimierz founded a Basilian Uniate monastery in 1702. Rakaŭ came under Russian rule in the second partition of the Commonwealth in 1793. Catherine II confiscated it from the Sanguszkos the following year and granted it to General Saltykov, who sold it to Wawrzyniec Zdziechowski in 1804. The two monasteries were closed by the Russian authorities in the 1830s.
simp_chinese:
拉考位于明斯克以西的伊斯拉奇河畔。聚落见于15世纪的编年史，一座城堡后来建在更古老的设防遗址上。1465年，卡齐米日·雅盖隆将拉考赠予立陶宛大臣米科拉斯·肯斯盖拉；此地后来先后归扎维沙和桑古什科家族所有。

桑古什科家族在此资助了两座修道院：康斯坦察·特奥多拉于1686年建立多明我会修道院，卡齐米日则于1702年建立巴西利安联合教会修道院。1793年联邦第二次被瓜分后，拉考归入俄罗斯。次年叶卡捷琳娜二世没收桑古什科家族的产业，将其赐给萨尔蒂科夫将军；后者于1804年将其出售给瓦夫日涅茨·兹杰霍夫斯基。1830年代，俄国当局关闭了两座修道院。

english: Rakhiv lies in the upper Tisza valley, enclosed by the high ridges of the Eastern Carpathians. The town's history is rooted in the mountain country of Máramaros, where the valleys of the Black and White Tisza come together. Its foundation is traditionally dated to 1447, when the region formed part of the Hungarian kingdom. Forested slopes and narrow valleys shaped the settlements and routes of this upland district.
simp_chinese: 拉希夫位于蒂萨河上游河谷，四周环绕东喀尔巴阡山的高峻山脊。城镇的历史植根于马劳毛罗什山地，黑蒂萨河与白蒂萨河的河谷在这一带汇合。当地传统将建城年代定为1447年，当时此地属于匈牙利王国。林木覆盖的山坡和狭窄河谷塑造了这一高地地区的聚落与道路。

english: Rakhyah lies in the western Hadramawt country, where a long wadi winds between rocky highlands. Villages and cultivated plots follow the valley, and mountain passes connect it with Dawan and Shabwa. Ancient stone tombs and the remains of irrigation works at Bir Hamad testify to settlement in the area long before the Islamic centuries. Defensive buildings such as Qarn Muwašša stand on heights above the valley, overlooking routes through this rugged part of southern Arabia.
simp_chinese: 拉希亚位于哈德拉毛西部，一条长谷在多岩的高地之间蜿蜒。村落与耕地沿谷分布，山口将它与达万和沙布瓦连接。古石墓与比尔哈马德的灌溉遗迹表明，早在伊斯兰时代之前这里就有人居住。卡尔恩穆瓦沙等防御建筑立于谷地上方，俯瞰南阿拉伯这片崎岖地区的通道。

english: Rakitnoye takes its name from the Rakitna, a small river in the forest-steppe west of Belgorod. In 1652 Russian officials surveying the frontier chose its high bank for a watch fort between the fortified towns of Karpov and Khotmyzhsk. Service men settled at the outpost, followed by Ukrainian and Russian migrants, and the sloboda of Rakitnaya grew under its protection. In the eighteenth century the estate passed through the hands of prominent nobles, including Alexander Menshikov and the Yusupov family.
simp_chinese: 拉基特诺耶得名于拉基特纳河，这条小河流经别尔哥罗德以西的森林草原。1652年，勘察边疆的俄罗斯官员选中河流高岸，在卡尔波夫与霍特梅日斯克两座设防城镇之间设置守望堡。服役人员在前哨定居，随后乌克兰和俄罗斯移民来到这里，在堡垒保护下形成拉基特纳亚斯洛博达。十八世纪，庄园先后属于亚历山大·缅希科夫和尤苏波夫家族等显贵。

english: Rakitnya lies in the forest country south of Firovo, near the watershed of the Valdai Hills. To the west, the many reaches and islands of Lake Seliger formed part of a water route between the upper Volga and the Novgorod lands. A portage near the old fortified settlement of Berezovets linked the lake to rivers flowing toward Lake Ilmen. Woods and small lakes separate this rural district from the more heavily travelled shores of Seliger.
simp_chinese: 拉基特尼亚位于菲罗沃以南的森林地带，靠近瓦尔代丘陵的分水岭。西面的谢利格尔湖由众多湖湾和岛屿组成，是伏尔加河上游与诺夫哥罗德土地之间水路的一部分。古老的别列佐韦茨设防聚落附近有一条拖船路，把湖泊与流向伊尔门湖的河流相连。森林和小湖将这片乡村与交通更繁忙的谢利格尔湖岸分隔开来。

english: Rakiura lies across Foveaux Strait from the southern tip of New Zealand's South Island. Its forested shores and surrounding waters form part of the southern Māori world. Sealers arrived in the region in the 1790s, followed by whalers, whose coastal stations brought them into contact with Māori communities around the strait.
simp_chinese: 拉基乌拉隔福沃海峡与新西兰南岛南端相望。森林覆盖的海岸与周围水域属于南部毛利世界。捕海豹者于十八世纪九十年代抵达该地区，随后捕鲸者前来，其沿岸据点使他们与海峡周围的毛利社群接触。

english: Rakni lies in the hill country of Barkhan, west of the Punjab plains. The surrounding Khetran country was once a district of Sewistan and of the province of Thatta; in Akbar's reign it was known as Janjah. Local tradition connects the name Barkhan with Baro Khan, a leader of the Panni people who came to the valley with his followers.
simp_chinese: 拉克尼位于旁遮普平原以西的巴尔汗山地。周围的赫特兰地区曾是塞维斯坦和塔塔省的一个辖区，阿克巴统治时期称作詹贾。当地传说将巴尔汗之名与帕尼人的首领巴罗汗联系起来；他曾带领族人来到这片河谷。

english: Rakovník lies in the uplands west of Prague, on the stream that bears its name. First recorded in 1252, it was then a market village in the district administered from Křivoklát Castle. The town grew rapidly in the later sixteenth century: walls and gates were built, a church and cemetery established, and its beer gained a reputation throughout Bohemia. The Thirty Years' War, plague and floods in the seventeenth century brought heavy losses and depopulation.
simp_chinese: 拉科夫尼克位于布拉格以西高地的同名溪流畔。1252年它首次见于记载，当时是克日沃克拉特城堡管辖地区的一座集镇。十六世纪后半叶，城镇迅速发展：人们修建城墙与城门，建立教堂和墓地，当地啤酒也闻名波希米亚全境。十七世纪的三十年战争、瘟疫与洪水带来严重损失，居民大量减少。

english: Rakvere, historically also called Wesenberg, lies in northern Estonia. Denmark granted the town Lübeck rights in 1302. After Danish Estonia was sold to the Livonian Order in 1346, a stone castle rose on the fortified hill. A Franciscan monastery was established in the early sixteenth century. During the Livonian War Russian forces took the town in 1558, and a Swedish siege in 1574 left it badly damaged. Sweden captured Rakvere in 1581; warfare between Sweden and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth subsequently brought further destruction, including the castle's ruin in 1605. Its history reflects the importance and vulnerability of a fortified town amid competing Baltic powers.
simp_chinese: 拉克韦雷位于爱沙尼亚北部，历史上也称韦森贝格。1302年丹麦国王授予其吕贝克法城市权利。1346年丹麦将爱沙尼亚领地售予利沃尼亚骑士团后，设防山丘上建起了石城堡。十六世纪初，当地又建立方济各会修道院。利沃尼亚战争期间，俄军于1558年占领城镇，1574年瑞典军围攻使其严重受损。瑞典于1581年攻占拉克韦雷；此后瑞典与波兰立陶宛联邦的战争再度带来破坏，城堡于1605年毁坏。这座设防城镇的经历体现了波罗的海诸势力竞争下的战略价值与脆弱处境。

english: Rala Kharmar stands in the upper Indus country of western Tibet, near the meeting of the river's headstreams. A Tibetan tradition associates its fortress with Nyima Gön, a ruler of western Tibet in the tenth century. In autumn 1679 the forces of Ladakh and the Lhasa government met near Rala. The Ladakhis were defeated and fell back towards their frontier, while others took shelter in the strongholds of Purang, Tsaparang and Tashigang.
simp_chinese: 热拉卡玛位于西藏西部印度河上游，靠近江河源流汇合处。藏地传说将这里的堡垒与十世纪西藏西部统治者尼玛衮联系起来。1679年秋，拉达克军队与拉萨政府军在热拉附近交战，拉达克人战败后退向边地，另有部队进入布让、札布让与扎西岗的堡垒避守。

sources.title: 1977 Kingdom of Ladakh c 950-1842 AD by Petech s.pdf

english: Raleigh Bay curves between Cape Hatteras and Cape Lookout along the North Carolina coast. Its shore is formed by barrier islands, including Ocracoke, with the waters of Pamlico Sound behind them. Though called a bay, it faces the open Atlantic and gives vessels little shelter from the ocean swell. Inlets between the sandy islands provide passages to the protected sound, their channels shaped by tides, currents and storms.
simp_chinese: 罗利湾沿北卡罗来纳海岸弯曲，位于哈特拉斯角与卢考特角之间。岸边由屏障岛组成，其中包括奥克拉科克岛，岛后是帕姆利科湾的水域。这里虽然称为海湾，却面向开阔的大西洋，难以为船只遮挡涌浪。沙岛之间的海口通向较受保护的内湾，航道不断受到潮汐、水流与风暴的影响。

english: South of the western Marshall Islands, open Pacific water extends beyond their scattered coral atolls. Marshallese communities navigated between these islands before European ships arrived. In 1792 Henry Bond sighted Namu, one of the western atolls, and saw inhabitants on its shore.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔群岛西部以南的开阔太平洋水域延伸至零散珊瑚环礁之外。欧洲船只到来之前，马绍尔社群已在这些岛屿间航行。1792年，亨利·邦德望见西部环礁之一纳穆，在岸上看见居民。

english: Northwest of Bikini, the open Pacific lies beyond the northern end of the Ralik chain. Bikini's low islands surround a broad central lagoon, with Eneu among the larger islets. Otto von Kotzebue named the atoll for his ship's naturalist Johann Friedrich von Eschscholtz during his nineteenth-century exploration of the Marshall Islands.
simp_chinese: 比基尼西北方的开阔太平洋位于拉利克岛链北端之外。比基尼的低矮岛屿围绕宽阔的中央潟湖，埃内乌是较大的岛屿之一。奥托·冯·科策布19世纪探索马绍尔群岛时，以船上博物学家约翰·弗里德里希·冯·埃施朔尔茨的名字为环礁命名。

english: South of Enewetak, open water surrounds the western Marshall Islands. Marshallese communities travelled among the atolls long before European contact. In 1794 Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak from the ship Walpole while sailing toward China. Its coral islets surround a broad lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克以南的开阔水域环绕马绍尔群岛西部。与欧洲人接触之前，马绍尔社群早已在环礁间航行。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒乘“沃波尔”号驶往中国时望见埃内韦塔克。珊瑚小岛环抱着宽阔的潟湖。

english: Southeast of Enewetak, the Pacific stretches between low coral atolls of the western Marshall chain. Marshallese navigators knew these islands before European ships arrived. In 1794 Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak aboard the Walpole on his voyage toward China. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克东南方的太平洋延伸在马绍尔西部岛链的低矮珊瑚环礁之间。欧洲船只到来之前，马绍尔航海者已熟悉这些岛屿。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒乘“沃波尔”号驶往中国时望见埃内韦塔克。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: West of Namu, open Pacific water separates the western Marshall atolls from distant islands. In 1792 Captain Henry Bond sighted Namu from the Royal Admiral and saw people ashore. Marshallese communities already travelled and maintained ties among the atolls. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 纳穆以西的开阔太平洋水域将马绍尔西部环礁与遥远岛屿隔开。1792年，亨利·邦德船长在“皇家海军上将”号上望见纳穆，看见岸上的人。马绍尔社群此前已在环礁间航行并维持联系。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: Northwest of Namu, the Pacific extends among the low coral atolls of the western Marshall chain. Captain Henry Bond sighted Namu in 1792 during a voyage toward China. Its inhabitants were part of a Marshallese island world connected by canoe travel.
simp_chinese: 纳穆西北方，太平洋延伸在马绍尔西部岛链低矮珊瑚环礁之间。1792年，亨利·邦德船长驶往中国时望见纳穆。当地居民属于通过独木舟航行相连的马绍尔岛屿世界。

english: Southwest of Namu, open ocean lies beyond the western Marshall Islands. Marshallese communities had long maintained ties across these waters. In 1792 Captain Henry Bond sighted Namu from the Royal Admiral and recorded people on its low coral shore. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 纳穆西南方的开阔大洋位于马绍尔群岛西部之外。马绍尔社群长期跨越这些水域维持联系。1792年，亨利·邦德船长在“皇家海军上将”号上望见纳穆，记下低矮珊瑚海岸上的居民。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: South of the Marshall Islands, the Pacific stretches beyond the low atolls of the western chain. Marshallese communities travelled among these islands before European contact. In 1792 Henry Bond sighted Namu and other western atolls during his voyage from Port Jackson toward China.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔群岛以南，太平洋延伸至西部岛链低矮环礁之外。与欧洲人接触之前，马绍尔社群已在这些岛屿间航行。1792年，亨利·邦德从杰克逊港驶往中国途中望见纳穆等西部环礁。

english: North of Rongelap, open water extends beyond the northern Marshall atolls. In 1825 Otto von Kotzebue’s expedition examined Rongelap and neighbouring atolls, naming them the Rimsky-Korsakov Islands. Marshallese people already knew these low islands and their surrounding waters. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 朗格拉普以北的开阔水域延伸至马绍尔北部环礁之外。1825年，奥托·冯·科策布的船队考察朗格拉普和邻近环礁，将它们命名为里姆斯基-科萨科夫群岛。马绍尔人早已熟悉这些低岛和周围水域。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: Northeast of Rongelap, the Pacific separates the western Marshall atolls from the northern islands of the eastern chain. In 1825 Otto von Kotzebue examined Rongelap and neighbouring atolls. Their Marshallese inhabitants had established connections across the archipelago before European contact. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 朗格拉普东北方，太平洋将马绍尔西部环礁与东部岛链北端岛屿隔开。1825年，奥托·冯·科策布考察朗格拉普和邻近环礁。与欧洲人接触之前，马绍尔居民已在群岛之间建立联系。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: Southwest of Enewetak, open Pacific water extends beyond the western Marshall Islands. Marshallese navigators had long known this remote island world when Captain Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak in 1794. His ship Walpole was sailing from Australia toward China. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克西南方的开阔太平洋水域延伸至马绍尔群岛西部之外。1794年托马斯·巴特勒船长望见埃内韦塔克时，马绍尔航海者早已熟悉这一偏远岛屿世界。他的“沃波尔”号当时正从澳大利亚驶往中国。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: West of Enewetak, the open Pacific surrounds remote coral atolls of the western Marshall chain. In 1794 Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak while sailing the Walpole toward China. Marshallese islanders had earlier crossed the ocean between these low-lying landfalls. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克以西的开阔太平洋环绕马绍尔西部岛链偏远的珊瑚环礁。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒乘“沃波尔”号驶往中国时望见埃内韦塔克。马绍尔岛民早已横渡这些低矮陆地之间的海洋。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: Northwest of Enewetak, open water extends beyond the western Marshall Islands into the Pacific. Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak in 1794 while commanding the ship Walpole. Marshallese voyagers had already made these remote atolls part of an inhabited island world. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克西北方的开阔水域延伸至马绍尔群岛西部之外的太平洋。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒指挥“沃波尔”号时望见埃内韦塔克。马绍尔航海者此前已将这些偏远环礁纳入有人居住的岛屿世界。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: North of Enewetak, open ocean surrounds the low western Marshall atolls. In 1794 Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak during a voyage toward China aboard the Walpole. Marshallese people had long inhabited and navigated the surrounding island chain before his arrival. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克以北的开阔大洋环绕马绍尔西部低矮环礁。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒乘“沃波尔”号驶往中国途中望见埃内韦塔克。他到来之前，马绍尔人长期在周围岛链生活和航行。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english: East of Enewetak, the Pacific stretches between widely separated western Marshall atolls. Thomas Butler sighted Enewetak in 1794 from the ship Walpole. Marshallese communities had long inhabited these islands and maintained connections across the ocean before his voyage. Its coral islets surround a lagoon.
simp_chinese: 埃内韦塔克以东，太平洋延伸在相距遥远的马绍尔西部环礁之间。1794年，托马斯·巴特勒从“沃波尔”号上望见埃内韦塔克。在他的航行之前，马绍尔社群早已在岛上生活并跨海维持联系。珊瑚小岛环抱着潟湖。

english:
Ralung belongs to the central Tibetan highlands near the Nyang and Tsang world, where a religious center stands within a wider landscape of cultivation and pasture. Valleys provide limited fields and settlement, while uplands support herds and seasonal movement. Routes connect communities with neighboring districts, carrying food, materials, pilgrims, and teachings. The practical life of a monastery depends on these surrounding households and resource relationships.

Founded in 1180 by Tsangpa Gyare, Ralung became a traditional seat of the Drukpa Kagyu Buddhist lineage. Religious leadership, teaching and patronage connected the monastery with communities beyond its valley. In 1616 its abbot Ngawang Namgyal left Tibet for Bhutan after a dispute over religious succession and conflict with the ruler of Tsang. He subsequently became a major figure in Bhutan's religious and political history. The monastery's influence thus extended across the Himalayas, even as its daily life depended on surrounding communities and resources.
simp_chinese:
热龙属于西藏中部高地年楚、后藏附近，宗教中心处在耕作牧场景观中。谷地提供有限田地聚落，高地支持畜群季节移动。路线联系邻区，运送食物材料、朝圣者及教法。寺院实际生活依靠周围家庭资源关系。

藏巴嘉热于1180年创建热龙寺，寺院后来成为竹巴噶举传统的祖庭。宗教领袖、教法传承与供养，把寺院同本谷以外的社群联系起来。1616年，寺主阿旺南杰因转世继承争议以及与藏巴统治者的冲突离开西藏，前往不丹；他后来成为不丹宗教与政治历史的重要人物。寺院影响因此跨越喜马拉雅山，而其日常生活仍有赖于周围社群与资源。

english: The Rama are an indigenous people of southeastern Nicaragua, whose lands extend from the Bluefields lagoon toward the Punta Gorda River. Their language belongs to the Chibchan family. River channels, forest and coastal lagoons form the landscape of their communities. Tradition relates that the Rama were granted an island in the Bluefields lagoon after helping the Miskito in a conflict; it became known as Rama Cay.
simp_chinese: 拉马人是尼加拉瓜东南部的原住民族，其土地从布卢菲尔兹泻湖延伸至蓬塔戈尔达河一带。他们的语言属于奇布查语系，河道、森林与海岸泻湖构成了社区的环境。传统记载，拉马人在一场冲突中帮助米斯基托人后，获得布卢菲尔兹泻湖中的一座岛屿，后来称为拉马岛。

english:
Ramagiri Fort occupies a wooded hill above the country near the Godavari and Manair rivers. Its walls, gateways and water reservoirs made the height a defensible centre in northern Telangana. The fort is associated with the Kakatiya rulers of Warangal and with the chiefs who succeeded them after their kingdom fell.

In the fourteenth century Musunuri Kapaya Nayaka appointed Muppa Bhupala to govern Sabbinadu from Ramagiri. The Bahmani sultan Ahmad Shah I invaded Telangana and took the fort in 1433. It later passed through the hands of the Qutb Shahi sultans, the Mughals and the Asaf Jahi rulers of Hyderabad. These successive occupations left their mark on a stronghold whose hilltop position long made it valuable to those governing the surrounding country.
simp_chinese:
拉马吉里堡占据一座林木覆盖的山丘，俯瞰戈达瓦里河与马奈尔河附近地区。城墙、门楼和蓄水设施使这处高地成为特伦甘纳北部易守的中心。堡垒与瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚统治者，以及其王国覆灭后继起的首领有关。

十四世纪，穆苏努里·卡帕亚·纳亚克任命穆帕·布帕拉从拉马吉里治理萨比纳杜。1433年，巴赫曼尼苏丹艾哈迈德沙阿一世入侵特伦甘纳并夺取堡垒。此后它先后归库特布沙阿苏丹、莫卧儿人和海得拉巴阿萨夫·贾希统治者掌管。历代驻守者在要塞留下痕迹；山顶位置长期使它对治理周围地区的人十分重要。

english: Ramah lies near the sands of Nafud al-Urayq in the interior of Najd. Sand and gravel plains surround scattered granite and basalt hills. In the northern sands, white saxaul is a characteristic shrub; farther south, acacias grow on hillocks and in shallow hollows. After sufficient rain, grasses and other short-lived plants flourish across the dry ground.
simp_chinese: 拉马靠近内志内陆的乌赖格沙地。沙砾平原间散布着花岗岩和玄武岩丘陵；北部沙地常见白梭梭，南面的土丘和浅洼地则生长着金合欢。雨水充足时，草类和其他短生植物会在干燥地面上繁盛起来。

english: Ramechhap lies in the hill country of eastern Nepal, in the region known as Wallo Kirat. Local stories offer several explanations for its name. One tells of a Tamang village leader named Ram, whose seal or chhap authorised transactions concerning the land; another traces the name to words for the animals and young livestock kept in a meadow. The hills and valleys connect the settlement with the wider Kosi basin.
simp_chinese: 拉梅查普位于尼泊尔东部丘陵，属于称为瓦洛基拉特的地区。当地流传着几种关于地名的解释：一种讲述塔芒村长拉姆使用印记，即“恰普”，为土地事务作证；另一种则将地名追溯到草场上饲养的牲畜及幼崽的名称。山岭与河谷将这里同更广阔的戈西河流域相连。

english: Ramenki lay in the Kamensky district of Bezhetsky Verkh, on the road between Tver and Bezhetsk. A charter of Ivan IV in 1551 confirmed the Trinity-Sergius Monastery's rights to the village. The name is connected with a word for dense woodland adjoining fields. The settlement suffered during the disturbances of the early seventeenth century; the depopulated village was inhabited again by 1646. In 1781 the place, later called Rameshki, had 107 inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 拉缅基位于别热茨基韦尔赫的卡缅斯基辖区，在特维尔与别热茨克之间的道路上。1551年，伊凡四世的敕书确认了三一圣谢尔吉修道院对村庄的权利。村名与田地旁茂密林木的称呼有关。十七世纪初的动乱使聚落受到破坏；到1646年，荒废的村庄重新有人居住。1781年，这个后来称为拉梅什基的地方有107名居民。

english: Rameshk lies in the rugged country south of the Jaz Murian basin, at the western edge of Makran. Streams descend from the surrounding highlands, and the Rameshk River carries water through the dry landscape. Irrigation channels and springs sustain patches of cultivation in valleys otherwise hemmed in by barren hills. The wider country around Qaleh Ganj has long been associated with date growing, a livelihood suited to the hot lowlands beyond the mountain slopes.
simp_chinese: 拉梅什克位于贾兹穆里安盆地以南的崎岖地带，处在马克兰西缘。溪流从周围高地流下，拉梅什克河穿行于干旱的山地之间。泉水与灌溉渠道在荒山包围的谷地里维持一片片耕地。附近的盖莱甘杰地区长期种植椰枣，这种作物适合山坡之外炎热的低地。

english:
Ramesvaram stands on an island between the Indian mainland and Sri Lanka, beside the shallow chain of shoals known as Rama’s Bridge. Its Ramanathaswamy temple is one of the great pilgrimage places of Hindu India. Tradition holds that Rama worshipped Shiva here after his journey to Lanka, linking the shrine with the story of the Ramayana. Pilgrims visit the temple and its sacred waters before crossing the island’s sandy shores.

The temple grew through the patronage of rulers and donors over many centuries. The Sethupatis of Ramnad, whose title is associated with guardianship of the passage to Lanka, were especially connected with the shrine. In the eighteenth century Muthuramalinga Sethupathi sponsored the great outer corridor, whose long rows of carved pillars gave the temple one of its most distinctive features. The island remained a place where a major religious route met the seaways and pearl-fishing coast of the Gulf of Mannar.
simp_chinese:
罗摩湿伐罗姆坐落在印度大陆与斯里兰卡之间的岛屿上，旁边是称为罗摩桥的浅滩链。岛上的罗摩那塔斯瓦米神庙是印度教重要朝圣地之一。相传罗摩前往楞伽后在此礼拜湿婆，使这座神庙与《罗摩衍那》的故事联系在一起。朝圣者来到神庙及其圣水处，也穿过岛上的沙岸。

数百年间，统治者和捐赠者不断资助神庙扩建。拉姆纳德的塞图帕蒂与圣所联系尤其密切，他们的称号与守护通往楞伽的通道有关。十八世纪，穆图拉马林加·塞图帕蒂资助修建宏伟的外廊，绵延成排的雕柱成为神庙最鲜明的特色之一。这座岛屿也是重要朝圣路线与马纳尔湾航道和采珠海岸的交汇之处。

english: Ramgarh lies in the forested country east of Mandla, among the upper valleys and hills of Gondwana. The surrounding region formed part of the kingdom of Garha-Mandla, whose Gond rulers held a chain of strongholds across central India. The Narmada rises farther east at Amarkantak and runs west through this upland country. In the eighteenth century the authority of the Garha-Mandla dynasty gave way to Maratha power.
simp_chinese: 拉姆加德位于门德拉以东的森林地区，坐落于冈瓦纳的上游河谷和丘陵之间。周边曾属于加尔哈—门德拉王国，其贡德统治者掌控着印度中部一系列堡垒。讷尔默达河发源于更东面的阿马尔坎塔克，向西穿过这片高地。十八世纪，加尔哈—门德拉王朝的权力最终被马拉塔势力取代。

english: Ramgarh lies north of Jaisalmer in the arid Thar country of western Rajasthan. Sand dunes and stony plains alternate across a landscape of sparse rainfall and thorny vegetation. The area belongs to the desert once ruled from the Bhati stronghold at Jaisalmer, where caravans crossed the sands between Sindh and the markets of northern India. Wells and the knowledge of routes were important to those travelling through this dry country.
simp_chinese: 拉姆加尔位于杰伊瑟尔梅尔以北、拉贾斯坦西部干旱的塔尔地区。沙丘与石质平原交替分布，降雨稀少，植被以耐旱灌丛为主。这片沙漠曾由杰伊瑟尔梅尔的巴蒂据点统治，商队穿越沙地往返信德与印度北部市场。对行经这片干旱地区的人来说，水井和对道路的熟悉十分重要。

english: The Ramgarh hills rise in the Surguja country of northern Chhattisgarh. Among their rock shelters are the ancient Sitabenga and Jogimara caves, reached through a natural passage known as Hathipol. Inscriptions in Prakrit and Brahmi letters and traces of painting survive in the caves. The arrangement of rock-cut benches at Sitabenga has suggested to scholars that poetry or performances may once have been presented there. Local tradition also associates the hills with Rama and Sita’s exile.
simp_chinese: 拉姆格尔山位于恰蒂斯加尔北部的苏尔古贾地区。山中岩洞包括古老的西塔本加和乔吉马拉洞窟，可经一条称为哈蒂波尔的天然通道抵达。洞内留有以婆罗米字母书写的俗语铭文及绘画痕迹。西塔本加的岩刻坐席布局使学者推测，那里曾举行诗歌朗诵或表演。地方传统还将山地与罗摩和悉多流放的故事联系起来。

english:
Ramgiri, also known as Ramgarh, is a hill rising above the forests of Surguja. Its caves bear the names of Rama, Sita and Lakshmana, recalling the tradition that they stayed here during their exile. The rock shelters contain inscriptions in early Brahmi and traces of painting, placing human stories in this landscape long before the later rulers of Surguja.

In the Jogimara cave an ancient inscription names Sutanuka and Devadinna, an artist associated with her. Nearby Sita Bengra has a shaped interior and an inscription mentioning poets, and has been interpreted as a place for performance. The hill has also been connected with Ramagiri, the mountain from which the poet Kalidasa’s exiled messenger addresses a cloud. Its caves bring together literary memory, local sacred tradition and unusually early traces of writing and art.
simp_chinese:
罗摩吉里又称拉姆加尔，是耸立于苏尔古贾森林上方的山丘。洞穴以罗摩、悉多和罗什曼那命名，呼应他们流放期间曾在此停留的传统。岩穴中有早期婆罗米文铭刻和绘画痕迹，说明远在后来苏尔古贾诸王之前，人们已在这片土地留下故事。

焦吉马拉洞穴中的古代铭文提到苏塔努卡及与她相关的艺术家德瓦丁纳。附近悉多·本格拉洞穴的内部经过整形，铭文提及诗人，有人因此认为它曾用于表演。这座山也与诗人迦梨陀娑笔下的罗摩吉里相联系：流放的使者在那里向云诉说心愿。洞穴汇集了文学记忆、地方神圣传统以及非常古老的文字和艺术遗存。

english: Ramhormoz lies on a fertile plain at the eastern edge of Khuzestan, where the Zagros foothills meet the lowlands. Medieval geographers praised its date palms and orchards of grapes, almonds, peaches and other fruit. In the tenth century the town was known for raising silkworms and making silk cloth for export. Its position on routes between Khuzestan and Fars made it a meeting place of the mountain and plain economies.
simp_chinese: 拉姆霍尔木兹坐落在胡齐斯坦东缘肥沃的平原上，扎格罗斯山麓在此与低地相接。中古地理学家称赞当地的椰枣林和种植葡萄、杏仁、桃等水果的果园。十世纪，这座城以养蚕和生产出口丝织品闻名。它处在胡齐斯坦与法尔斯之间的道路上，是山区与平原经济的交会地。

english:
Ramírez Island lies in Chile's Queen Adelaide Archipelago in the far south of South America. Exposed water and changing weather make navigation in the region demanding.

Indigenous maritime peoples, including the Yaghan and Kawésqar, lived in the southern archipelagos, using boats and a detailed knowledge of sheltered channels to obtain marine resources. Ships seeking the passage around the southern continent faced long distances from supplies and little margin for error, and weather, currents and coastal shelter repeatedly decided whether a voyage survived.
simp_chinese:
拉米雷斯岛位于智利南部的阿德莱德王后群岛，地处南美洲最南端。开阔的海面和多变的天气使这一带的航行十分艰难。

亚甘人与卡韦斯卡尔人等原住民海洋族群生活在南部群岛，利用舟船和对避风水道的细致认识获取海产。绕过南美大陆的船只远离补给，几乎没有犯错余地；天气、海流与沿岸庇护条件，反复决定航程能否完成。

english: Ramkola was the chief village of a district within the forested state of Surguja. The local officer resided here, giving the settlement a role in the administration of the surrounding villages. Surguja’s hills and forests formed the country of the Raksel rulers, whose authority was challenged by the Marathas in the eighteenth century. In 1758 a Maratha army crossed the eastern part of the state and compelled its chief to acknowledge tribute.
simp_chinese: 兰姆科拉是林间国家苏尔古贾境内一处辖区的主要村庄。地方官员居住于此，使聚落在管理周围村落时具有一定地位。苏尔古贾的山林属于拉克塞尔统治者的领地，十八世纪其权威受到马拉塔人挑战。1758年，一支马拉塔军队穿过国家东部，迫使首领承认纳贡。

english: Ramnagar stands in the Baghelkhand country near the Son River, which flows eastward from the central Indian highlands toward the Ganges. The river and its tributaries cut through the plateau to form a landscape of valleys and wooded hills. Ramnagar lies in the country historically associated with the Baghela rulers of Rewa, whose strongholds and settlements gave their name to Baghelkhand. The Son forms one of the great waterways linking this upland region to the plains farther north and east.
simp_chinese: 拉姆那迦位于巴格尔坎德地区，靠近从印度中部高地向东流向恒河的索恩河。河流及支流切开高原，形成河谷与林木丘陵交错的地貌。这里历来与雷瓦的巴格拉统治者相关，他们的据点和聚落也使这片地区得名。索恩河是连接中部高地与东北方平原的重要水道之一。

english: Ramnagar lies in the northern Champaran country, near the forested foothills of Nepal. Its ruling estate was a neighbour of the much larger Bettiah Raj. By 1765, when the East India Company acquired the diwani, the Bettiah family held most of Champaran, while the Ramnagar Raj retained a smaller part. The two estates stood among the landed powers through which the fertile country of northern Bihar was governed.
simp_chinese: 拉姆讷格尔位于占帕兰北部，靠近尼泊尔林木茂密的山麓。这里的王公领地与规模大得多的贝蒂亚领地相邻。1765年东印度公司取得征税权时，贝蒂亚家族已拥有占帕兰的大部分土地，拉姆讷格尔王公则保有其中较小的一部分。这两处领地都是比哈尔北部地方土地权势的一部分。

english:
Râmnicu Sărat lies in eastern Wallachia near the Carpathian foothills. It is recorded in a document of 1439. The town and its surroundings lay along routes between Wallachia and Moldavia, and its church of the Assumption was built under Constantin Brâncoveanu in 1697.

In 1789, during the Russo-Turkish War, Russian and Habsburg forces commanded by Alexander Suvorov defeated an Ottoman army in the Battle of Rymnik near the town. The battle brought the locality into the wider struggle between the neighbouring empires.
simp_chinese:
勒姆尼库瑟拉特位于瓦拉几亚东部、喀尔巴阡山麓附近，1439年的文献已提及此地。城镇及周边位于瓦拉几亚通往摩尔达维亚的道路上；当地圣母安息教堂于1697年在康斯坦丁·布朗科韦亚努统治时期建成。

1789年俄土战争期间，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫指挥的俄国与哈布斯堡军队在附近的勒姆尼克战役中击败奥斯曼军队，使当地成为周边帝国争斗的战场。

english:
Râmnic lies in the Olt valley of northern Oltenia, on the route towards the Carpathians. It was recorded as a princely town under Mircea the Elder in 1388 and as the seat of Vâlcea County in 1392. The fortress of Cetățuia served the Oltenian bans and, from 1504, the Orthodox bishops of Râmnic. In 1529 Prince Radu of Afumați was killed there in a boyar conspiracy.

Under Matei Basarab and Constantin Brâncoveanu, Râmnic developed as a cultural center associated with paper-making and printing. Its church institutions connected it to the religious life of Wallachia. The town suffered heavy damage during the Habsburg occupation of Oltenia from 1718 to 1739, a period when it again served chiefly as a fortress.
simp_chinese:
勒姆尼库位于北奥尔泰尼亚的奥尔特河谷，通往喀尔巴阡山的道路经过这里。1388年，老米尔恰统治时期的文献称它为亲王的城镇；1392年又记载它是沃尔恰县治所。切特楚亚堡垒曾供奥尔泰尼亚的班使用，1504年起也成为勒姆尼库东正教主教的驻地。1529年，亲王拉杜·德·阿富马齐在此死于波雅尔贵族的阴谋。

马泰·巴萨拉布和康斯坦丁·布伦科韦亚努统治时，勒姆尼库发展为与造纸、印刷有关的文化中心。教会机构使它与瓦拉几亚的宗教生活紧密相连。1718至1739年哈布斯堡占领奥尔泰尼亚期间，城镇遭到严重破坏，再次主要作为堡垒使用。

english: Rampa lies in the forested hills above the Godavari country. Its chief was known as the raja or mansabdar of Rampa, and subordinate hill chiefs called muttadars held villages under him. In 1787 a British committee observed that, although the estate was counted within the Rajahmundry circar, neither the Company nor the Nizam received tribute from it. The hill chief's authority thus endured alongside the claims of stronger powers in the lowlands.
simp_chinese: 蓝波位于戈达瓦里地区上方的森林山地。当地首领被称为蓝波拉阇或曼萨卜达尔，下属的山地首领穆塔达尔则管理村庄。1787年，英国委员会记载，虽然这片领地被列入拉贾蒙德里辖区，东印度公司和尼扎姆政府都没有从中取得贡赋。山地首领的权力因而与低地强权的领土主张并存。

english: Dleł Taaneets lies on the south bank of the Yukon River, where the water passes through a range of low mountains. The Koyukon name is associated with a hanging moose hide, recalled by the colour of the bluffs near the village. The surrounding boreal forest and river belong to a landscape used by Koyukon Dene families through the seasons. Salmon, plants and berries are gathered in their time, while moose and other animals provide food and materials. The Yukon forms a route through the hills of the interior.
simp_chinese: 德莱尔塔内茨位于育空河南岸，河水在此穿过一列低山。这个科尤孔语地名与悬挂的驼鹿皮有关，附近崖壁的颜色令人联想到这种景象。周围的北方森林与河流是科尤孔德内人世代随季节利用的土地。人们在适当时节捕捞鲑鱼、采集植物和浆果，驼鹿等动物则提供食物和材料。育空河穿过内陆丘陵，构成一条交通路线。

english:
Rampur Boalia, on the Padma River, grew as a centre of the silk trade in Rajshahi. Mulberry cultivation in the surrounding country supplied silk producers, and the riverside market connected their thread and cloth with merchants from farther afield. A Dutch trading house stood by the river, a sign of European interest in the produce of northern Bengal.

By the late eighteenth century the East India Company was investing heavily in raw silk at Boalia. In 1787 its commercial resident, Mr Speke, received funds both to purchase silk and to make advances for further supplies. The following year officials sent him silkworm eggs from China in the hope of introducing a different variety of silk. The trade joined cultivators, reelers and weavers to an expanding network of European commercial establishments.
simp_chinese:
兰布尔博阿拉位于博多河畔，发展为拉杰沙希丝绸贸易中心。周边地区种植桑树，供应丝绸生产；河边市场则将丝线与织物售予远方商人。荷兰商馆立于河岸，显示欧洲商人对孟加拉北部物产的兴趣。

十八世纪末，东印度公司在博阿拉大量投资生丝贸易。1787年，公司的商业驻员斯皮克获得资金购买丝绸，并预付货款以取得更多供应。次年官员又送来中国蚕卵，希望引入另一种丝绸。贸易将种植者、缫丝者和织工与不断扩大的欧洲商馆网络联系起来。

english: Rampura lies in western Malwa, near the frontier with Mewar. Tradition attributes its foundation to Rama, a Bhil ruler, before the Chandrawats of Mewar took the town. Their possessions included the fortress of Hinglajgarh, named for the goddess Hinglaj Devi. In 1773 Ahilyabai Holkar defeated the Chandrawat ruler Laxman Singh and took the fort, which she rebuilt while maintaining its temples.
simp_chinese: 兰普拉位于西摩腊婆，靠近梅瓦尔边境。相传比尔人统治者罗摩建立了这座城镇，后来它被梅瓦尔的钱德拉瓦特家族夺取。该家族的领地还包括兴拉杰格尔堡，堡垒得名于女神兴拉杰·黛维。1773年，阿希莉娅·拜伊·霍尔卡尔击败钱德拉瓦特统治者拉克什曼·辛格，夺取堡垒，并重修城堡、维护其中的神庙。

english:
Ramree belongs to the island and estuarine country of southern Arakan, where coastal channels, mangroves and cultivated ground supported communities connected with the Bay of Bengal. Fishing and rice production offered complementary livelihoods, while boats linked settlements with mainland markets and neighbouring shores. The broken coastline required knowledge of tides, shallow passages and seasonal weather. Sea routes could be easier to use than difficult inland paths, giving maritime skills a central place in local life.

Ramree Island was connected to the kingdom centred on Mrauk U, and the town is associated in Rakhine accounts with its last ruler, Mahathamada Raza, said to have been governor of Ramree. After the Konbaung conquest of Arakan, Burmese governors administered the region. Following the First Anglo-Burmese War, Arakan passed to British control in 1826, and Ramree became a district headquarters.
simp_chinese:
兰里属于阿拉干南部岛屿和河口地区，沿海水道、红树林及耕地支撑同孟加拉湾相连的社区。捕鱼和稻作提供互补生计，舟船把聚落同大陆市场及邻近海岸联系起来。曲折岸线要求熟悉潮汐、浅水通道和季节天气。海路可能比困难内陆小径更便于使用，使航海技能成为地方生活核心。

兰里岛与以妙乌为中心的王国相联系。若开记载称，阿拉干末代国王摩诃昙摩陀罗阇曾任兰里总督。贡榜王朝征服阿拉干后，缅甸派总督管理这一地区。第一次英缅战争之后，阿拉干于1826年转入英国统治，兰里成为地区行政中心。

english: Ramree is a large island off the Arakan coast, separated from the mainland by tidal channels. Its sheltered eastern shores and the neighbouring river mouths support extensive mangrove forests. Hills rise inland from the coast, while waterways between the island and mainland provide sheltered approaches to the Bay of Bengal. The island forms part of a broken coastline of islands, estuaries and inlets that gives Arakan a distinct maritime character.
simp_chinese: 兰里岛是若开海岸外的大岛，潮汐水道将它与大陆分开。岛屿东侧避风的海岸及邻近河口生长着大片红树林，内陆则有丘陵起伏。岛与大陆之间的水道提供了通往孟加拉湾的避风航路。岛屿、河口和海湾交错的曲折海岸，使若开地区具有鲜明的海洋特色。

sources.title: Kyaukphyu Township Environment Assessment Report Nov2017.pdf

english: Ramsele lies beside the Faxälven in inland Ångermanland. Its medieval stone church occupies a height above the river, enclosed by steep sandy banks. The church and parish appear in documents from the 1270s. According to local tradition, eleven farmers built the church. Medieval parishioners could reach its site at Grannäset most easily by travelling along the river.
simp_chinese: 拉姆瑟勒位于昂厄曼兰内陆的法克斯河畔。中世纪石教堂建在河流上方的高地，四周是陡峭的沙岸。教堂与教区见于十三世纪七十年代的文书。地方传说称，教堂由十一位农民建造。中世纪教民最方便的方式是沿河抵达格兰内塞特的教堂所在地。

english: Ramsheh lies in the dry Jarquya country southeast of Isfahan, among scattered settlements on the edge of the central desert. Underground qanat channels bring water to the surface for fields and gardens. Jarquya was traditionally divided into upper and lower districts, each containing a chain of oasis villages. Salt deposits have been worked at Ramsheh as well as at Sian and Khara elsewhere in the district.
simp_chinese: 拉姆谢位于伊斯法罕东南的干旱贾尔库耶地区，聚落零星散布在中部沙漠边缘。地下坎儿井将水引出地面，浇灌田地和园圃。贾尔库耶传统上分为上、下两区，各有一串绿洲村庄。拉姆谢以及区内的西亚恩和哈拉都有盐矿开采。

sources.title: Sangin-Rethinking Residential Cooling in Europe-299 LongVersionf865.pdf

english: Ramsis lies in the cultivated western Nile Delta, in the country of Buhayra. Medieval Egyptian records used the name Hawf Ramsis for a district that included villages such as Kharibta. The flat lands of the Delta were shaped by the branches of the Nile and the channels that carried water through the fields. Villages in this region formed part of the agricultural landscape between the river and the western desert.
simp_chinese: 拉姆西斯位于尼罗河三角洲西部的布海拉耕作区。中世纪埃及记载以「豪夫拉姆西斯」称呼一个地区，其中包括哈里卜塔等村庄。尼罗河的支流及为田地引水的渠道塑造了三角洲平坦的土地。这一带的村庄共同构成了河流与西部沙漠之间的农业景观。

english: Ramu lies on the Bakkhali River in the coastal country south of Chittagong, between the hills and the Bay of Bengal. The settlement appears on early European maps of the coast, and its Buddhist temples bear witness to the region's long religious connections with Arakan. The surrounding lands formed part of the wider country contested by Arakan and Bengal until the Mughal conquest of Chittagong in 1666. Rivers and coastal routes linked Ramu to both sides of the bay.
simp_chinese: 拉穆位于吉大港以南沿海地区的巴卡利河畔，处在丘陵与孟加拉湾之间。早期欧洲海图标出了这处聚落，当地佛教寺庙见证了该地区与若开长久的宗教联系。周围土地属于若开与孟加拉争夺的广大地区，直到1666年莫卧儿征服吉大港。河流和沿海路线将拉穆与海湾两侧联系起来。

english: Ran was a fortified settlement among the northern spurs of the Karatau, northwest of Sozak. Set near the exit of a gorge, it belonged to a group of settlements associated with the Kazakh communities of the region. Its remains have been dated to the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, a period when towns and fortified places along the mountains linked the steppe with the settled country farther south.
simp_chinese: 兰恩是卡拉套山北侧支脉间的一处设防聚落，位于所扎克西北方。它靠近一条峡谷的出口，属于与当地哈萨克人有关的一组聚落。遗址年代为十七至十八世纪，当时沿山分布的城镇和设防地点将草原与更南方的定居地区联系起来。

english: Ranfjord cuts east into northern Helgeland from the islands near the Norwegian Sea. Its outer reaches are narrow and steep-sided, opening farther inland towards wooded and cultivated shores. At its head the Rana valley leads into the mountains. Mineral deposits there attracted prospectors in the seventeenth century, when silver mining was attempted at Bertelberget.
