The fjord provided a waterway between this inland country and the islands and coastal routes beyond its mouth.
simp_chinese: 兰峡湾从挪威海附近的岛屿之间向东深入海尔格兰北部。外段狭窄、岸坡陡峭，进入内侧后逐渐展宽，两岸有森林与耕地。峡湾尽头的拉纳河谷通向山地。十七世纪，山中矿藏吸引勘探者前来，人们曾在贝特尔山尝试开采银矿。峡湾提供了一条连接内陆与湾口外岛屿、沿海航路的水道。

english: Rana stretches inland from the head of Ranfjord into the forests and mountains of Helgeland. Rivers descend through its valleys towards the fjord, while high ground approaches the Swedish border. The mountains held mineral deposits known by the seventeenth century, when silver mining was attempted at Bertelberget and at Nasafjäll across the frontier. In 1803 the preacher Hans Nielsen Hauge noted iron ore, a waterfall and extensive forest in northern Rana, seeing possibilities in their combination.
simp_chinese: 拉纳从兰峡湾尽头向内陆延伸，进入海尔格兰的森林和山地。河流沿山谷流向峡湾，高地则接近瑞典边界。十七世纪时，人们已知山中有矿藏，并曾在贝特尔山及边界另一侧的纳萨山尝试开采银矿。1803年，传教士汉斯·尼尔森·豪格注意到拉纳北部的铁矿、瀑布和大片森林，看到了它们结合的潜力。

english:
Ranchi lies on the high plateau of Chota Nagpur, among forests, hills and streams that descend from the uplands. Munda and Oraon communities inhabited this country alongside the territories of the Nagvanshi rulers. Near the town, the Jagannath temple stands on a hill, its form recalling the celebrated temple at Puri in Odisha.

Thakur Ani Nath Shahdeo built the Jagannath temple in 1691. Its annual chariot festival brought worshippers together around the image of Jagannath in a procession through the temple grounds. In the early nineteenth century, changes in landholding and the demands of outsiders contributed to discontent across the plateau. The Kol uprising of 1831–32 spread through the Ranchi country, and its suppression was followed by a reorganisation of Company administration in Chota Nagpur.
simp_chinese:
兰契位于乔塔纳格普尔高原，森林、丘陵和从高地流下的溪流环绕其间。蒙达人与奥朗人社群居住在这里，与纳格万希统治者的领地相邻。城镇附近的山丘上有贾格纳特神庙，其形式令人想起奥里萨普里著名的同名神庙。

1691年，塔库尔·阿尼·纳特·沙阿德奥修建了这座神庙。每年的战车节使信众围绕贾格纳特神像聚集。十九世纪初，土地持有关系的变化与外来者的要求加剧了高原各地的不满。1831至1832年的科尔起义蔓延至兰契地区，镇压之后东印度公司重新组织了乔塔纳格普尔的行政体系。

english: Rander stands on the northern bank of the Tapi opposite Surat. Before its neighbour rose to prominence, it was a port whose merchants connected Gujarat with Arabia and Southeast Asia. Spices and other goods moved through its maritime networks, and Muslim traders made the town a centre of religious and commercial life. As Surat expanded, Rander’s relative importance declined, but its old mosques and neighbourhoods preserve the memory of a long-established trading community.
simp_chinese: 兰德尔位于塔普蒂河北岸，与苏拉特隔河相望。在邻城兴起之前，它已是一座港口，商人将古吉拉特与阿拉伯及东南亚连接起来。香料和其他货物通过海上网络流通，穆斯林商人使城镇成为宗教与商业中心。随着苏拉特扩张，兰德尔的相对地位下降，但古老清真寺和街区仍保存着悠久商人社群的记忆。

english:
Randers stands at the narrow crossing where the Gudenå meets the head of Randers Fjord, so that roads running north and south through Jutland and the sea route out along the fjord came together here. King Canute IV minted coins in the town in the 11th century, and the market town, burned and rebuilt more than once in the 13th century, received market privileges in 1302. Salmon fishing and the harbour supported its merchants, and a ring of ramparts enclosed the streets.

In the Kingless Time, when Denmark was pledged to German counts, the Jutland noble Niels Ebbesen killed Count Gerhard III of Holstein, nicknamed the Bald, in Randers on 1 April 1340. Ebbesen was himself killed in battle at Skanderborg that November, but his act touched off a revolt against the pledgeholders. When Valdemar IV rebuilt the realm, Randers was strengthened as a fortress, the Randershus, yet discontented nobles seized it in 1357, and the king attacked it with all his forces in 1359. The town prospered in the 15th and 16th centuries from trade at home and overseas, withstood a peasant assault in 1534, and gained wide moats under Christian III.
simp_chinese:
兰讷斯位于古登河汇入兰讷斯峡湾湾顶的狭窄渡口，贯穿日德兰半岛南北的道路和沿峡湾出海的水路在此汇合。11世纪，国王克努特四世曾在此铸造钱币；这座市镇在13世纪几度焚毁又重建，1302年获得集市特权。鲑鱼捕捞和港口养活着商人，一圈土垒城垣围住街巷。

在丹麦被抵押给德意志伯爵的“无王时代”，日德兰贵族尼尔斯·埃贝森于1340年4月1日在兰讷斯杀死了绰号“秃头”的荷尔斯泰因伯爵格哈德三世。同年11月，埃贝森本人在斯坎讷堡一带的战斗中阵亡，但他的行动点燃了反抗抵押领主的起义。瓦尔德马四世重建王国时，兰讷斯被加固为要塞，称兰讷斯堡；不满的贵族却在1357年夺取了它，1359年国王率全部兵力进攻。15至16世纪，兰讷斯凭借国内外贸易繁荣起来，1534年挡住了农民的进攻，克里斯蒂安三世时期又在城外挖起宽阔的壕沟。

english: The upper Bear River winds through mountain valleys near Bear Lake, in a country long visited by Shoshone, Bannock and Ute people. The lake and surrounding highlands supplied fishing and hunting grounds and served as places of exchange. Fur traders later joined these gatherings: Donald Mackenzie named Bear Lake in 1819, and in the summers of 1827 and 1828 trappers held rendezvous at its southern end. The Bear River continued westward on its long course toward the Great Salt Lake.
simp_chinese: 贝尔河上游蜿蜒流过贝尔湖附近的山间谷地，肖肖尼人、班诺克人和犹特人长期来到这一地区。湖泊及周围高地提供渔场与猎场，也是交换物品的地方。毛皮商人后来加入这些聚会：1819年唐纳德·麦肯齐为贝尔湖命名，1827和1828年夏季，捕猎者在湖的南端举行交易集会。贝尔河继续向西，沿漫长河道流往大盐湖。

english: Råneå stands near the mouth of the Råne River on the northern Gulf of Bothnia. In 1642 its farmers sought permission to build a church, hoping to separate their district from the large parish of Luleå. The building was largely complete by 1646, and the king approved a separate parish in 1654. Around the church, families from the surrounding villages built cottages in which to stay during services, court sessions and markets.
simp_chinese: 罗讷奥位于罗讷河口附近，濒临波的尼亚湾北部。1642年，当地农民请求修建教堂，希望从广阔的吕勒奥堂区分出。教堂于1646年基本完工，国王于1654年批准设立独立堂区。周围村庄的家庭在教堂附近建起小屋，以便参加礼拜、法庭和集市时留宿。

english:
Rangamati, later called Udaipur, was the capital of the Manikya kings of Tripura on the Gomati River. Royal palaces, temples and great tanks gave the city its character. Its most revered shrine is the temple of Tripura Sundari, dedicated to the goddess and counted among the sacred Shakti pithas.

King Dhanya Manikya built the Tripura Sundari temple in 1501. Tradition tells that the goddess instructed him in a dream to establish her worship on the hilltop. The shrine’s square chamber and roof combine local Bengali forms with a royal cult that drew devotees from beyond the kingdom. A smaller image of the goddess was traditionally carried by the kings on campaigns. In 1567 the army commander Gopi Prasad seized the throne as Uday Manikya and renamed the capital Udaipur. Later rulers continued to endow temples and excavate tanks around the city. In 1760 Krishna Manikya moved the capital to Old Agartala, but the older royal city retained its temples and religious importance.
simp_chinese:
兰加马蒂后来称为乌代布尔，是特里普拉玛尼基亚诸王在戈马蒂河畔的都城。王宫、寺庙和大型水池构成城市的特色。最受尊崇的神庙奉祀女神特里普拉·孙德里，被列为神圣的性力派圣地之一。

达尼亚·玛尼基亚国王于1501年修建特里普拉·孙德里神庙。传说女神在梦中指示他在山顶建立祭祀。神庙的方形殿室和屋顶结合了孟加拉本地形式与王室崇拜，吸引王国之外的信徒。传统上，国王出征时会携带一尊较小的女神像。1567年，军队统帅戈皮·普拉萨德夺取王位，称乌代·玛尼基亚，并将都城改名乌代布尔。后来的统治者继续在城中兴建寺庙、开凿水池。1760年克里希纳·玛尼基亚将都城迁往旧阿加尔塔拉，旧王都仍保有寺庙及其宗教地位。

english: Rangaunu Bay opens northwards from a harbour on the far northern coast of New Zealand. Ngāti Kahu traditions recount the arrival of the Māmaru canoe and the settlement of descendants of its captain Te Parata and Kahutianui around Rangaunu and Tokerau. The harbour’s shallows were also used as a managed shark fishery.
simp_chinese: 兰加乌努湾向北开口，连通新西兰极北海岸的一处港湾。恩加蒂卡胡传统讲述了马马鲁独木舟的到来，以及船长特帕拉塔与卡胡蒂阿努伊的后裔在兰加乌努和托克劳一带定居的故事。港湾浅水区也曾被用作有管理的鲨鱼渔场。

english: Rangiroa is one of the largest atolls in the Tuamotus, with a long ring of low islets around an immense lagoon. Coral-block ceremonial platforms, or marae, testify to Polynesian life on its shores. Dutch navigators Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten reached the atoll during their Pacific voyage in 1616.
simp_chinese: 朗伊罗阿是土阿莫土群岛最大的环礁之一，狭长低岛围绕巨大的潟湖。珊瑚石块筑成的礼仪平台，即马拉埃，见证了岛岸上的波利尼西亚生活。1616年，荷兰航海者雅各布·勒梅尔与威廉·斯豪滕在太平洋航行中抵达环礁。

english: Rangiroa is a great Tuamotu atoll, where many low coral islets and reefs enclose a vast lagoon. Polynesian settlers reached it long before European contact. In 1616 Dutch navigators Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten encountered Rangiroa and gave it the name Vlieghen Eiland.
simp_chinese: 朗伊罗阿是土阿莫土的一座巨大环礁，众多低矮珊瑚小岛和礁体围成广阔潟湖。欧洲人接触之前，波利尼西亚移民早已到达此地。1616年，荷兰航海家雅各布·勒梅尔与威廉·斯豪滕遇见朗伊罗阿，将其称为苍蝇岛。

english:
Rancagua lies in the fertile Cachapoal valley, south of Santiago and beneath the Andes of central Chile. The valley was inhabited by Picunche communities before Spanish settlement. In 1743 Governor José Antonio Manso de Velasco founded the villa of Santa Cruz de Triana on land ceded by the indigenous chief Tomás Guaglén. The older name Rancagua remained attached to the settlement.

The town became the scene of a decisive battle during the struggle for Chilean independence. On 1 and 2 October 1814, patriot forces under Bernardo O’Higgins defended positions around the square against the royalist army of Mariano Osorio. Their defeat opened the road to Santiago and began a period of Spanish reconquest. Patriot leaders and supporters fled across the Andes to Mendoza before returning in a later campaign.
simp_chinese:
兰卡瓜位于圣地亚哥以南肥沃的卡查波阿尔河谷，背靠智利中部安第斯山脉。西班牙人定居之前，皮昆切社群居住于此。1743年，总督何塞·安东尼奥·曼索·德贝拉斯科在原住民首领托马斯·瓜格伦让出的土地上建立圣克鲁斯德特里亚纳镇。较早的兰卡瓜之名仍为人们所使用。

智利独立战争期间，这座城镇成为一场决定性战役的战场。1814年10月1日至2日，贝尔纳多·奥伊金斯率领的爱国军在广场周围坚守，抵抗马里亚诺·奥索里奥的保王派军队。爱国军战败后，通往圣地亚哥的道路敞开，西班牙收复时期开始。爱国派领袖和支持者逃往安第斯山脉另一侧的门多萨，随后才在新的战役中返回。

english:
Rangküll Mapu is the country of the Rankülche, or Ranquel, in the central pampas region. Their communities occupied a landscape of grassland, woodland, lagoons and dunes, maintaining relations with other Indigenous peoples and the colonial frontier. The name joins the people to their land, a region traversed by paths between the plains and the Andean world.

During the later eighteenth century groups associated with the Ranquel established themselves in the central pampas. Their leaders negotiated, traded and fought with neighbouring peoples and the authorities of Buenos Aires. Around the Salinas Grandes and the eastern dunes, different communities maintained their own relationships with the frontier. Their history was shaped by both movement across the plains and efforts to defend their territory.
simp_chinese:
兰库尔马普是潘帕斯中部兰库尔切人，即兰克尔人的土地。社群居住在草原、林地、潟湖与沙丘交织的环境中，与其他原住民族及殖民边境保持关系。这个名称将民族与土地联系起来，平原与安第斯世界之间的道路穿越其间。

十八世纪后期，与兰克尔人有关的群体在潘帕斯中部建立居地。首领与邻近民族及布宜诺斯艾利斯当局协商、贸易和交战。大盐沼及东部沙丘周围的不同社群，各自维持与边境的关系。他们的历史既由穿越平原的移动塑造，也由捍卫土地的努力塑造。

english:
Rangpur lies in the fertile plains of northern Bengal, among rivers descending from the Himalayan foothills. The countryside became the scene of a major peasant rising in the early years of East India Company rule. Known as the Rangpur dhing, it brought cultivators together against the demands of revenue collectors and spread across neighbouring districts.

In 1783 farmers resisted the exactions of Debi Singh, the revenue contractor for Rangpur and Dinajpur. They chose Nuruddin as their leader, proclaimed him nawab and stopped paying revenue to the contractor. Instead, they raised contributions to support the revolt and drove out or attacked his agents. The Company sent troops to suppress the movement; Nuruddin was wounded and captured during the fighting. The rebellion exposed the violence surrounding revenue collection in northern Bengal.
simp_chinese:
伦格布尔位于孟加拉北部肥沃的平原，多条河流从喜马拉雅山麓流经此地。东印度公司统治初期，这片乡村爆发了规模可观的农民起义。它被称为伦格布尔“丁”，把反抗征税者要求的农民聚集起来，并蔓延到邻近地区。

1783年，农民抵抗伦格布尔和迪纳杰布尔税收承包人德比·辛格的苛索。他们推举努鲁丁为领袖，宣布他为纳瓦布，停止向承包人缴税，转而筹集款项支持起义，并驱逐或袭击其代理人。公司派兵镇压，努鲁丁在战斗中受伤被俘。起义揭示了孟加拉北部征税过程中存在的暴力。

english: Rang was the old county at the seat of Dengzhou in the Nanyang basin. Its Flower Isle Academy was founded by the Song statesman Fan Zhongyan while he governed the prefecture; there he wrote his celebrated essay on Yueyang Tower. Scholars continued to study at the academy under later dynasties, and Ming officials repaired its halls and gardens during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns.
simp_chinese: 穰县是南阳盆地邓州治所的旧县。北宋政治家范仲淹知邓州时创办花洲书院，并在此写下著名的《岳阳楼记》。后世学子继续在书院求学；明嘉靖、万历年间，地方官又整修讲堂与园林。

english: Ranibas is a village in the hill country of Bhojpur in eastern Nepal. The wider region takes its name from the Himalayan birch, whose bark was traditionally known as bhojpatra. These hills form part of the country associated with Kirati peoples, whose name appears in old Sanskrit literature for inhabitants of the Himalayan mountains. Forested ridges and river valleys separate Ranibas from the neighbouring districts of the Kosi basin.
simp_chinese: 拉尼巴斯是尼泊尔东部博杰布尔山区的一个村庄。博杰布尔得名于喜马拉雅桦树，其树皮传统上称为博杰帕特拉。这片山地与基拉特诸族有关；古代梵文文献中，基拉特是对喜马拉雅山居民的称呼。森林覆盖的山脊和河谷将拉尼巴斯与戈西河流域的邻近地区隔开。

english: Ranikot is a vast walled enclosure among the barren Kirthar hills west of the Indus. Its stone ramparts follow the ridges and valleys, enclosing smaller fortified places and seasonal watercourses. The origins of the fort are debated, but its present walls are associated with major work under the Talpur rulers of Sindh in the early nineteenth century. The scale of the defences and the rugged terrain make it one of the most striking strongholds of the lower Indus country.
simp_chinese: 拉尼科特是印度河以西荒凉基尔塔尔山中的巨大城墙围地。石造壁垒沿山脊与谷地延伸，围住较小的设防地点和季节性水道。堡垒起源有不同说法，现存城墙则与十九世纪初信德塔尔普尔统治者时期的大规模工程有关。防御规模与崎岖地势使它成为印度河下游地区最引人注目的要塞之一。

english: Rankin Inlet, called Kangiqtiniq or 'deep inlet' in Inuktitut, opens onto the western shore of Hudson Bay. Near the mouth of the Meliadine River, the remains of ancient sod houses at Qamaviniqtalik recall generations of Inuit life in the region. Thule people and later Caribou Inuit occupied the site over several centuries, fishing and hunting in the country around the inlet. Offshore lies Marble Island, where the ships of the explorer James Knight were lost in the early eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 兰金湾位于哈得孙湾西岸，因纽特语名康吉克蒂尼克意为“深湾”。梅利亚丁河口附近的卡马维尼克塔利克留有古老草皮屋遗址，见证了因纽特人在这一地区世代生活。图勒人和后来的驯鹿因纽特人曾在此居住数百年，在湾区周围捕鱼、狩猎。近海有大理石岛，探险家詹姆斯·奈特的船队在十八世纪初于岛附近失事。

english:
Rankülche, the “people of the reeds,” are associated with Mamüll Mapu, the wooded country of the central Pampas. Caldén groves, grassland and scattered lagoons break up the broad plains of the interior, and Indigenous routes linked camps across this vast region. By the late eighteenth century the Ranquel name appeared in colonial records, as communities formed political and economic ties across the frontier.

Carripilún and Yanquetruz were among the leaders remembered in this frontier history. Their leaders negotiated and fought with colonial and later Argentine authorities while maintaining connections with other Indigenous groups. Hunting, livestock raising and exchange formed part of a wider network reaching toward the Andes and the settlements east of the Pampas. The territory remained under Indigenous authority well into the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
兰屈尔切意为“芦苇丛之人”，与潘帕中部称作马穆尔马普的林木之地相联系。卡尔登树林和湖泊点缀着平原，原住民道路连接广阔地区中的营地。到十八世纪末，殖民文献中出现了兰克尔人的名称，各社区也在边疆两侧建立政治和经济联系。

卡里皮隆和扬克特鲁斯是这段边疆历史中为人记住的首领。他们的首领与殖民当局及后来的阿根廷当局时而谈判、时而交战，同时与其他原住民群体保持联系。狩猎、牲畜与交换构成更广泛网络的一部分，向西伸至安第斯山，向东连接潘帕的聚落。直到十九世纪相当长的一段时间，这片地域仍由原住民掌握。

english: Rano was one of the Hausa Bakwai, the seven legitimate Hausa states, and tradition names its founder as Zamna Kogi, a descendant of the legendary Bayajidda. Hausa tradition gave each state a role: Kano and Rano were the centres of cloth-making, called the “kings of indigo”, while Katsina and Daura were the market towns and Zazzau supplied slave labour to the others. During the reign of Yaji I of Kano (1349–1385), Kano conquered Rano and held it for two years. The town survived, but it never regained its sovereignty and from then on lived in the shadow of its larger neighbour to the north.
simp_chinese: 拉诺是豪萨七大正统邦国之一，传说其创建者是扎姆纳·科吉，据说是传奇人物巴亚吉达的后裔。按豪萨传统，各邦各有分工：卡诺和拉诺是织布染布的中心，被称作“靛蓝之王”，卡齐纳和达乌拉是市镇，扎造则向其他邦国提供奴隶劳力。卡诺国王亚吉一世（1349—1385年在位）在位期间，征服并占领拉诺两年。此后拉诺虽然延续下来，却再没有恢复主权，从此活在北面这个大邻邦的阴影之下。

english: Ranohira lies beside the Isalo massif in southern Madagascar, in country associated with the Bara. Sandstone has been worn into cliffs, deep canyons and strange rock formations, with pools and streams hidden among them. The Bara are known for raising zebu cattle, a source of wealth as well as food. Their tombs are placed among the rocks of Isalo, linking the mountain landscape to the memory of the dead.
simp_chinese: 拉努希拉位于马达加斯加南部伊萨卢山地旁，属于与巴拉人相联系的地区。砂岩经侵蚀形成峭壁、深峡和奇特岩层，水潭与溪流隐藏其间。巴拉人以饲养瘤牛闻名，牛既是财富，也提供食物。他们的墓葬安置在伊萨卢的岩石之间，使山地景观与对逝者的纪念联系起来。

english: Ranongga is a long, narrow island on the western side of the New Georgia group. Its wooded ridges rise above coastal settlements and reefs, with Vella Lavella to the west and Kolombangara across the water to the east. The channels between these islands form part of the western Solomon Islands’ maritime landscape.
simp_chinese: 拉农加是新乔治亚群岛西侧一座狭长岛屿。林木山脊俯瞰沿岸聚落与礁石，西面是韦拉拉韦拉，东面隔海则是科隆班加拉。岛屿之间的水道构成所罗门群岛西部海洋景观的一部分。

english: Ranpur lies in eastern Saurashtra, where a fortified settlement guarded routes across the peninsula. Local rulers held the town before the Gujarat sultan Mahmud Begada defeated its chief and destroyed the fort in the late fifteenth century. In the seventeenth century the Mughal governor Azam Khan built another stronghold called Shahpur to control the surrounding country. These successive forts reflect the changing powers that sought authority over the region.
simp_chinese: 兰布尔位于索拉什特拉东部，设防聚落守卫着穿越半岛的道路。当地统治者曾掌有城镇，直到十五世纪末古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达击败首领并摧毁堡垒。十七世纪，莫卧儿总督阿扎姆汗另建一座名为沙阿布尔的要塞，以控制周围地区。这些先后兴建的堡垒反映出寻求统治此地的势力不断变化。

english: Rantau Benar lies in the Tungkal country of Jambi, among the rivers and hills of eastern Sumatra. A local tradition calls the settlement Balik Bukit, or “behind the hill”, and relates its foundation to Datuk Mandaliko and his children, remembered as ancestors of three neighbouring communities. The place also appears in accounts of the lower territories of the Jambi kingdom, which extended from the Tungkal area towards the Batang Hari basin and the border with Palembang.
simp_chinese: 兰道贝纳位于占碑的通卡尔地区，坐落在苏门答腊东部河流与丘陵之间。地方传说称这里为“山后村”，并将其建立与拿督曼达利科及其子女联系起来；他们被视为三个相邻社群的祖先。关于占碑王国下游领地的记载也提到此地，王国的范围从通卡尔一带延伸至巴当哈里流域和巨港边界。

sources.title: Tan talanai beserta dua buah cerita rakyat jambi lainnya.pdf

english: Rantau Panjang was a settlement on the Segamat River in the interior of Johor. Local tradition connects its beginnings with the retreat of Malacca's bendahara and his followers after the Portuguese captured their city in 1511. The river flows toward the Muar and provided a route between the inland settlement and the coast. The town later came to be known by the river's name, Segamat.
simp_chinese: 兰斗班让是柔佛内陆昔加末河畔的聚落。地方传统将其起源与1511年马六甲被葡萄牙攻占后宰相及其追随者的撤退联系起来。昔加末河流向麻坡河，为内陆聚落与海岸之间提供通道。这座城镇后来以河流之名被称为昔加末。

english:
Ranthambore Fort crowns a high plateau above the wooded hills of eastern Rajasthan. Steep cliffs and massive walls protect a complex of temples, palaces and reservoirs. Its commanding position made it one of the strongest forts of Rajputana, and the shrine of Ganesha within its walls drew worshippers as well as soldiers.

The Chauhan ruler Hammir defended Ranthambore against the Delhi sultan Alauddin Khalji in 1301. After a prolonged siege the fort fell, an event remembered in accounts of Rajput resistance. It subsequently passed through the hands of the Delhi sultans, the rulers of Mewar and the Hadas of Bundi. In 1569 the Mughal emperor Akbar besieged the fort and secured its surrender from the Hada ruler Surjan. Its later history remained bound to the shifting relationships between the Mughal court and Rajput houses.
simp_chinese:
伦滕波尔堡占据拉贾斯坦东部林木山丘之上的高原。陡峭悬崖与巨大城墙保护着神庙、宫殿和蓄水池组成的建筑群。险要地势使它成为拉杰普塔纳最坚固的堡垒之一；城内供奉象头神的圣所也吸引信众前来。

1301年，乔汉统治者哈米尔在伦滕波尔抵御德里苏丹阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉。长期围攻后堡垒陷落，这一事件在拉杰普特抵抗的记述中得到纪念。此地随后先后归德里苏丹、梅瓦尔统治者和本迪的哈达家族掌管。1569年，莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴围攻堡垒，迫使哈达统治者苏尔詹投降。此后的历史仍与莫卧儿宫廷和拉杰普特家族不断变化的关系密切相连。

english: Ranua lies in the forest and lake country of southern Lapland. Sámi inhabitants hunted and fished in the region before Finnish settlers established farms in the sparsely inhabited interior. In the later seventeenth century, people from Ii and Pudasjärvi settled at Kuha, east of Lake Ranuanjärvi, on lands they had previously used as outlying grounds. Settlement remained thin: around the beginning of the eighteenth century the Ranua region had only five inhabited farms.
simp_chinese: 拉努阿位于拉普兰南部的森林湖泊地带。芬兰移民在这片人口稀少的内陆建立农场之前，萨米居民在此狩猎捕鱼。十七世纪后半叶，来自伊和普达斯耶尔维的人们在拉努阿湖以东的库哈定居，此前他们曾把这片土地作为外围利用地。当地定居人口依然稀少：十八世纪初，拉努阿地区只有五座有人居住的农场。

english: Ranyah is the principal settlement of a long valley in southwestern Najd, on routes between the highlands and the interior. The wadi is associated with the Subay tribe, whose communities occupied villages and watering places along its course. Travellers, traders and pilgrims passed through the district on journeys between southern and northern Arabia. Old houses, palms and fortified residences reflect the life of its settled communities.
simp_chinese: 兰耶是内志西南一条漫长谷地的主要聚落，位于连接高地与内陆的道路上。山谷与苏拜部族有关，他们的社群居住在沿谷分布的村庄和水源地附近。旅人、商人和朝觐者往来阿拉伯南北时经过这里。旧屋、枣椰树和设防宅院反映了定居社群的生活。

english: Rao is a Papuan language of the Ramu River region in northern New Guinea. Its speakers live in a landscape of forested hills and waterways draining towards the broad river valley. Rao is one of many languages associated with the Ramu and its tributaries, whose courses connect communities between the central highlands and the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 拉奥语是新几内亚北部拉穆河地区的一种巴布亚语言。使用者居住在森林山丘与水道之间，水流汇向宽广的河谷。拉奥语是拉穆河及其支流一带众多语言之一；河道将中央高地与北岸之间的社群联系起来。

english:
Rapa Nui is a remote volcanic island in the southeastern Pacific, settled by Polynesian voyagers centuries before European contact. Its people carved monumental stone figures, or moai, from the volcanic tuff of Rano Raraku and raised them on ceremonial platforms called ahu. Villages, gardens and ritual sites formed a distinctive island landscape.

On Easter Sunday 1722 the Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen reached the island, giving it the European name Easter Island. Spanish visitors followed in 1770, and James Cook came in 1774. Cook’s party observed that some statues had fallen, while others remained standing. Ritual life also included the tangata manu, or birdman, competition associated with Orongo and offshore islets. These traditions reveal a society whose history continued to change after the great statues had been carved.
simp_chinese:
拉帕努伊是东南太平洋一座偏远的火山岛，波利尼西亚航行者在欧洲人接触前数世纪便已定居。岛民从拉诺拉拉库的火山凝灰岩中雕刻巨大的摩艾石像，将其立在称为阿胡的礼仪台上。村落、园地与仪式场所组成了独特的岛屿景观。

1722年复活节，荷兰航海者雅各布·罗赫芬抵达此岛，赋予它复活节岛的欧洲名称。西班牙访客于1770年到来，詹姆斯·库克于1774年来访。库克一行见到一些石像已经倒下，另一些仍然矗立。仪式生活还包括与奥龙戈及近海小岛相关的鸟人竞赛。这些传统显示，巨大石像雕成之后，岛上社会的历史仍在变化。

english: Rapa Nui is a remote volcanic island in the eastern Pacific, settled by Polynesian voyagers. Its people carved monumental stone figures, or moai, and raised them on ceremonial platforms along the coast. In 1722 the Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen reached the island on Easter Sunday; Spanish, British and French expeditions followed in 1770, 1774 and 1786.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊是东太平洋一座偏远的火山岛，由波利尼西亚航海者定居。岛民雕刻巨大的石像“摩艾”，将它们立在沿岸的祭祀平台上。1722年，荷兰航海家雅各布·罗赫芬于复活节抵达此岛；西班牙、英国和法国探险队分别于1770年、1774年和1786年随后到访。

english: East of Rapa Nui, the open Pacific stretches toward South America. The island to the west was settled by Polynesian voyagers, whose descendants raised monumental moai on stone platforms. Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen reached Rapa Nui in 1722 and named it Easter Island.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊以东的开阔太平洋向南美洲延伸。西面的岛屿由波利尼西亚航海者定居，其后裔在石台上竖起巨大的摩艾石像。荷兰航海家雅各布·罗赫芬于1722年抵达拉帕努伊，称其为复活节岛。

english: Northeast of Rapa Nui, open water surrounds one of Polynesia’s most remote islands. Its inhabitants carved moai and erected them on ceremonial stone platforms. In 1722 Jacob Roggeveen’s Dutch expedition reached the island on Easter Sunday, giving it the European name Easter Island.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊东北方的开阔水域环绕着波利尼西亚最偏远的岛屿之一。岛民雕刻摩艾石像，将它们立在祭祀石台上。1722年，雅各布·罗赫芬的荷兰船队于复活节抵达此岛，给它留下复活节岛的欧洲名称。

english: North of Rapa Nui, the eastern Pacific extends far beyond the island’s volcanic shore. Polynesian settlers and their descendants shaped a distinctive island society, raising great stone moai. Jacob Roggeveen reached the island in 1722; James Cook and La Pérouse visited later in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊以北，东太平洋远远延伸至岛屿火山海岸之外。波利尼西亚移民及其后裔塑造了独特的岛屿社会，并竖起巨大的摩艾石像。雅各布·罗赫芬于1722年抵达该岛；詹姆斯·库克和拉佩鲁兹在十八世纪稍后到访。

english: Northwest of Rapa Nui, vast distances of open ocean separate the island from the rest of eastern Polynesia. Its Polynesian inhabitants carved and erected monumental stone moai. The Dutch expedition of Jacob Roggeveen reached Rapa Nui in 1722, followed by other European voyages later that century.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊西北方，辽阔的开阔大洋将此岛与东波利尼西亚其他地区隔开。岛上的波利尼西亚居民雕刻并竖立了巨大的摩艾石像。雅各布·罗赫芬的荷兰船队于1722年抵达拉帕努伊，同世纪稍后还有其他欧洲航行到访。

english: West of Rapa Nui, the Pacific stretches across the long distance to other Polynesian islands. Voyagers settled Rapa Nui before European contact, and their descendants carved the island’s great stone moai. In 1722 Jacob Roggeveen reached its coast on Easter Sunday.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊以西，太平洋横亘在该岛与其他波利尼西亚岛屿之间。欧洲人接触之前，航海者已在拉帕努伊定居，其后裔雕刻了岛上巨大的摩艾石像。1722年，雅各布·罗赫芬于复活节抵达其海岸。

english: South of Rapa Nui, the open Pacific surrounds a remote volcanic island settled by Polynesian voyagers. Its inhabitants raised stone moai on ceremonial platforms. In 1722 the Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen reached the island, which later European visitors called Easter Island.
simp_chinese: 拉帕努伊以南的开阔太平洋环绕着一座由波利尼西亚航海者定居的偏远火山岛。岛民在祭祀平台上竖起摩艾石像。1722年，荷兰航海家雅各布·罗赫芬抵达此岛，后来的欧洲访客称之为复活节岛。

english:
Rapayán stands on a ridge above the upper Marañón valley, east of the Cordillera Blanca. Stone buildings and burial structures occupy the slopes and heights, overlooking the river basin and the steep mountain valleys that lead towards it. Excavations have found evidence of a remarkably long occupation, extending from ancient pre-Inca times into the period of Inca rule.

The Inca occupied Rapayán directly during the fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries. Its buildings were used as homes, but excavations also revealed that important funerary rites took place within them. Burial towers, or chullpas, appear in this and other highland settlements of Áncash, reflecting the significance of ancestors in the landscape. Rapayán may have continued to be occupied into the early colonial period, after the Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese:
拉帕扬位于科迪勒拉布兰卡山脉以东，坐落在马拉尼翁河上游河谷之上的山脊上。石砌建筑和墓葬分布于山坡及高处，俯瞰河流盆地和通向盆地的陡峭山谷。发掘发现这里有极长时间的居住证据，从古代前印加时期延续至印加统治时期。

十五至十六世纪初，印加人直接占据拉帕扬。建筑既用作住宅，发掘也表明其中举行过重要的丧葬仪式。称为丘尔帕的墓塔见于此地及安卡什其他高地聚落，体现了祖先在当地景观中的重要地位。拉帕扬可能一直有人居住到西班牙征服之后的殖民早期。

english: Raphoe is an old ecclesiastical centre in the fertile country of eastern Donegal. Its cathedral and bishop's residence reflect the town's long role as a seat of church authority. In the early seventeenth century Bishop Andrew Knox undertook repairs to the cathedral; his successor John Leslie built a fortified palace in the 1630s. The bishop's castle was besieged during the rising of 1641, and Leslie held it until relieved. It faced another siege during the Cromwellian conquest and surrendered in 1650, bringing the wars of the century to the bishop's own residence.
simp_chinese: 拉福是多尼戈尔东部肥沃地区的古老教会中心。座堂与主教驻所反映了城镇长期作为教会权威所在地的地位。十七世纪初，安德鲁·诺克斯主教着手修缮座堂；继任者约翰·莱斯利在1630年代建造设防主教宫。1641年起义期间，主教城堡遭围，莱斯利坚守直到获援。克伦威尔征服期间，城堡再遭围攻，于1650年投降，战争波及了主教的住所。

english: Rapla appears in the Danish Census Book of 1241 as a small village in northern Estonia. A stone church was established here in the thirteenth century and became the centre of a parish serving the surrounding countryside. During the Great Northern War the church burned down to its walls; it was restored by 1738. Rapla's manor, recorded from 1412, became a separate estate from Alu in 1705. Late eighteenth-century maps show two villages bearing the name, one by the church and another to the west.
simp_chinese: 拉普拉作为爱沙尼亚北部的小村庄，见于1241年的《丹麦户籍册》。十三世纪，这里建起石造教堂，成为周围乡村的教区中心。大北方战争期间，教堂被烧得仅剩墙壁，至1738年修复。拉普拉庄园自1412年见于记载，1705年从阿卢庄园分出，成为独立地产。十八世纪末的地图上有两个同名村落，一个在教堂附近，另一个位于西面。

english: The Rapoisi jungle belongs to Bougainville’s forested interior, where mountain ridges rise above the island’s coastal plains. Rivers descend through steep valleys to the sea on both sides of the long island. Forest, gardens and paths formed the setting for diverse communities speaking several distinct Papuan and Austronesian languages.
simp_chinese: 拉波伊西丛林位于布干维尔森林覆盖的内陆，山脊在沿海平原后方升起。河流穿过陡峭河谷，流向狭长岛屿两侧的海洋。森林、园地与小径构成多样社群的生活环境，岛上使用数种不同的巴布亚语言和南岛语言。

english:
The Rappahannock River flows eastward through Virginia to Chesapeake Bay. In the early seventeenth century the Rappahannock people held towns on both banks, with their principal settlement at Topahanocke. They spoke an Algonquian language and stood on the margins of the Powhatan Confederacy. John Smith met them during his explorations of the river country in 1607 and 1608.

English settlement along the river increased in the 1650s, and the Rappahannock withdrew from its southern bank. Their leader Taweeren was killed in a dispute with colonists in 1654; further boundary disputes followed under his successor Wachicopa. By 1669 the people had moved to the headwaters of the Mattaponi River. In 1684 the Virginia colonial government ordered them to join the Portobacco people farther up the Rappahannock.
simp_chinese:
拉帕汉诺克河向东流过弗吉尼亚，注入切萨皮克湾。十七世纪初，拉帕汉诺克人在河流两岸拥有城镇，主要聚落位于托帕哈诺克。他们使用阿尔冈昆语，处在波瓦坦联盟的边缘。1607至1608年，约翰·史密斯探索这片河流地区时与他们相遇。

1650年代，英国人沿河定居日益增多，拉帕汉诺克人从南岸退走。1654年，他们的首领陶韦伦在与殖民者的争执中被杀，其继任者瓦奇科帕时期边界争端仍未平息。到1669年，居民已迁往马塔波尼河源一带。1684年，殖民政府又命令他们与拉帕汉诺克河上游的波托巴科人合居。

english:
Raqchi stands beside the Vilcanota River south of Cuzco, beneath the volcanic mountain Kinsach’ata. Its most striking Inca building is a vast rectangular structure identified in colonial accounts as the Temple of Viracocha. A high central wall of stone and adobe once supported its roof, while planned enclosures and courtyards lay nearby.

The complex also contains a large walled area filled with rows of circular buildings, traditionally interpreted as storehouses for crops and other goods. Their number and orderly arrangement show the importance of Raqchi within the imperial landscape. The settlement stood on a route through the southern highlands, joining ceremonial architecture with spaces used to organise people and resources. Its massive surviving wall remains a landmark above the valley.
simp_chinese:
拉克奇位于库斯科以南的维尔卡诺塔河畔，背靠金萨查塔火山。最醒目的印加建筑是一座巨大的长方形建筑，殖民时期的记载称之为维拉科查神庙。石头与土坯筑成的高大中央墙曾支撑屋顶，附近还有规划整齐的围屋与庭院。

建筑群还包括一片宽大的围墙区，内有成排圆形建筑，通常被解释为存放农产品和其他物资的仓库。其数量与整齐布局显示了拉克奇在帝国中的重要性。聚落位于通往南部高地的道路上，将礼仪建筑与组织人力和资源的空间结合起来。高大的残墙至今是河谷上的地标。

english:
Raqqa stands beside the Euphrates near the mouth of the Balikh. The Abbasids built the walled city of al-Rafiqa beside the older settlement, and Harun al-Rashid made the area his residence for part of his reign. Palaces, mosques and markets spread across the river plain, while potters became renowned for glazed ceramics. The massive brick walls of al-Rafiqa and the Baghdad Gate recall the city's former splendour.

Raqqa declined after the Mongol invasions and much of the old city was left in ruins. In the sixteenth century it reappeared in Ottoman records as a customs station and small riverside settlement. The citadel was partly restored in 1683 and housed a Janissary detachment; in the following decades the province became a centre of Ottoman efforts to settle tribal communities. The river continued to connect the surviving settlement with the towns of the Euphrates, even as its inhabited area remained far smaller than the Abbasid city.
simp_chinese:
拉卡位于幼发拉底河畔，靠近巴利赫河汇入口。阿拔斯王朝在旧聚落旁修建了有城墙的拉菲卡城，哈伦·拉希德曾在位期间居住于此。宫殿、清真寺和市场遍布河边平原，当地陶工烧制的釉陶也广受称誉。拉菲卡厚重的砖墙和巴格达门，仍令人想起这座城市昔日的繁华。

蒙古入侵之后，拉卡衰落，大片旧城化为废墟。十六世纪，奥斯曼文献再次提及此地，称它是幼发拉底河畔的小聚落和税关。1683年城堡得到部分修复，并驻有一队耶尼切里士兵；此后数十年，拉卡行省成为奥斯曼安置部族政策的一个中心。尽管有人居住的范围远小于阿拔斯时代，河流依旧将它与幼发拉底河沿岸城镇联系起来。

english: Raraka, also called Te Marie, is an oval atoll in the western Tuamotus. Small coral islets and sandbanks stand on the reef around a broad lagoon, which has a navigable passage to the sea. In 1831 Captain Ireland sighted Raraka, an inhabited island in a chain long traversed by Polynesian voyagers.
simp_chinese: 拉拉卡又称特马里，是土阿莫土群岛西部的椭圆形环礁。珊瑚小岛与沙洲立于宽阔潟湖的礁缘上，一条可航行的水道通向外海。1831年，艾尔兰船长望见拉拉卡；这座已有居民的岛屿位于波利尼西亚航行者长期穿越的岛链中。

english:
The Raritan River runs east across New Jersey to the bay that shares its name. Its branches rise in the hills of the interior, joining to form a river that becomes tidal near New Brunswick. The Raritan people belonged to the Lenape communities of the surrounding country; their name was applied both to the river and to the bay at its mouth.

Dutch records used the name Raritan for several groups. The Sanhicans lived west of the bay before attacks in the 1640s drove them inland. In 1649 Wisquaskecks moved into the area and came to be known by the same name. Relations with the Dutch had already been marked by violence: the Raritan were among the peoples drawn into Kieft's War of 1643–1645, a conflict between New Netherland and its Indigenous neighbours.
simp_chinese:
拉里坦河横穿新泽西向东流入同名海湾。它的支流发源于内陆丘陵，汇合后形成大河，在新不伦瑞克附近进入潮汐区。拉里坦人属于周围地区的莱纳佩社群，他们的名字也被用于河流与河口的海湾。

荷兰人的记录以拉里坦称呼几个不同群体。桑希坎人原住在海湾西侧，十七世纪四十年代遭受袭击，被迫迁往内陆。1649年，维斯夸斯凯克人迁入这一地区，也被称为拉里坦人。他们与荷兰人的关系此前已有暴力冲突：在1643年至1645年新尼德兰与原住民邻族之间的基夫特战争中，拉里坦人也是卷入战事的族群之一。

english: Raritan Bay lies south of Staten Island, where the Raritan River meets the waters of the lower New York harbor. The bay takes its name from the Raritan people, a Lenape community who lived along its shores and river before Dutch and English colonization. Large shell middens around the bay and on Staten Island preserve traces of generations who gathered food from these waters. Sandy Hook extends along the bay's eastern approach toward the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 拉里坦湾位于斯塔滕岛南侧，拉里坦河在此汇入纽约港下部水域。海湾得名于拉里坦人，这是一个在荷兰与英国殖民之前居住于海岸和河畔的莱纳佩社群。海湾周围及斯塔滕岛上的大型贝壳堆，留下了世代居民从水中采集食物的痕迹。桑迪胡克沙嘴沿海湾东侧延伸，面向大西洋。

english: Northwest of the Society Islands, the open Pacific Ocean surrounds their remote western coral atolls. Polynesian navigators knew the broader archipelago long before European contact. James Cook visited Huahine and Raiatea in 1769 with the Polynesian navigator and priest Tupaia aboard.
simp_chinese: 社会群岛西北方的开阔太平洋环绕其偏远的西部珊瑚环礁。与欧洲人接触之前，波利尼西亚航海者早已熟悉更广阔的群岛。1769年，詹姆斯·库克载着波利尼西亚航海家兼祭司图帕亚到访胡阿希内和赖阿特阿。

english:
The waters of the southern Polynesian island world connect scattered land through routes shaped by wind, swell, and navigational skill. Reefs, lagoons, and small islands offer resources, while open passages demand careful supplies and reliable boats. Communities use fishing and garden production close to home, but longer journeys depend on knowledge that makes distant shores reachable. The sea can sustain relationships while also imposing serious risks when weather or plans change.

During the late medieval and early modern centuries, Polynesian societies maintained histories of ancestry, migration, exchange, and religious connection across the ocean. Canoe building and navigation were embedded in social institutions that preserved expertise and organized responsibility. Chiefs and communities used voyages to sustain alliances and circulate valued goods. European ships increasingly entered parts of the South Pacific during the eighteenth century, bringing new objects, observations, and political or religious interests to an established maritime world.
simp_chinese:
南部波利尼西亚的海路连接分散的岛屿，航行受到风向、涌浪和领航技术的影响。礁区、潟湖及小岛提供资源，穿越外海则需要充足补给和可靠船只。居民在岛屿附近捕鱼、耕种，长途旅程依赖通往远岸的知识，也需要应对天气变化带来的风险。

中世纪后期至近代早期，波利尼西亚社会保留跨洋祖先、迁徙、交换和宗教联系的历史。造舟与领航依靠保存经验、分配责任的社会制度；首领和社群通过航行维持联盟、传递贵重物品。十八世纪，更多欧洲船只进入南太平洋部分海域，为已有的海洋网络带来新物品、观察及政治和宗教利益。

english: North of the western Society Islands, open Pacific waters extend beyond the reefs of Bora Bora and its neighbours. Polynesian communities inhabited these islands long before James Cook’s voyage in 1769. Cook grouped Bora Bora, Huahine, Raiatea and nearby islands under the name Society Isles.
simp_chinese: 社会群岛西部以北的开阔太平洋水域延伸至波拉波拉及邻岛的珊瑚礁之外。詹姆斯·库克于1769年航行到此之前，波利尼西亚社群早已在这些岛屿生活。库克将波拉波拉、胡阿希内、赖阿特阿及邻岛合称社会群岛。

english: North of Huahine, open water separates the western Society Islands from the Tuamotu atolls. James Cook visited Huahine in 1769 with Tupaia, a Polynesian navigator and priest. Islanders approached his ship more readily after recognising Tupaia, who knew their language and island world.
simp_chinese: 胡阿希内以北的开阔水域将社会群岛西部与土阿莫土环礁隔开。1769年，詹姆斯·库克与波利尼西亚航海家兼祭司图帕亚到访胡阿希内。岛民认出熟悉他们语言和岛屿世界的图帕亚后，更愿意接近船只。

english: South of the western Society Islands, the Pacific stretches between their volcanic shores and the Austral group. Polynesian voyagers maintained relationships between the archipelagos long before European arrival. In 1769 James Cook left the Society Islands and passed Rurutu without landing.
simp_chinese: 社会群岛西部以南，太平洋延伸在火山海岸与南方群岛之间。欧洲人到来之前，波利尼西亚航海者早已维持两组群岛的联系。1769年，詹姆斯·库克离开社会群岛，经过鲁鲁图时没有登陆。

english: Southwest of the Society Islands, open water lies between the group’s western atolls and the Cook Islands. Polynesian navigators crossed this ocean long before European expeditions. In 1773 James Cook sailed west from the Society Islands and sighted Manuae in the southern Cook group.
simp_chinese: 社会群岛西南方的开阔水域位于该群岛西部环礁与库克群岛之间。欧洲探险队到来之前，波利尼西亚航海者早已横渡这片海洋。1773年，詹姆斯·库克从社会群岛向西航行，望见库克群岛南部的曼努埃。

english: West of the Society Islands, the Pacific separates their outlying coral atolls from the southern Cook Islands. In 1773 James Cook sailed west from the Society group and sighted Manuae, an inhabited atoll whose two principal islets he called the Hervey Islands.
simp_chinese: 社会群岛以西，太平洋将外围珊瑚环礁与库克群岛南部隔开。1773年，詹姆斯·库克从社会群岛向西航行，望见有人居住的曼努埃环礁；他将其两座主要小岛称为赫维群岛。

english: Raroia is a coral atoll in the central Tuamotus, its long reef enclosing a lagoon dotted with coral formations. Polynesian islanders had long known the atoll before European voyages reached it. In 1820 Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen recorded Raroia during the expedition of the Vostok and Mirny.
simp_chinese: 拉罗亚是土阿莫土群岛中部的珊瑚环礁，长礁围住点缀着珊瑚构造的潟湖。欧洲航行抵达之前，波利尼西亚岛民早已熟悉这个环礁。1820年，法比安·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋在东方号与和平号的探险航行中记录了拉罗亚。

english:
Rarotonga is a mountainous volcanic island in the southern Cook Islands, its valleys descending to a reef-fringed coast. Polynesian communities established settlements and chiefly lineages here before European ships arrived. Oral traditions remember voyaging ancestors and their relationships with other islands across the Pacific. The island’s valleys supplied cultivated food, while the surrounding reef and open sea provided fish and other resources.

In 1823 Papeiha, a Christian convert from Bora Bora, came to Rarotonga after working on Aitutaki. His mission opened a period of religious and political change among the island’s communities, while the older chiefly titles and land relationships remained central to local life. The island’s steep interior and narrow coastal belt framed these communities and their connections by sea.

The later city of Avarua lies here.
simp_chinese:
拉罗汤加是库克群岛南部的多山火山岛，山谷下降至礁盘环绕的海岸。欧洲船只抵达前，波利尼西亚社群已在此建立聚落与首领世系。口述传统记述了远航的祖先及他们与太平洋其他岛屿的关系。岛上山谷提供耕种的食物，周围的礁盘与开阔海洋则出产鱼类等资源。

1823年，来自波拉波拉的基督徒帕佩伊哈在艾图塔基传教后来到拉罗汤加。他的传教开启了岛上社群宗教与政治变化的时期，而较早的首领称号及土地关系仍是当地生活的核心。陡峭内陆与狭窄沿岸地带构成了社群及其海上联系的地理环境。

后来的阿瓦鲁阿即位于此地。

english: Ras al-Ain lies west of Tlemcen, near the site of the fortified town of Mansourah. The Marinid sultan Abu Yaqub Yusuf established Mansourah as a siege camp in 1299, building a mosque, palace and walls opposite Tlemcen. After his death in 1307 the siege was abandoned. In 1335 Abu al-Hasan began another siege, and the Marinids later made Mansourah a seat of government.
simp_chinese: 拉斯艾因位于特莱姆森以西，靠近曼苏拉设防城镇的遗址。1299年，马林苏丹阿布·雅各布·优素福为围攻特莱姆森建立曼苏拉营地，在城对面修建清真寺、宫殿和城墙。1307年他死后，围攻随之解除。1335年，阿布·哈桑再次发起围攻，马林王朝后来一度以曼苏拉为统治中心。

english:
Ras al-Ayn takes its name, the Spring-head, from the many springs that feed the Khabur River. Known as Resaina in Roman times and Resh'ayna in Syriac, the town stood among gardens watered by clear streams. Medieval geographers admired the springs, whose water turned mills and irrigated orchards before joining the river. An important settlement of the Jazira, it also supported a Syriac bishopric and monasteries.

The town changed hands repeatedly in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries as Zengids, Ayyubids and Khwarazmians struggled over northern Mesopotamia. Timur's forces plundered it in the late fourteenth century. Despite these upheavals, the springs remained the defining feature of the place: Yaqut described their clear pools and recounted how small boats had once carried people from garden to garden and downstream along the Khabur.
simp_chinese:
拉斯艾因的名字意为“泉源”，得自汇入哈布尔河的众多泉水。罗马时期这里称为雷萨伊纳，叙利亚语称雷什艾纳，城镇坐落在清泉灌溉的园圃之间。中世纪地理学家赞叹这些泉水：它们推动磨坊、浇灌果园，随后汇成河流。这座杰济拉的重要聚落也拥有叙利亚教会的主教座堂和修道院。

十二至十三世纪，赞吉、阿尤布和花剌子模诸势力争夺北美索不达米亚，城镇屡次易手。十四世纪末，帖木儿的军队洗劫了这里。尽管战乱不断，泉水仍是当地最鲜明的特色：雅库特描绘过清澈的泉池，并记述过去人们曾乘小船往来园圃，甚至沿哈布尔河顺流而下。

english: Ra’s el-Mā’ stands near the western end of the Faguibine basin, a chain of lakes linked to the Niger by seasonal channels. When the river floods strongly, water passes through the basin and spreads over the low ground, supporting cultivation and fishing along its shores. The settlement also lay on a route connecting Walata with Timbuktu and Djenné. It thus belonged both to the lake country of the inland delta and to the caravan world of the southern Sahara.
simp_chinese: 拉斯埃尔马位于法吉宾盆地西端附近，湖泊通过季节性水道与尼日尔河相连。河水大涨时，洪水流入盆地并漫过低地，支持沿岸的耕种与捕鱼。聚落也位于连接瓦拉塔、廷巴克图和杰内的道路上。因此，它既属于内陆三角洲的湖区，也属于撒哈拉南缘的商队世界。

sources.title: Vol 5. Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century editor B.A.OGOT(FILEminimizer).pdf

english: Ras Gharib lies on the African shore of the Gulf of Suez, where the Eastern Desert meets the Red Sea. The coast is backed by arid mountains and crossed by dry valleys descending toward the water. Routes through the desert connected the Nile Valley with Red Sea harbors, allowing caravans to reach the coast. The gulf forms the northern arm of the Red Sea, opposite the Sinai Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 拉斯加里卜位于苏伊士湾的非洲海岸，东部沙漠在此与红海相接。海岸背靠干旱山脉，干谷向海边延伸。穿越沙漠的道路连接尼罗河谷与红海港口，使商队能够抵达海岸。苏伊士湾是红海的北部海湾之一，与西奈半岛隔水相望。

english: Ras Hafun projects into the Indian Ocean on the eastern side of the Horn of Africa. The headland is commonly identified with Opone, a trading place described in the ancient Periplus of the Erythraean Sea. Ships reached its shore on voyages around the Horn, exchanging goods that included spices, ivory, animal skins and incense. The exposed coast lies in the path of winds and currents that change with the monsoon.
simp_chinese: 哈丰角从非洲之角东侧伸入印度洋。人们通常将这处海角与古代《厄立特里亚海周航记》所记载的贸易地奥波涅联系起来。船只绕过非洲之角来到这里，交换香料、象牙、兽皮和香料树脂等货物。这段开阔海岸处在随季风变化的风与海流路径上。

english: Ras Kebdana is a coastal headland in northeastern Morocco, near the mouth of the Moulouya River. The river reaches the Mediterranean through a low estuary and floodplain, while the Kebdana hills rise to the west. Sandy shores and coastal wetlands lie between the mountains and the sea. The estuary carries water from a wide inland basin to this part of the Mediterranean coast.
simp_chinese: 凯卜达纳角是摩洛哥东北部的一处海岸岬角，靠近穆卢亚河口。河流经过低平的河口和泛滥平原注入地中海，凯卜达纳丘陵则在西方隆起。沙岸和沿海湿地位于山地与海洋之间，河口将广阔内陆流域的水带到这一段地中海海岸。

english: Ras Lanuf lies on the southern shore of the Gulf of Sirte, where the Mediterranean meets the dry Libyan desert. This broad gulf cuts deeply into the North African coast, and its shores are bordered by sandy plains and salt depressions. Rainfall is scarce compared with the country around Tripoli, and vegetation is adapted to the arid conditions. The coast forms a long passage between Tripolitania to the west and Cyrenaica to the east.
simp_chinese: 拉斯拉努夫位于锡尔特湾南岸，地中海在此与干燥的利比亚沙漠相接。宽广的海湾深深切入北非海岸，岸边分布着沙质平原与盐洼。与的黎波里周边相比，这里降雨稀少，植被适应干旱环境。这段漫长海岸连接西方的的黎波里塔尼亚和东方的昔兰尼加。

english:
Ras Mkumbuu lies at the end of a long peninsula on the western shore of Pemba. Here stood a Swahili settlement whose remains include a large mosque, wells, house foundations and elaborate pillar tombs. Archaeological evidence shows occupation in the tenth to twelfth centuries and again from the fourteenth to sixteenth centuries. Its position facing the mainland placed it within the busy maritime world of the East African coast.

The later city of Chake-Chake lies here.
simp_chinese:
拉斯姆昆布位于奔巴岛西岸一条狭长半岛的尽头。这里曾有斯瓦希里聚落，遗迹包括大型清真寺、水井、住宅地基和装饰精美的柱状墓。考古证据显示这里在十至十二世纪有人居住，十四至十六世纪又出现另一阶段的聚落。面向大陆的位置，使它处于繁忙的东非海岸海上世界之中。

后来的查凯查凯即位于此地。

english:
Rasanga was a riverside village in the country of Mananghare on Madagascar's southeastern coast. The traveller Leguével de Lacombe described reaching it by canoe after following the river southwest from its mouth. Farther upstream stood Fifahoumé, the principal village of the district, on a mountain crest. The river linked the coastal settlements with the inland seat of a local chief, Razouma, whose country the traveller described as fertile.

The later city of Farafangana lies here.
simp_chinese:
拉桑加是马达加斯加东南岸马南加雷地区的一座河畔村落。旅行者勒盖韦尔·德·拉孔布记述，他乘独木舟从河口沿河向西南行进，抵达了这里。更上游的山脊上坐落着该地区的主要村落菲法乌梅。河流将沿海聚落同地方首领拉祖马在内陆的居所连接起来；这位旅行者描述其领地土地肥沃。

后来的法拉凡加纳即位于此地。

english: Raseiniai is an old centre of Samogitia, first mentioned in 1253. Its position in the western Lithuanian countryside gave it a lasting role in the administration of the region. From 1585 the local assembly of the Samogitian nobility met here regularly, making the town a place where the affairs of the duchy were debated and its representatives chosen. Raseiniai received municipal rights in 1792, during the final years of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. The town's history is thus closely bound to the institutions through which Samogitia retained its distinctive place within Lithuania.
simp_chinese: 拉塞尼艾是萨莫吉蒂亚的古老中心，最早见于1253年的记载。它位于立陶宛西部的乡间，长期在地方行政中占有重要地位。从1585年起，萨莫吉蒂亚贵族的地方议会定期在此召开，商议公国事务并选派代表。1792年，在波兰立陶宛联邦存续的最后几年，拉塞尼艾获得城市自治权。城镇的历史与萨莫吉蒂亚的地方机构密切相连，后者使这一地区在立陶宛内部保有独特地位。

english:
Rashid, known to Europeans as Rosetta, stands near the mouth of the western branch of the Nile. Its position between river and sea made it a port for the fertile western Delta and a meeting place for merchants travelling to and from the Mediterranean. Mosques, houses and warehouses reflected the prosperity of a town whose life was closely tied to the river.

Following the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517, Rashid became an important port for commerce with the Ottoman lands. In 1799, during the French occupation of Egypt, Lieutenant Pierre-François Bouchard found an inscribed stone while fortifications were being repaired near the town. The decree on the Rosetta Stone appeared in Greek, Demotic and hieroglyphs. Comparing the scripts later helped scholars unlock ancient Egyptian writing.
simp_chinese:
拉希德在欧洲人那里称为罗塞塔，位于尼罗河西支河口附近。它处在河流与大海之间，是肥沃的西部三角洲的港口，也是往来地中海的商人聚集之地。清真寺、住宅和仓库体现了这座与河流息息相关的城镇的繁荣。

1517年奥斯曼人征服埃及后，拉希德成为与奥斯曼各地通商的重要港口。1799年法国占领埃及期间，中尉皮埃尔－弗朗索瓦·布沙尔在城镇附近修筑防御工事时发现一块刻有文字的石碑。罗塞塔石碑上的诏令分别以希腊文、世俗体和象形文字书写；后来学者通过比较这些文字，逐渐解开了古埃及文字之谜。

english:
Rasht lies in the humid lowlands of Gilan south of the Caspian Sea, where heavy rain, rice fields, mulberry groves and forested hills set the region apart from the dry Iranian plateau. Its bazaars gathered rice, silk cocoons and raw silk from the villages, and the city became the commercial heart of Gilan, a border town between the Caspian shore and the road up to Qazvin.

Tradition dates the city's founding to 1494, but it grew mainly in the sixteenth century, while Gilan was divided between local rulers. After Abbas I conquered Gilan in 1592, Rasht became the provincial capital and a major centre of the Safavid silk trade, with Armenian, English and Dutch merchants buying silk here for export. In 1669 the Cossack leader Stenka Razin raided the city. Russian troops occupied Rasht and the rest of Gilan from 1722, and many of them died of fever in the marshes. The Treaty of Rasht in 1732 returned Gilan and the other southern Caspian provinces to Persia.
simp_chinese:
拉什特位于里海以南吉兰的湿润低地，丰沛的降雨、稻田、桑林和森林覆盖的山丘使这里与干燥的伊朗高原截然不同。它的巴扎汇集着乡村送来的稻米、蚕茧和生丝，使拉什特成为吉兰的商业中心，也是里海沿岸与通往加兹温的道路之间的边境城镇。

传说这座城市建于1494年，但主要在16世纪发展起来，当时吉兰分属多个地方统治者。1592年阿拔斯一世征服吉兰后，拉什特成为省会和萨法维王朝丝绸贸易的重要中心，亚美尼亚、英国和荷兰商人在此购买出口的生丝。1669年，哥萨克首领斯捷潘·拉辛袭击了这座城市。1722年起俄军占领拉什特及吉兰其他地区，许多士兵死于沼泽中的热病。1732年《拉什特条约》把吉兰和里海南岸的其他省份归还波斯。

english: Rasini, also known as Faza, lies on the northern side of Pate Island in the Lamu archipelago. Its Swahili community faced the channels and sheltered waters that connect the islands with the East African coast. The town shared an island with Pate, an important sultanate whose fortunes rose with trade and alliances on the mainland. Boats carried people and goods through the mangrove-fringed passages between the settlements.
simp_chinese: 拉西尼又称法扎，位于拉穆群岛帕泰岛北侧。斯瓦希里社群面向连接各岛与东非海岸的水道和避风水域。岛上还有帕泰城，其苏丹国因贸易和大陆联盟而兴盛。船只穿行于红树林环绕的水道，在各聚落之间运送人口和货物。

english: Rask lies beside the Sarbaz River in the mountains of Iranian Makran. The river cuts a long gorge through the arid ranges, passing numerous villages before reaching the coastal lowlands. Rainfall in the interior is irregular: floods can fill the channel after storms, while for much of the year water remains in deep pools. Fields and groves along the river stand out against the bare hills, forming a narrow inhabited corridor through the mountains towards the Sea of Oman.
simp_chinese: 拉斯克位于伊朗马克兰山区的萨尔巴兹河畔。河流穿过干旱山脉，切出一条漫长峡谷，流经众多村庄后抵达海岸低地。内陆降雨不规律：暴雨可使河道涨满洪水，一年大部分时间里则只剩深潭积水。河畔的田地和树林与光秃山丘形成对照，构成一条穿越群山、通向阿曼海的狭窄居住走廊。

english: Raskam lies in the upper valley of the Yarkand River, among the mountains north of the Karakoram. The river gathers glacial waters before cutting through deep, dry valleys on its way toward the Tarim Basin. Paths from Raskam lead into neighbouring mountain valleys, including the route toward the Shaksgam. The contrast between icy headwaters and barren slopes marks this remote corridor through the high ranges.
simp_chinese: 热斯喀木位于喀喇昆仑山以北的叶尔羌河上游谷地。河流汇集冰川融水，穿过深邃干燥的山谷，向塔里木盆地流去。从热斯喀木出发的小路通向邻近山谷，包括前往克勒青河的路线。冰冷河源与荒凉山坡相互映衬，构成群山中偏远通道的景观。

sources.title: 2011 The Apricot Road to Yarkand by Rashid s.pdf

english: Rasony lies in a wooded, lake-strewn region north of Polotsk. It was a private town belonging to the Lubomirski family, whose estates formed part of the landed society of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. A Jesuit mission was established here around 1764. In 1812, during Napoleon's invasion of Russia, French forces captured the town, bringing the wider struggle between the empires into this northern corner of the old Polotsk lands.
simp_chinese: 拉索内位于波洛茨克以北，周围森林密布、湖泊众多。它曾是卢博米尔斯基家族的私人城镇，其庄园属于波兰立陶宛联邦的地主社会。约1764年，耶稣会在此设立传教站。1812年拿破仑入侵俄罗斯期间，法军占领了这座城镇，帝国之间的战争由此波及古波洛茨克地区的北部一隅。

english: Rassawek was the principal town of the Monacan people, on the Piedmont above the fall line near the meeting of the James and Rivanna rivers. Monacan towns in the surrounding country gave it tribute, and the river fork made it a gathering place for families and traders within a homeland that reached from the James River falls toward the Blue Ridge. John Smith placed Rassawek and other Monacan towns on his map of Virginia, published in 1612, drawing on information gathered during English journeys upriver. The English settlers who spread into the Piedmont in the early eighteenth century gradually scattered the Monacan from their homeland, and the town ceased to be important.
simp_chinese: 拉萨维克是莫纳坎人的主要城镇，位于瀑布线以西的皮德蒙特高地上，靠近詹姆斯河与里瓦纳河的交汇处。周围的莫纳坎村镇向它纳贡，河口也使它成为一片家园中的会合之地，这片家园从詹姆斯河瀑布一直延伸到蓝岭。约翰·史密斯根据英国人溯河探险的见闻，在1612年出版的弗吉尼亚地图上标出了拉萨维克和其他莫纳坎城镇。十八世纪初，英国移民扩散到皮德蒙特，逐渐把莫纳坎人赶出故土，这座城镇也随之失去了重要性。

english: Rasshua is a volcanic island in the central Kurils, with three overlapping cones inside a caldera whose eastern rim lies beneath the sea. The Kuril Ainu maintained a village here and travelled to seasonal fishing camps on neighbouring islands. In the eighteenth century, Rasshua hunters pursued sea otters around their island as Russian expeditions moved south through the chain.
simp_chinese: 罗处和是千岛中部的火山岛，三座相叠的火山锥位于破火山口内，东缘没入海中。千岛阿伊努人在岛上有村落，并前往邻岛的季节性渔猎营地。18世纪，罗处和的猎人捕猎附近的海獭，而俄国探险队正沿群岛向南推进。

english: Rasskazovo arose in the wooded country east of Tambov at the end of the seventeenth century. The village is known from 1697, when Stepan Rasskaz, a peasant from the Morsha district, obtained a royal charter concerning its establishment. Originally called Lesnoy Tambov, it later took his name. Its appearance belonged to a wider movement of settlers into the forest-steppe beyond the fortified frontier, as the danger of raids on the Tambov district diminished.
simp_chinese: 拉斯卡佐沃于十七世纪末兴起在坦波夫以东的林地。1697年的文书记载了这座村庄，当时来自莫尔沙地区的农民斯捷潘·拉斯卡兹获得有关建村的沙皇特许状。村庄最初称为列斯诺伊坦波夫，后来以他的名字命名。随着坦波夫地区遭受袭击的危险减弱，移民逐渐进入防线以外的森林草原；拉斯卡佐沃正是在这一过程中出现的。

english: Rastyapino was a village in the bend of the Oka west of Nizhny Novgorod, where pine forests spread along the river. Documents show it already existed in 1607, and a 1615 survey records the village under the form Rostyapino. It was associated with an earlier settlement called Sukhaya Rechka, or Dry Stream. The Oka carried the waters of the Russian interior toward the Volga, while small villages occupied the wooded land along its banks.
simp_chinese: 拉斯佳皮诺是下诺夫哥罗德以西奥卡河曲处的村庄，松林沿河岸延伸。文献表明它在1607年已经存在；1615年的调查则以罗斯佳皮诺的形式记载了这个村庄。这里与一个更早名为苏哈亚列奇卡，即「干溪」的聚落有关。奥卡河将俄国内陆的水带往伏尔加河，小村庄则分布在两岸林地之间。

english: Rasyal stands on the Chenab River in the hills south of Kashmir. Tradition associates the old state of Bhimgarh with Bhim Dev, a Rajput ruler said to have established it in the eighth century. In 1810, amid unrest in Jammu during the reign of Diwan Singh, Ranjit Singh sent Gulab Singh to take control. After suppressing rebels in the Rasyal area, Gulab Singh entrusted its administration to his commander Zorawar Singh.
simp_chinese: 拉夏尔位于克什米尔以南的丘陵中，坐落在杰纳布河畔。相传古老的宾加尔邦由拉杰普特统治者宾姆·德夫于八世纪建立。1810年，迪万·辛格统治下的查谟发生动乱，兰吉特·辛格派古拉布·辛格前来掌控局势。古拉布·辛格平定拉夏尔一带的叛乱后，将这里的政务交给了麾下将领佐拉瓦尔·辛格。

english: North of the eastern Marshall Islands, open ocean separates low coral atolls from Eneen-Kio farther north. Marshallese oral tradition recalls voyages to Eneen-Kio to obtain seabird wing bones for tattooing chiefs. These journeys linked distant landfalls across the Pacific. Coral reefs fringe the low islands.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔群岛东部以北的开阔大洋将低矮珊瑚环礁与更北方的埃宁基奥隔开。马绍尔口述传统记得前往埃宁基奥取得海鸟翼骨、用于酋长刺青的航行。这些旅程跨越太平洋，将遥远陆地相连。低矮岛屿的边缘分布着珊瑚礁。

english: East of the northern Marshall atolls, the open Pacific extends beyond their low coral shores. Marshallese navigators maintained island connections long before European contact. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue’s expedition visited Wotje and other atolls of the eastern chain. Coral reefs fringe the low islands.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔北部环礁以东的开阔太平洋延伸至低矮珊瑚海岸之外。与欧洲人接触之前，马绍尔航海者早已维持岛际联系。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布的船队到访东部岛链的沃杰和其他环礁。低矮岛屿的边缘分布着珊瑚礁。

english: East of the northern Marshall Islands, the Pacific separates scattered coral atolls from distant landfalls. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue visited the eastern atolls and met Marshallese navigators. Their knowledge encompassed many neighbouring islands, including Wotje and Likiep. Coral reefs fringe the low islands.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔群岛北部以东，太平洋将零散珊瑚环礁与遥远陆地隔开。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布到访东部环礁，遇见马绍尔航海者。他们的知识涵盖沃杰、利基埃普等许多邻岛。低矮岛屿的边缘分布着珊瑚礁。

english: East of Wotje, open Pacific water extends beyond the eastern Marshall chain. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue’s expedition entered Wotje’s lagoon and met local navigators and chiefs. The navigator Lagediack drew a map identifying Wotje and neighbouring atolls. Coral reefs fringe the low islands.
simp_chinese: 沃杰以东的开阔太平洋水域延伸至马绍尔东部岛链之外。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布的船队进入沃杰潟湖，遇见当地航海者和酋长。航海者拉格迪亚克绘制地图，标出沃杰和邻近环礁。低矮岛屿的边缘分布着珊瑚礁。

english: East of Arno, the open Pacific extends beyond the eastern chain of Marshallese coral atolls. British ships under William Marshall and Thomas Gilbert sighted Arno in 1788 on a voyage toward China. Marshallese communities already maintained their own island connections across these waters.
simp_chinese: 阿尔诺以东的开阔太平洋延伸至马绍尔东部珊瑚环礁链之外。1788年，威廉·马绍尔与托马斯·吉尔伯特指挥的英国船只驶往中国时望见阿尔诺。马绍尔社群此前已跨越这些水域维持自己的岛际联系。

english: East of Mili, open ocean surrounds the southern atolls of the eastern Marshall chain. In 1788 British ships under William Marshall and Thomas Gilbert encountered people at Mili; islanders approached by canoe and traded with the crews before the ships sailed onward.
simp_chinese: 米利以东的开阔大洋环绕马绍尔东部岛链南端的环礁。1788年，威廉·马绍尔和托马斯·吉尔伯特指挥的英国船只在米利遇见居民；岛民乘独木舟靠近，与船员交易后船只继续航行。

english: Northwest of Bokak, the open ocean separates the northern Ratak atolls from distant Ānen Kio. Bokak and Bikar were traditionally hereditary possessions of the paramount chief of Ratak. People from other northern atolls visited these low reefs to collect birds, eggs and turtles under customary authority.
simp_chinese: 博卡克西北方的开阔海洋将拉塔克北部环礁与遥远的阿嫩基奥分开。博卡克和比卡尔传统上是拉塔克最高酋长的世袭领地。北方其他环礁的居民依照习俗前往这些低礁，采集海鸟、鸟卵和海龟。

english: Northwest of the Marshall Islands, open Pacific water stretches toward the distant atoll of Eneen-Kio. Marshallese oral tradition recounts voyages there to collect seabird wing bones used in chiefly tattooing. The low islands lay far beyond the main Marshall atoll chains.
simp_chinese: 马绍尔群岛西北方的开阔太平洋水域向遥远的埃宁基奥环礁延伸。马绍尔口述传统讲述前往那里采集海鸟翼骨、用于酋长刺青的航行。低矮岛屿远在马绍尔主要环礁链之外。

english: Ratchaburi lies on the Mae Klong River, west of the Chao Phraya plain. Its long history is reflected in Wat Mahathat, a sanctuary near the heart of the old town. Archaeological evidence points to a Dvaravati settlement, followed by Khmer influence: a laterite enclosure and a Khmer-style sanctuary were built around the thirteenth century. In the early Ayutthaya period a principal prang and three subsidiary towers were added. South of the town, the ancient site of Khu Bua preserves further remains of Dvaravati religious buildings.
simp_chinese: 叻武里位于湄南河平原以西的美功河畔。它悠久的历史体现在旧城中心附近的玛哈泰寺。考古发现显示这里先有堕罗钵底聚落，后来受到高棉影响：约十三世纪，人们修建了红土岩围墙和高棉式圣殿。阿瑜陀耶早期又增建一座主塔和三座附塔。城南的古代库布阿遗址还保留着堕罗钵底宗教建筑的遗存。

english: The country around Rath and Sarila lies in the plains of Bundelkhand south of the Yamuna. Sarila became the seat of a small Bundela principality founded by Aman Singh, a descendant of the powerful chief Chhatrasal. Aman occupied the place and built a fort in the middle of the eighteenth century. In 1807 its ruler received a British grant of villages, securing a small estate amid the changing political order of Bundelkhand.
simp_chinese: 拉特与萨里拉周围的地区位于亚穆纳河以南的本德尔肯德平原。萨里拉成为一个小型本德拉邦国的驻地，创建者阿曼·辛格是强大的首领查特拉萨尔的后代。阿曼于十八世纪中叶占据此地并修筑堡垒。1807年，当地统治者获得英国授予的若干村庄，在本德尔肯德不断变化的政治秩序中保有一片小领地。

sources.title: The Imperial Gazetteer of India Vol-21 (Pushkar to Salween).pdf

english:
Ratlam lies in western Malwa, where the central Indian plateau connects routes between Gujarat, Rajasthan and the northern Deccan. Its surrounding countryside supported agriculture, livestock and exchange, while roads drew merchants and travellers through the district. Markets benefited from this position between larger regional economies. Local communities lived within a landscape shaped by Rajput households, cultivated villages and the changing demands of states seeking revenue from the productive plateau.

In the seventeenth century Ratlam became the centre of a Rathore Rajput ruling house linked to the Mughal court. Ratan Singh received the district under Shah Jahan and died fighting in the Mughal succession war in 1658. His successors faced changing imperial favour and divisions within the family; Ratlam was restored to Chhatrasal in 1705. Later Maratha expansion reduced the territory of the state.
simp_chinese:
拉特兰姆位于摩腊婆西部，中印度高原在这里连接古吉拉特、拉贾斯坦与德干北部的道路。周围乡村支持农业、畜养和交换，交通路线则吸引商人与旅行者经过。处在较大区域经济之间的位置，使市场获得便利。地方居民生活在拉杰普特家族、耕作村庄，以及试图从富有生产力的高原取得收入的国家要求共同塑造的环境中。

十七世纪，拉特兰姆成为与莫卧儿宫廷相联系的拉杰普特拉索尔家族统治中心。拉坦·辛格在沙贾汗统治下获授此地，1658年死于莫卧儿继承战争。其继承者面对帝国恩宠变化和家族内部分裂；1705年，拉特兰姆归还给恰特拉萨尔。此后马拉塔扩张使该邦领土缩小。

english:
Ratnagiri, the Hill of Jewels, was an important Buddhist monastic centre in the hills of coastal Odisha. Its great monasteries stood among stupas, shrines and sculpted images of the Buddha and other sacred figures. The richly carved entrance of the principal monastery led into a courtyard surrounded by monastic cells. Together with nearby Lalitgiri and Udayagiri, Ratnagiri formed part of a remarkable concentration of Buddhist foundations.

Ratnagiri flourished over many centuries and became associated with the development of Vajrayana Buddhism. Monks and patrons added numerous small votive stupas to the sacred complex, leaving a landscape crowded with offerings in stone and brick. By the end of the thirteenth century the monastery was in decline and new construction ceased. Its buildings and sculptures nevertheless preserve evidence of the community that once gathered on this hill.
simp_chinese:
勒德纳吉里意为“宝石山”，曾是奥里萨沿海丘陵中重要的佛教寺院中心。大型寺院周围分布着佛塔、圣所、佛陀及其他神圣人物的雕像。主寺雕刻精美的入口通向庭院，四周环绕僧房。这里与附近的拉利特吉里、乌达亚吉里一起，构成佛教寺院高度集中的地区。

勒德纳吉里繁荣了许多世纪，并与金刚乘佛教的发展相联系。僧人和施主在寺院建筑群中增建了大量小型供养塔，使圣地遍布石砖建造的供物。到十三世纪末，寺院已趋于衰落，新建筑不再兴建。建筑和雕塑仍保留了曾在山上聚集的佛教社群的痕迹。

english:
Ratnapura, or Ratanpur, was the capital of the Kalachuri dynasty that ruled much of Dakshina Kosala. Its rulers moved their seat here from Tummana and filled the town with forts, temples and tanks. The Mahamaya temple, dedicated to a form of the goddess, became a prominent religious centre; tradition associates its foundation with the Kalachuri king Ratnadeva. The town also served as a market for produce brought from the wooded hills to the north.

By the fifteenth century the Kalachuri house had divided into branches ruling from Ratanpur and Raipur. The Ratanpur line endured into the eighteenth century, when the expanding power of the Bhonsles of Nagpur reached Chhattisgarh. The kingdom acknowledged Maratha supremacy around 1740; after the death of its last ruler, Mohan Singh, it was annexed. The temples and remains of the old capital recall the long reign of the Kalachuris and the religious life they supported.
simp_chinese:
拉特纳普拉又称拉特纳普尔，是统治南拘萨罗大部分地区的卡拉丘里王朝的都城。统治者将驻地从图马纳迁来，在城中营建堡垒、寺庙和水池。供奉女神的摩诃摩耶寺成为重要宗教中心，传统将其创建归于卡拉丘里国王拉特纳德瓦。城镇也是北方森林山地物产的集散市场。

到十五世纪，卡拉丘里王室已分为拉特纳普尔和赖布尔两支。拉特纳普尔一支延续至十八世纪，此时那格浦尔的本斯勒家族势力扩张到恰蒂斯加尔。王国约在1740年承认马拉塔宗主权，末代统治者莫汉·辛格去世后被兼并。旧都的寺庙和遗迹，见证了卡拉丘里家族漫长的统治及其支持的宗教生活。

sources.title: 382917315 Archaeological study of Ratanpur A Capital site of Kalachuris of Ratanpur branch

english:
Ratnapura lies in Sri Lanka's wet southwestern interior, amid river valleys and wooded hills. The region is especially known for its tradition of gemstone mining, which depends on labour and knowledge of water and river sediments. Cultivation and routes through the interior also connect local communities with wider markets.

During the late medieval and early modern centuries, rival kingdoms existed on Sri Lanka, and Portuguese and Dutch powers later controlled parts of its coast. The inland Kandyan kingdom maintained changing relationships with these outside powers before British expansion in the early nineteenth century. Ratnapura's gem-mining tradition offers one way to understand its local economy.
simp_chinese:
拉特纳普勒位于斯里兰卡西南部湿润的内陆，河谷与林木覆盖的丘陵环绕着聚落。当地以宝石开采传统著称；开采需要劳动以及处理河流沉积物和水源的经验。耕作和交通也使内陆地区与其他市场相连。

中世纪后期至近代早期，斯里兰卡岛上存在相互竞争的王国，后来葡萄牙和荷兰势力控制了部分沿海地区。内陆的康提王国与欧洲势力之间的关系不断变化，英国在十九世纪初进一步扩张。拉特纳普勒的宝石传统提供了理解地方经济的一条线索。

english: Ratne lies on the Turiia in the low, wooded country of western Volhynia. A border town mentioned in documents around the turn of the thirteenth century, it housed a princely garrison and a monastery. The Mongol invasion devastated it. Under Polish rule Ratne became a royal town of the Chełm land and received Magdeburg rights in the fifteenth century, giving its inhabitants a measure of municipal self-government.
simp_chinese: 拉特内位于沃里尼亚西部低洼林地的图里亚河畔。这座边境城镇见于十三世纪前后的文书，曾驻有诸侯守军，也有一座修道院。蒙古入侵使它遭到破坏。波兰统治下，拉特内成为海乌姆地区的王室城镇，并在十五世纪获得马格德堡法权，使居民拥有一定程度的市政自治。

english: Rattanaburi grew from a settlement of Kuy people who crossed the Mekong from the Champasak country. Local tradition names Chiang Si as its founder at Ban Kut Wai; he later received a Siamese title as ruler. Along with Prathai Saman, Sangkha and Khukhan, the town sent tribute through Phimai to the Siamese court. Elephants, ivory and beeswax were among the forest products valued in these exchanges.
simp_chinese: 拉达那武里由库伊人聚落发展而来，这些人从占巴塞地区渡过湄公河迁居此地。地方传统称蒋西在班谷怀建立聚落，后来受暹罗册封为当地首领。此城与普泰萨曼、桑卡及库坎一样，经披迈向暹罗王廷进贡，贡品包括大象、象牙和蜂蜡等林地物产。

sources.title: ตำบลรัตนบุรี

english:
Ratzeburg lies among four lakes, its approaches confined to narrow strips of land. Founded in the eleventh century, it takes its name from the Slavic stronghold of Racisburg. Henry the Lion established a bishopric here in 1154 and began the great brick cathedral. The town itself belonged to the duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg, while the cathedral precinct formed a separate territory of the prince-bishopric.

The bishopric became Lutheran in 1554. In 1619 the dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg moved their residence here after the castle at Lauenburg had burned. Danish King Christian V bombarded Ratzeburg in 1693 during a dispute over the duchy's succession, reducing much of the town to ruins. It was rebuilt in Baroque style, but its castle was not restored. After the Napoleonic Wars, the duchy passed into personal union with the Danish crown.
simp_chinese:
拉策堡位于四座湖泊之间，通往城镇的道路受狭窄陆地所限。城市建于十一世纪，得名于斯拉夫人的拉齐斯堡。1154年，狮子亨利在此设立主教区，并开始修建宏大的砖砌主教座堂。城镇本身属于萨克森—劳恩堡公国，而主教座堂周围则是采邑主教领的一块独立领地。

主教区于1554年转向路德宗。1619年，劳恩堡城堡被焚后，萨克森—劳恩堡公爵将驻地迁至拉策堡。1693年，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安五世在公国继承权争端中炮击城市，使大部分城区沦为废墟。城市后来按巴洛克风格重建，城堡却未再恢复。拿破仑战争后，公国与丹麦王室形成共主邦联。

english: The Rauchua, also called the Bolshaya Baranikha, flows north through the uplands of western Chukotka to the East Siberian Sea. Its middle course winds between tundra hills, with gravel bars, shallow rapids and willow thickets along its channels. Farther north the river spreads into a low coastal landscape near Chaun Bay, where wetlands and islands meet the Arctic sea.
simp_chinese: 劳恰河又称大巴拉尼哈河，向北穿过楚科奇西部高地，注入东西伯利亚海。中游在苔原丘陵间蜿蜒，河道沿岸有砾石沙洲、浅滩和柳树丛。再往北，河流进入恰翁湾附近低平的海岸地带，湿地和岛屿与北极海洋相接。

english: Lake Ranco lies among the wooded foothills of the southern Chilean Andes. Several rivers flow into it, including the Calcurrupe, which connects it with Lake Maihue, and the Nilahue and Riñinahue from the eastern mountains. Its waters drain westwards through the Bueno River. Huilliche communities lived around the lake basins, where forests, waterways and nearby mountain valleys formed their homeland long before extensive Spanish settlement.
simp_chinese: 兰科湖位于智利南部安第斯山脉林木覆盖的山麓之间。多条河流注入湖中，包括连接迈韦湖的卡尔库鲁佩河，以及从东部山区流来的尼拉韦河和里尼纳韦河。湖水经布埃诺河向西流去。远在西班牙人大规模定居之前，维利切社群就生活在湖盆周围，森林、水道和附近山谷构成他们的家园。

english: Rauma follows the valley of the river of the same name down through the mountains to Romsdalsfjord. The valley offers a route between the western coast and the interior of Norway. During the Kalmar War in 1612, Scottish soldiers intending to enter Swedish service landed in Romsdal and marched inland along this route. At Kringen in Gudbrandsdalen, farmers assembled to block their passage and defeated them. Their expedition became known in Norway as the Skottetoget, the Scottish march.
simp_chinese: 劳马沿同名河流的山谷向下延伸，穿过群山抵达鲁姆斯达尔峡湾。这条山谷提供了挪威西岸与内陆之间的一条通道。1612年卡尔马战争期间，准备为瑞典效力的苏格兰士兵在鲁姆斯达尔登陆，沿此路向内陆进军。古德布兰谷地的农民在克林根集结阻击并击败他们；这次远征在挪威被称为“苏格兰人的行军”。

english:
Raumo, or Rauma, is an old harbour town on the Gulf of Bothnia. Its lanes and wooden houses grew around a Franciscan friary, whose stone Church of the Holy Cross contains medieval paintings. The town's merchants and seafarers looked out across the gulf, while its craftsmen worked in the houses and workshops that lined the narrow streets.

Rauma received town privileges in the fifteenth century. The Reformation ended the friary, but its church found a new use after fire destroyed the parish church of the Holy Trinity in 1640. The former monastic church became the Lutheran parish church. Further fires devastated the wooden town in the late seventeenth century, and its inhabitants rebuilt among the old streets. An eighteenth-century town hall later gave the market place a stone civic building amid the wooden quarter.
simp_chinese:
劳莫的芬兰语名为劳马，是波的尼亚湾沿岸的古老港城。狭巷与木屋围绕方济各会修院发展，修院的圣十字石教堂内绘有中世纪壁画。商人和水手面向海湾往来，工匠则在狭窄街道旁的住宅和作坊中劳作。

劳马在15世纪获得城市特权。宗教改革结束了修院的生活，但1640年圣三一教区教堂毁于火灾后，修院教堂有了新用途，成为路德宗教区教堂。17世纪后期，更多火灾重创这座木城，居民沿旧街巷重建。18世纪建起的市政厅则为木屋环绕的集市增添了一座石质公共建筑。

sources.title: Church of the Holy Cross, Rauma

english:
Rauna grew around a castle of the archbishops of Riga, one of their principal residences in the wooded interior of Livonia. The fortified complex enclosed a courtyard and was surrounded by outer defences. Archbishop Jasper Linde enlarged it in the early sixteenth century, adding a tower called Tall Jasper after himself. The halls and outbuildings housed the archbishop's household as well as the garrison.

Conflict between the archbishop and the powerful Livonian Order brought an armed attack on Rauna in 1556. The Livonian War and later struggles between Poland–Lithuania, Sweden and Russia brought further damage. After severe fighting in 1658 the castle was no longer restored. Its ruined walls remained above the settlement that had grown beside this once imposing residence.
simp_chinese:
劳纳围绕里加总主教的城堡发展起来，它是总主教在利沃尼亚内陆的主要驻地之一。设防建筑围合着庭院，外面还有防御工事。十六世纪初，总主教雅斯珀·林德扩建城堡，并以自己的名字将一座新塔称为「高雅斯珀」。大厅和附属建筑容纳总主教的随员与守军。

总主教与利沃尼亚骑士团之间的冲突使劳纳于1556年遭到攻击。利沃尼亚战争，以及此后波兰立陶宛、瑞典和俄国之间的争斗，又带来进一步破坏。1658年的激烈战斗后，城堡不再修复。残存城墙俯瞰着在这座昔日宏伟府邸旁发展起来的聚落。

english: Rounala was a Sámi meeting place and church site in the northern reaches of Torne Lappmark. The people of the Rounala community travelled across the mountains and maintained regular contact with the Norwegian coast. Tradition credits three Christian Sámi brothers with building the small chapel, carrying its timber over the mountains from Norway. A chapel stood here by the end of the sixteenth century; after a new church was established at Enontekis in the early seventeenth century, the old site gradually fell out of use.
simp_chinese: 鲁纳拉是托尔讷拉普马克北部的一处萨米人聚会和礼拜地点。鲁纳拉社群的人们翻越山脉，与挪威海岸保持定期联系。传说三位皈依基督教的萨米兄弟建造了这里的小礼拜堂，他们从挪威将木料运过群山。十六世纪末，此地已有礼拜堂；十七世纪初埃农泰基斯建起新教堂后，这处旧址逐渐不再使用。

english: Rautavaara lies among the lakes, bogs and forests of northern Savolax. Local farmers smelted iron from bog and lake ores, a craft practiced in northeastern Savolax from at least the sixteenth century. On a small islet in Lake Tiilikkajärvi stands a boundary stone marking the frontier drawn between Sweden and Russia in 1595; its carvings include a crown and a cross.
simp_chinese: 劳塔瓦拉位于萨沃拉克斯北部的湖泊、沼泽和森林之间。当地农民用沼泽矿和湖矿炼铁，萨沃拉克斯东北部至少从16世纪起便有这种工艺。蒂利卡湖的小岛上立着一块界石，标记瑞典与俄国1595年划定的边界，石上刻有王冠和十字。

english: Ravar stands on the edge of the Lut Desert north of Kerman, where routes lead towards the oases of Khorasan. Its climate is marked by hot summers, and its cultivated land lies amid dry hills and plains. During the Qajar period a community of carpet weavers worked here alongside the better-known textile makers of Kerman. The road north led caravans and pilgrims through the difficult desert country towards Mashhad.
simp_chinese: 拉瓦尔位于克尔曼以北、卢特沙漠边缘，道路从这里通向呼罗珊的绿洲。当地夏季炎热，耕地散布在干燥的丘陵和平原之间。卡扎尔时期，这里已有一批地毯织工，与更为著名的克尔曼纺织工匠并存。北面的道路引领商队与朝圣者穿越艰险的沙漠地带，前往马什哈德。

english: Between Ravar and Nayband the road crosses a difficult stretch along the western edge of the Lut Desert. Caravans passed through mountain gaps and open plains, relying on guides and scattered stopping places where water could be stored. One such cistern, Howz-e Khan, was among the works attributed to Ganj Ali Khan, Safavid governor of Kerman. Without these halts, travellers risked losing their way in a country with few springs.
simp_chinese: 拉瓦尔与奈班德之间的道路穿越卢特沙漠西缘一段艰险地带。商队经过山间隘口与开阔平原，依靠向导和分散的停驻点储存水源。其中一座称为豪兹汗的蓄水池，被列为萨法维克尔曼总督甘吉·阿里汗的工程。若没有这些歇脚处，旅人便可能在泉水稀少的地区迷失方向。

english:
Ravensburg lies in Upper Swabia at a crossing of the Schussen, on a route between the Danube and Lake Constance. A town developed beneath the Welf family's castle, and in 1276 Emperor Rudolf I granted it the status of a free imperial city.

Around 1380 merchant families from Ravensburg and Constance founded the Great Ravensburg Trading Society. Linen and fustian were early products, and paper became another commodity after a mill opened in 1402. Its trade reached distant markets, but the society was liquidated in 1530. The Thirty Years' War brought a severe decline in population, and Swedish troops destroyed the old castle.
simp_chinese:
拉芬斯堡位于上施瓦本的舒森河渡口，处在多瑙河与博登湖之间的道路上。城镇在韦尔夫家族的城堡下发展起来；1276年，皇帝鲁道夫一世授予它自由帝国城市地位。

约1380年，拉芬斯堡和康斯坦茨的商人家族建立了大拉芬斯堡贸易公司。亚麻布和混纺布是早期商品，1402年造纸厂开工后纸张也成为贸易品。公司的商业网络延伸到远方市场，但于1530年清算。三十年战争导致人口严重减少，瑞典军队还摧毁了旧城堡。

english: Ravno stands where the Ravanica joins the Great Morava, at a crossing used since Roman times. The Romans knew the settlement as Horreum Margi; in the Middle Ages it became Ravno, and later took the name Ćuprija from an Ottoman bridge. Nearby, Prince Lazar founded the monastery of Ravanica, whose church is an important work of medieval Serbian architecture. Its painted walls include the prince and his family among the figures commemorated by the foundation.
simp_chinese: 拉夫诺坐落在拉瓦尼察河汇入大摩拉瓦河之处，罗马时代这里就有渡河通道。罗马人称聚落为霍雷乌姆·马尔吉，中世纪称作拉夫诺，后来因奥斯曼人修建的桥梁而得名丘普里亚。附近的拉瓦尼察修道院由拉扎尔公建立，教堂是塞尔维亚中世纪建筑的重要作品。壁画中描绘着这位建院者及其家人。

english:
Rawa was a seat of the dukes of Mazovia, whose brick castle rose in the low ground where the Rawka and Rylka meet. The town later became the centre of Rawa Voivodeship under the Polish Crown. Its castle held a treasury of unusual importance, administered by the royal starosta: from 1569 the quarter tax collected from royal estates was stored securely here to pay the Polish Crown's regular standing troops.

Jesuits established themselves in Rawa in the early seventeenth century and completed a college in 1622. The writer Jan Chryzostom Pasek was among its pupils. Wars of the century damaged the town and castle, but the surviving tower still marks the place where the treasury and the old ducal residence once stood.
simp_chinese:
拉瓦曾是马佐夫舍公爵的驻地，砖造城堡建在拉夫卡河与雷尔卡河汇合处的低地。城镇后来成为波兰王室拉瓦省的中心。城堡内设有由王室地方长官管理的重要金库：从1569年起，王室领地征收的四分之一税存放于此，用来支付王室常备军的费用。

十七世纪初，耶稣会士来到拉瓦，1622年建成学院，作家扬·赫雷佐斯托姆·帕塞克曾在此求学。同世纪的战争损毁城镇和城堡，幸存的塔楼仍标示着昔日金库和公爵居所的位置。

english:
Rawa is a Papuan language of the mountainous country in northeastern New Guinea. Forested ridges separate valleys that run towards the north coast and the Ramu basin. Its speakers are neighbours of communities using other Papuan and Austronesian languages, reflecting the linguistic diversity of the country between the mountains and the Bismarck Sea.

The later city of Goroka lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
拉瓦语是新几内亚东北部山地的一种巴布亚语言。森林山脊分隔着通往北岸和拉穆河流域的河谷。使用拉瓦语的居民与使用其他巴布亚语言和南岛语言的社群毗邻而居，反映出山地与俾斯麦海之间的语言多样性。

后来的戈罗卡位于此地附近。

english: The waters west of Kanton lie among the widely scattered atolls of the Phoenix Islands. Archaeological remains on islands in the group show that Pacific voyagers reached them before European contact. In the early nineteenth century the expansion of American whaling brought new ships into this remote region.
simp_chinese: 坎顿岛以西的水域位于凤凰群岛零散分布的环礁之间。群岛上的考古遗迹表明，太平洋航海者早在与欧洲人接触之前已抵达此地。十九世纪初，美国捕鲸业的扩张为这一偏远地区带来了新的船只。

english: Near the equator, open Pacific waters separate Howland Island from the Phoenix Islands to the south. Earlier Pacific islanders reached these remote shores, leaving traces of settlement on Howland and other islands. In 1822 the American whaler Oeno sighted Howland, which its captain named Worth Island.
simp_chinese: 赤道附近的开阔太平洋将豪兰岛与南方的凤凰群岛隔开。早期太平洋岛民曾抵达这些遥远海岸，在豪兰岛和其他岛屿留下定居的痕迹。1822年，美国捕鲸船“奥伊诺”号望见豪兰岛，船长将其命名为沃思岛。

english: Near the equator, open water stretches west of Howland Island toward the antimeridian. Howland is a low coral island whose archaeological remains testify to earlier Pacific settlement. In 1822 the American whaler Oeno sighted the island, which its captain George Worth named for himself.
simp_chinese: 赤道附近，开阔水域从豪兰岛向西延伸至本初子午线对面的经线。豪兰是一座低矮珊瑚岛，其考古遗迹见证了太平洋岛民早期的定居。1822年，美国捕鲸船“奥伊诺”号望见此岛，船长乔治·沃思以自己的名字为它命名。

english: Northwest of Howland Island lies a stretch of the equatorial Pacific, far from the high islands of Polynesia. Howland’s low coral shore preserves traces of an earlier settlement. American whalers sighted the island in the 1820s; the captain of the Oeno called it Worth Island in 1822.
simp_chinese: 豪兰岛西北方是一片赤道太平洋水域，远离波利尼西亚的高岛。豪兰岛低矮的珊瑚海岸保存着早期聚落的痕迹。美国捕鲸船于十九世纪二十年代望见此岛；1822年，“奥伊诺”号船长将它命名为沃思岛。

english: The open Pacific north of Howland Island lies near the equator. Howland’s narrow fringing reef surrounds a flat coral island, where archaeological traces show that Pacific islanders lived before European and American visitors. The American whaling ship Oeno sighted the island in 1822.
simp_chinese: 豪兰岛以北的开阔太平洋靠近赤道。狭窄的裙礁环绕着低平珊瑚岛，考古痕迹表明，欧美访客到来之前太平洋岛民曾在岛上生活。1822年，美国捕鲸船“奥伊诺”号望见了这座岛。

english: East of Howland Island, equatorial waters lead toward the widely scattered islands of the Phoenix group. Archaeological evidence on Howland points to settlement before European contact. In the early nineteenth century American whaling ships reached the island; the Oeno sighted it in 1822.
simp_chinese: 豪兰岛以东的赤道水域通向分散的凤凰群岛。豪兰岛的考古证据显示，与欧洲人接触之前岛上曾有人定居。十九世纪初，美国捕鲸船来到此岛；“奥伊诺”号于1822年望见了它。

english: West of the Phoenix Islands lies a vast expanse of open Pacific water. The low islands to the east bear archaeological remains of early Pacific settlement, especially on Manra and Orona. In the early nineteenth century the expansion of whaling brought European and American vessels to the group.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛以西是一片辽阔的开阔太平洋。东面的低矮岛屿上有太平洋岛民早期定居的考古遗迹，其中尤以曼拉和奥罗纳为多。十九世纪初，捕鲸业的扩张使欧美船只来到这一群岛。

english: Southwest of the Phoenix Islands, the open Pacific Ocean surrounds a chain of small coral islands. Nikumaroro lies toward the western end of the group. In 1825 the Nantucket whaler Ganges sighted the atoll, which its captain Joshua Coffin named Gardner Island.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛西南方，开阔大洋环绕着一串小珊瑚岛。尼库马罗罗位于群岛西部。1825年，楠塔基特捕鲸船“恒河”号望见该环礁，船长约书亚·科芬将它命名为加德纳岛。

english: South of the Phoenix Islands, the open Pacific separates the atolls from other island groups. Archaeological remains on Manra and Orona show that people had settled these remote islands before European ships arrived. Whalers began reaching the group as the Pacific fishery expanded in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛以南，开阔的太平洋将这些环礁与其他群岛隔开。曼拉和奥罗纳的考古遗迹表明，欧洲船只到来之前，人们曾在这些偏远岛屿定居。十九世纪初，随着太平洋捕鲸业扩张，捕鲸船开始抵达群岛。

english: Northwest of Kanton, open water separates the atoll from other landfalls in the equatorial Pacific. Kanton encloses a large lagoon within a narrow coral rim. In 1824 the London whalers Phoenix and Mary came upon the island and gave it the name Mary Ballcotts Island.
simp_chinese: 坎顿岛西北方的开阔水域将环礁与赤道太平洋中的其他陆地隔开。坎顿的狭窄珊瑚环围住一片大潟湖。1824年，伦敦捕鲸船“凤凰”号与“玛丽”号来到该岛，将其称作玛丽·巴尔科茨岛。

english: North of the Phoenix Islands, a wide stretch of ocean lies between their coral atolls and the equator. Their scattered shores were reached by Pacific islanders before the arrival of European and American whalers. In 1824 the London ships Phoenix and Mary visited Kanton, the northernmost island of the group.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛以北，一片宽阔海洋位于珊瑚环礁与赤道之间。欧美捕鲸船到来以前，太平洋岛民已抵达群岛零散的海岸。1824年，伦敦船只“凤凰”号和“玛丽”号到访群岛最北端的坎顿岛。

english: Northeast of the Phoenix Islands, the central Pacific extends far beyond the low coral shores of Rawaki. As American whaling expanded into the Pacific in the early nineteenth century, its ships encountered the scattered islands of the group. Their earlier settlement is recorded in archaeological remains.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛东北方，中太平洋远远延伸至拉瓦基低矮珊瑚海岸之外。十九世纪初，美国捕鲸业向太平洋扩张，船只陆续遇见群岛的零散岛屿。岛上考古遗迹记录了更早的定居。

english: East of the Phoenix Islands lies open ocean dotted with low coral landfalls. On Manra, archaeological structures bear witness to Pacific settlement before European contact. The London whaler Sydney Packet reported the island in 1823, during the early expansion of whaling in this part of the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛以东的开阔大洋散布着低矮珊瑚陆地。曼拉岛的考古建筑见证了欧洲人接触之前太平洋岛民的定居。1823年，伦敦捕鲸船“悉尼邮船”号报告了该岛，彼时捕鲸业正在这一太平洋地区扩张。

english: Southeast of the Phoenix Islands, the Pacific extends away from the coral islands of Manra and Rawaki. Archaeological remains on Manra show that Pacific voyagers reached and settled it before European contact. In the early nineteenth century whaling ships entered these remote waters.
simp_chinese: 凤凰群岛东南方，太平洋向曼拉和拉瓦基的珊瑚岛之外延伸。曼拉岛的考古遗迹表明，欧洲人接触之前太平洋航海者已抵达并在此定居。十九世纪初，捕鲸船进入这些偏远水域。

english: Rawalakot lies in the Pir Panjal mountains in the country of Poonch, southwest of the Vale of Kashmir. In the late fifteenth century the campaigns of Malik Tazi Bhat brought Poonch under the Kashmir Sultanate. Its local rulers continued to govern under the sultan's suzerainty, owing tribute and military support. The region later came under Mughal influence, before becoming part of Ranjit Singh's Sikh Empire in 1819.
